declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0955, part (2).** For a Noetherian ring the comparison functor
`D(I^∞-torsion) ⥤ D_{I^∞-torsion}(A)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A6N] is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_powerTorsionComparison :
    (powerTorsionComparison.{u, max u v} A I hI).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Dualizing.TorsionCounit.isIso_compareTorsionFunctors_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0955, part (3).** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and `I ⊆ A` a finitely generated
ideal. The comparison `RΓ_I ⟶ RΓ_Z` of [Stacks, Tag 0A6U] is an isomorphism at every object of
`D(A)`, with no torsion or boundedness hypothesis.

Evaluate the naturality square of the comparison at the local cohomology counit
`c : ι(RΓ_Z(K)) ⟶ K`. Its source has `I`-power-torsion cohomology, so the comparison is
invertible there by part (1); `RΓ_Z(c)` is invertible because `RΓ_Z` is a coreflection; and
`RΓ_I(c)` is invertible because the counit is universal among morphisms from torsion objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_compareTorsionFunctors_app
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) :
    IsIso ((compareTorsionFunctors.{u, v} A I hI).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.extendedCechComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0956.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `I = (f₁, …, f_r)` be an ideal of `A` and
let `Z = V(I)`. For every `A`-module `M` there are canonical isomorphisms
`RΓ_I(M) ≅ C^•(f₁, …, f_r; M) ≅ RΓ_Z(M)` in `D(A)`, the middle term being the extended
alternating Čech complex; the first carries the Čech augmentation to the structure map of
`RΓ_I(M)` and the second carries the local-cohomology counit back to the Čech augmentation,
which is what makes the pair canonical.
declarations.statement:
def extendedCechComparison (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hIf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) :
    { e : (derivedPowerTorsionObj.{u, v} A I (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing I) M ≅
              extendedCechObject f M) ×
            (extendedCechObject f M ≅
              (localCohomologyOnModules.{u, max u v} A I
                (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing I)).obj M) //
        e.1.hom ≫ extendedCechAugmentationHom f M =
            derivedPowerTorsionObjCounit.{u, v} A I (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing I) M ∧
          e.2.hom ≫ (Dualizing.localCohomologyAdjunction A I
              (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing I)).counit.app
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) 0).obj M) =
            extendedCechAugmentationHom f M }

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomologyOfRingBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957.** Local cohomology of the regular module commutes with derived extension of
scalars along a homomorphism of commutative rings, for a finitely generated ideal.
declarations.statement:
def localCohomologyOfRingBaseChangeIso (A B : Type uA) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, 0, uA} f).functor.obj (localCohomologyOfRing A I hI) ≅
      localCohomologyOfRing B (I.map f) (hI.map f)

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomologyOfRingLiftedBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957.** The change-of-rings isomorphism for local cohomology of the regular module,
for two rings in independent universes, after transporting both regular modules into a common
module universe.
declarations.statement:
def localCohomologyOfRingLiftedBaseChangeIso (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, max uA uB, uB} f).functor.obj
        (localCohomologyOfRingLifted.{uA, max uA uB} A I hI) ≅
      localCohomologyOfRingLifted.{uB, max uA uB} B (I.map f) (hI.map f)

declarations.name: Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionOfRingBaseChangeIsoLocalCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957, the first equality.** `RΓ_I(A) ⊗ᴸ_A B ≅ RΓ_Z(A) ⊗ᴸ_A B`: derived extension of
scalars applied to the identification of the two torsion models over the Noetherian ring `A`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPowerTorsionOfRingBaseChangeIsoLocalCohomology (A B : Type uA) [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, 0, uA} f).functor.obj
        (derivedPowerTorsionOfRing A I hI) ≅
      (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, 0, uA} f).functor.obj
        (localCohomologyOfRing A I hI)
declarations.comment: first equality: RΓ_I(A) ⊗ᴸ B = RΓ_Z(A) ⊗ᴸ B

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomologyOfRingIsoDerivedPowerTorsionOfRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957, the last equality.** `RΓ_Y(B) ≅ RΓ_{IB}(B)` for `Y = V(IB)`: the
identification of the two torsion models over the Noetherian ring `B`, read backwards at the
ideal `IB = Ideal.map f I`.
declarations.statement:
def localCohomologyOfRingIsoDerivedPowerTorsionOfRing (A B : Type uA) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing B] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    localCohomologyOfRing B (I.map f) (hI.map f) ≅
      derivedPowerTorsionOfRing B (I.map f) (hI.map f)

declarations.name: Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionOfRingBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957, the whole chain.** For a homomorphism `f : A → B` of Noetherian rings and a
finitely generated ideal `I ⊆ A`, there is an isomorphism
`RΓ_I(A) ⊗ᴸ_A B ≅ RΓ_{IB}(B)` in `D(B)`, obtained by composing the three isomorphisms of the
source: the first equality, the change-of-rings isomorphism
`Dualizing.localCohomologyOfRingBaseChangeIso`, and the last equality.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPowerTorsionOfRingBaseChangeIso (A B : Type uA) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, 0, uA} f).functor.obj
        (derivedPowerTorsionOfRing A I hI) ≅
      derivedPowerTorsionOfRing B (I.map f) (hI.map f)
declarations.comment: the four-term chain, composed, for two rings in one universe

declarations.name: Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionOfRingLiftedBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0957, the whole chain, for two rings in independent universes**, after transporting
both regular modules into a common module universe.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPowerTorsionOfRingLiftedBaseChangeIso (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) :
    (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{uA, max uA uB, uB} f).functor.obj
        (derivedPowerTorsionOfRingLifted.{uA, max uA uB} A I hI) ≅
      derivedPowerTorsionOfRingLifted.{uB, max uA uB} B (I.map f) (hI.map f)
declarations.comment: the four-term chain, composed, across universes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleToposEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical equivalence between the small étale topoi obtained from two
big étale sites containing the same scheme.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtaleToposEquiv
    (B₁ B₂ : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (h₁ : B₁.Contains S) (h₂ : B₂.Contains S) :
    smallEtaleTopos.{u, max (u + 1) v} B₁ S h₁ ≌
      smallEtaleTopos.{u, max (u + 1) v} B₂ S h₂

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections
declarations.doc:
On affine étale objects represented in both small sites, the comparison
equivalence agrees with restriction along their identification over `S`. This
is a natural isomorphism of evaluation functors, hence is natural in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections
    (B₁ B₂ : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (h₁ : B₁.Contains S) (h₂ : B₂.Contains S)
    (X₁ : SmallAffineEtale B₁ S h₁)
    (X₂ : SmallAffineEtale B₂ S h₂)
    (e : (Over.post B₁.inclusion).obj X₁.obj.obj ≅
      (Over.post B₂.inclusion).obj X₂.obj.obj) :
    (smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B₁ B₂ S h₁ h₂).functor ⋙
        (sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology B₂ S h₂)
          (Type (max (u + 1) v))).obj
          (Opposite.op X₂.obj) ≅
      (sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology B₁ S h₁)
        (Type (max (u + 1) v))).obj
        (Opposite.op X₁.obj)
declarations.comment: comparison on common affine étale objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections_natural
declarations.doc:
The section comparison commutes with restrictions along a morphism of
common affine étale objects.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections_natural
    (B₁ B₂ : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (h₁ : B₁.Contains S) (h₂ : B₂.Contains S)
    (X₁ Y₁ : SmallAffineEtale B₁ S h₁)
    (X₂ Y₂ : SmallAffineEtale B₂ S h₂)
    (eX : (Over.post B₁.inclusion).obj X₁.obj.obj ≅
      (Over.post B₂.inclusion).obj X₂.obj.obj)
    (eY : (Over.post B₁.inclusion).obj Y₁.obj.obj ≅
      (Over.post B₂.inclusion).obj Y₂.obj.obj)
    (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂)
    (hf : (Over.post B₁.inclusion).map
        ((SmallEtale.inclusion B₁ S h₁).map
          ((SmallAffineEtale.inclusion B₁ S h₁).map f₁)) ≫ eY.hom =
      eX.hom ≫ (Over.post B₂.inclusion).map
        ((SmallEtale.inclusion B₂ S h₂).map
          ((SmallAffineEtale.inclusion B₂ S h₂).map f₂)))
    (F : smallEtaleTopos.{u, max (u + 1) v} B₁ S h₁) :
    (smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections.{u, v} B₁ B₂ S h₁ h₂ Y₁ Y₂ eY).hom.app F ≫
        ((sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology B₁ S h₁)
          (Type (max (u + 1) v))).map
          (Opposite.op ((SmallAffineEtale.inclusion B₁ S h₁).map f₁))).app F =
      ((sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology B₂ S h₂)
        (Type (max (u + 1) v))).map
          (Opposite.op ((SmallAffineEtale.inclusion B₂ S h₂).map f₂))).app
            ((smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B₁ B₂ S h₁ h₂).functor.obj F) ≫
        (smallEtaleToposEquiv_sections.{u, v} B₁ B₂ S h₁ h₂ X₁ X₂ eX).hom.app F
declarations.comment: naturality on common affine étale objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleToposEquiv_refl
declarations.doc:
Comparing a small étale topos with itself is naturally isomorphic to the
identity functor.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtaleToposEquiv_refl
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (h : B.Contains S) :
    (smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B B S h h).functor ≅
      𝟭 (smallEtaleTopos.{u, max (u + 1) v} B S h)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleToposEquiv_trans
declarations.doc:
The equivalence for two successive changes of big étale site agrees,
naturally in sheaves, with the equivalence for the direct change.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtaleToposEquiv_trans
    (B₁ B₂ B₃ : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (h₁ : B₁.Contains S) (h₂ : B₂.Contains S) (h₃ : B₃.Contains S) :
    (smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B₁ B₂ S h₁ h₂).functor ⋙
      (smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B₂ B₃ S h₂ h₃).functor ≅
        (smallEtaleToposEquiv.{u, v} B₁ B₃ S h₁ h₃).functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_smallEtaleBaseChangeNatTrans
declarations.doc:
Consider a cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```
of schemes of a big étale site with `f` finite, and a sheaf of sets `F` on the small étale site
of `X`. Then the canonical comparison `g⁻¹ f_* F ⟶ f'_* (g')⁻¹ F` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_smallEtaleBaseChangeNatTrans
    (sq : IsPullback (B.inclusion.map g') (B.inclusion.map f') (B.inclusion.map f)
      (B.inclusion.map g))
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (Type (u + 1))) :
    IsIso ((smallEtaleBaseChangeNatTrans B g' f' f g h).app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_smallEtaleBaseChangeAb_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Base change of an abelian direct image along a finite morphism, at the comparison
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChangeAb`.** For a cartesian square
```
Y' --π'--> Y
|e'        |e
v          v
T' --π---> T
```
of schemes with `π` finite, the canonical comparison `e⁻¹ π_* ⟶ π'_* (e')⁻¹` of abelian sheaves on
the small étale sites is an isomorphism.

This is [Stacks, Tag 0959] for abelian coefficients, stated at the comparison which the
higher-direct-image development of [Stacks, Tag 0F02] uses. The abelian statement at the
comparison of the proper base change development is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_etaleAbelianBaseChange_of_isFinite`; the passage between the two
comparisons is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_smallEtaleBaseChangeAb_of_isIso_etaleAbelianBaseChange`, and no big
étale site occurs in the hypotheses.

[Stacks, Tag 0EYP] is this statement with `π` merely *integral*. It does not follow from this one:
the source's passage from a finite morphism to an integral one presents the comparison as a
colimit of the comparisons for the finite stages of the integral morphism, and that presentation
is not available in this library for abelian coefficients.
declarations.comment: for abelian sheaves, at the comparison `smallEtaleBaseChangeAb` of [Stacks, Tag 0F02]; the morphism is finite, not merely integral, so this is 0959 and not 0EYP

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyConstant_smallEtaleSheafPullback
declarations.doc:
**Tag 093R for small étale sites.** The inverse image of a locally constant sheaf along a
morphism of small étale sites is locally constant, for arbitrary coefficients.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocallyConstant_smallEtaleSheafPullback
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property) A)
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback A
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a locally constant étale sheaf of sets along a finite étale
morphism is locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (max (u + 1) v)) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isFiniteLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a finite locally constant étale sheaf of sets along a finite
étale morphism is finite locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (max (u + 1) v)) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)
declarations.comment: finite locally constant sheaves of sets

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_abelian
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a locally constant étale sheaf of abelian groups along a
finite étale morphism is locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_abelian {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [∀ V : Y.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology Y).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)
declarations.comment: locally constant sheaves of abelian groups

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isFiniteLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_abelian
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a finite locally constant étale sheaf of abelian groups
along a finite étale morphism is finite locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_abelian {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [∀ V : Y.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology Y).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)
declarations.comment: finite locally constant sheaves of abelian groups

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_modules
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a locally constant étale sheaf of modules along a finite
étale morphism is locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_modules {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (R : Type r) [Ring R]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R)]
    [∀ V : Y.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology Y).over V) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R)]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R))
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F] :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isFiniteTypeLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_modules
declarations.doc:
Direct image of a finite-type locally constant étale sheaf of modules
along a finite étale morphism is finite-type locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteTypeLocallyConstant_finiteEtalePushforward_modules {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (R : Type r) [Ring R]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R)]
    [∀ V : Y.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology Y).over V) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R)]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R))
    (hF : Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant R (smallEtaleTopology X) F) :
    Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant R (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (((Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} R) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).obj F)
declarations.comment: finite-type locally constant sheaves of modules

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095C (1).** A morphism of locally constant sheaves of sets on the small étale site
of a scheme, whose source is finite locally constant, is on an étale covering of any object the
morphism of constant sheaves attached to a map of sets.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) (Type w)]
    (F G : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (Type w)) (φ : F ⟶ G)
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F]
    [IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) G] (U : X.Etale) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ smallEtaleTopology X U ∧ ∀ i,
        ∃ (A B : Type w), Finite A ∧
          ∃ (g : A ⟶ B)
            (eF : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (Type w)).obj A ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (Type w) (V i)).obj F)
            (eG : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (Type w)).obj B ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (Type w) (V i)).obj G),
              (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (Type w)).map g ≫ eG.hom =
                eF.hom ≫ ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (Type w) (V i)).map φ

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map_abelian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095C (2).** A morphism of locally constant sheaves of abelian groups on the small
étale site of a scheme, whose source is finite locally constant, is on an étale covering of any
object the morphism of constant sheaves attached to a homomorphism of abelian groups.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map_abelian [UnivLE.{u + 1, w}]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) Ab.{w}]
    (F G : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) Ab.{w}) (φ : F ⟶ G)
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F]
    [IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) G] (U : X.Etale) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ smallEtaleTopology X U ∧ ∀ i,
        ∃ (A B : Ab.{w}), Finite (A : Type w) ∧
          ∃ (g : A ⟶ B)
            (eF : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) Ab.{w}).obj A ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback Ab.{w} (V i)).obj F)
            (eG : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) Ab.{w}).obj B ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback Ab.{w} (V i)).obj G),
              (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) Ab.{w}).map g ≫ eG.hom =
                eF.hom ≫ ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback Ab.{w} (V i)).map φ

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map_modules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095C (3).** A morphism of locally constant sheaves of `R`-modules on the small
étale site of a scheme, whose source is locally constant of finite type, is on an étale covering
of any object the morphism of constant sheaves attached to a homomorphism of `R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_etaleCover_restrict_eq_constantSheaf_map_modules {R : Type r} [Ring R]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) (ModuleCat.{w} R)]
    (F G : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (ModuleCat.{w} R)) (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant R (smallEtaleTopology X) F)
    [IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) G] (U : X.Etale) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ smallEtaleTopology X U ∧ ∀ i,
        ∃ (A B : ModuleCat.{w} R), ModuleCat.isFG R A ∧
          ∃ (g : A ⟶ B)
            (eF : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{w} R)).obj A ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R) (V i)).obj F)
            (eG : (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{w} R)).obj B ≅
              ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R) (V i)).obj G),
              (constantSheaf ((smallEtaleTopology X).over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{w} R)).map g ≫
                  eG.hom =
                eF.hom ≫ ((smallEtaleTopology X).overPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R) (V i)).map φ

declarations.name: Stacks.ConstantSheaf.isLocallyConstant_tensor_smallEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095D.** The tensor product of two locally constant sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the
small étale site of a scheme is a locally constant sheaf of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_tensor_smallEtale {X : Scheme.{u}} (Λ : Type w) [CommRing Λ]
    [UnivLE.{u + 1, w}]
    [HasWeakSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    [∀ U : X.Etale, HasWeakSheafify ((smallEtaleTopology X).over U) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    (F G : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ))
    [IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) F]
    [IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) G] :
    IsLocallyConstant (smallEtaleTopology X) (F ⊗ G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_iff_exists_stratification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095E, sets and abelian groups: the equivalence of (1) and (3).** On a quasi-compact
quasi-separated scheme, a sheaf with values in a concrete category is constructible exactly when
there is one finite partition of the whole scheme by constructible locally closed subschemes on
each of which its inverse image is finite locally constant.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_iff_exists_stratification
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) D) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B X F ↔
      ∃ s : ConstructibleStratification B X ⊤,
        ∀ i, Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant
          (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)
          (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (s.inclusion i)).sheafPullback D
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_exists_stratification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095E, modules: the equivalence of (1) and (3).** On a quasi-compact quasi-separated
scheme, a sheaf of modules over a commutative ring is constructible exactly when there is one
finite partition of the whole scheme by constructible locally closed subschemes on each of which
its inverse image is locally constant with finitely generated values.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_exists_stratification
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F ↔
      ∃ s : ConstructibleStratification B X ⊤,
        ∀ i, Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant R
          (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)
          (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (s.inclusion i)).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095E for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups.** For a sheaf on the small étale site
of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme the following are equivalent: it is constructible; it is
constructible after restriction to each member of some open cover; and there is one constructible
stratification of the whole scheme on each stratum of which its inverse image is finite locally
constant.

Finite local constancy is closed under isomorphism and stable under inverse image along an
arbitrary morphism of small étale sites, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLocallyConstant_smallEtaleSheafPullback_of_overPost`, which is
Tag 093R, so `AlgebraicGeometry.isStratifiedSheaf_tfae` applies to it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_tfae (Z : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace Z.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z.obj]
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property) A) :
    List.TFAE
      [ IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B Z G,
        ∃ (J : Type (u + 1)) (Y : J → B.Scheme) (g : ∀ j, Y j ⟶ Z),
          (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (g j))) ∧
          (Set.univ = ⋃ j, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (g j)).base) ∧
          ∀ j, IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B (Y j)
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (g j)).sheafPullback A
              (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B (Y j).obj (Y j).property)).obj G),
        ∃ s : ConstructibleStratification B Z ⊤, ∀ i,
          Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant (FD := FA) (CD := CA)
            (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (s.inclusion i)).sheafPullback A
              (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)).obj G) ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf of modules over a Noetherian ring on the small étale site of a quasi-compact
quasi-separated scheme the following are equivalent: it is constructible; it is constructible
after restriction to each member of some open cover; and there is one constructible stratification
of the whole scheme on each stratum of which its inverse image is locally constant with finitely
generated values.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_tfae (Z : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace Z.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z.obj]
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R)) :
    List.TFAE
      [ IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Z R G,
        ∃ (J : Type (u + 1)) (Y : J → B.Scheme) (g : ∀ j, Y j ⟶ Z),
          (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (g j))) ∧
          (Set.univ = ⋃ j, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (g j)).base) ∧
          ∀ j, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B (Y j) R
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (g j)).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
              (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B (Y j).obj (Y j).property)).obj G),
        ∃ s : ConstructibleStratification B Z ⊤, ∀ i,
          Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant R
            (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (s.inclusion i)).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
              (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B (s.piece i).obj (s.piece i).property)).obj G) ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095F for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups.** Let `X` be a scheme covered by the
images of open immersions `U k ⟶ X`. A sheaf with values in a concrete category whose restriction
to every `U k` is constructible is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_of_openCover (X : B.Scheme)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) D)
    {I : Type*} (U : I → B.Scheme) (j : ∀ k, U k ⟶ X)
    (hj : ∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (j k)))
    (hcover : Set.univ = ⋃ k, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j k)).base)
    (hlocal : ∀ k, IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B (U k)
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (j k)).sheafPullback D
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B (U k).obj (U k).property)).obj F)) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095F for sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring.** Let `X` be a scheme covered by
the images of open immersions `U k ⟶ X`. A sheaf of modules over a Noetherian ring whose
restriction to every `U k` is constructible is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_openCover (X : B.Scheme)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R))
    {I : Type*} (U : I → B.Scheme) (j : ∀ k, U k ⟶ X)
    (hj : ∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (j k)))
    (hcover : Set.univ = ⋃ k, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j k)).base)
    (hlocal : ∀ k, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B (U k) R
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (j k)).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B (U k).obj (U k).property)).obj F)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_iff_forall_restrict
registrations.comment: sets and abelian groups: constructible iff constructible on every member of any open covering

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_forall_restrict

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095G for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups.** The inverse image of a constructible
sheaf with values in a concrete category along an arbitrary morphism of schemes is
constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_pullback {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) D)
    (hF : IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B Y F) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B X
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback D
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095G for sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring.** The inverse image of a
constructible sheaf of modules over a Noetherian ring along an arbitrary morphism of schemes is
constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y R F) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095H for sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring.** Let `p : T ⟶ S` be a finite
étale morphism of a big étale site, let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `ℱ` be a constructible
sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `T_étale`. Then `p_*ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on
`S_étale`. No hypothesis is imposed on `S` or `T`, and nothing is granted.

By Stacks 095F constructibility may be checked on an open covering of `S`, and the affine opens
of `S` are such a covering; the restriction of `p_*ℱ` to an affine open `U` is the direct image,
along the base change of `p` to `U`, of the restriction of `ℱ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardBaseChangeIso`), that base change is again
finite étale, the restriction of `ℱ` is constructible by Stacks 095G, and `U` is quasi-compact
and quasi-separated, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pushforward_of_compactSpace` applies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pushforward
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map p)] [Etale (B.inclusion.map p)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B T Λ F) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B S Λ
      ((B.smallPushforward p (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring; nothing granted, no hypothesis on S or T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_unconditional
declarations.doc:
Let `p : T ⟶ S` be a finite étale morphism of a big étale site and let `ℱ` be a
constructible sheaf of sets on `T_étale`. Then `p_*ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of sets on
`S_étale`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_unconditional
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map p)] [Etale (B.inclusion.map p)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B T F) :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B S ((B.smallPushforward p (Type (u + 1))).obj F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets; nothing granted, no hypothesis on S or T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pushforward_unconditional
declarations.doc:
Let `p : T ⟶ S` be a finite étale morphism of a big étale site and let `ℱ` be a
constructible abelian sheaf on `T_étale`. Then `p_*ℱ` is a constructible abelian sheaf on
`S_étale`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pushforward_unconditional
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map p)] [Etale (B.inclusion.map p)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B T F) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B S
      ((B.smallPushforward p AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups; nothing granted, no hypothesis on S or T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf_tensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095I.** Let `X` be a scheme and `Λ` a Noetherian ring. The tensor product of two
constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf_tensor (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    (Λ : Type (max (u + 1) w)) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf B X Λ F) (hG : IsConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf B X Λ G) :
    IsConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf B X Λ (F ⊗ G)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_tensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095I.** The tensor product of two constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the small
étale site of a scheme, for `Λ` a Noetherian ring, is a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_tensor (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    (Λ : Type (max (u + 1) w)) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    (F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ F) (hG : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ G) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (F ⊗ G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_affine_stratification_split_reduction
declarations.doc:
A finite locally free cover of each affine stratum splits the reduced pullback into
finitely many copies of the reduced covering scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finite_affine_stratification_split_reduction
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f]
    (hfp : FinitePresentation f) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (s : ∀ i, S i ⟶ X),
      (∀ i, IsAffine (S i) ∧ IsImmersion (s i) ∧
        IsLocallyClosed (Set.range (s i).base) ∧
        Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (s i).base)) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Set.range (s i).base) (Set.range (s j).base)) ∧
      (⋃ i, Set.range (s i).base) = Set.univ ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S i),
        Surjective g ∧ Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree g ∧
        ∃ (m : ℕ)
          (q : (pullback f (g ≫ s i)).nilradical.subscheme ⟶
            S'.nilradical.subscheme)
          (e : (pullback f (g ≫ s i)).nilradical.subscheme ≅
            ∐ (fun _ : Fin m ↦ S'.nilradical.subscheme)),
          q ≫ S'.nilradical.subschemeι =
              (pullback f (g ≫ s i)).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
                pullback.snd f (g ≫ s i) ∧
          e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin m ↦ 𝟙 S'.nilradical.subscheme) = q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_surjective_affine_baseChange_thickening_finiteEtale
declarations.doc: After a surjective affine base change, the pullback contains a finite étale thickening.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_surjective_affine_baseChange_thickening_finiteEtale
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f]
    (hfp : FinitePresentation f) :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsAffine X') (g : X' ⟶ X),
      Surjective g ∧
      ∃ (Z' : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z' ⟶ pullback f g),
        Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening i ∧
        IsFinite (i ≫ pullback.snd f g) ∧
        Etale (i ≫ pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.openClosedShortComplex
declarations.doc:
The short complex `j_! j^{-1} F ⟶ F ⟶ i_* i^{-1} F` built from the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` and
the unit of `i^{-1} ⊣ i_*`, for a closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X` and the open immersion `j : U ⟶ X`
of its complement.
declarations.statement:
def openClosedShortComplex :
    ShortComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.openClosedShortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc:
For a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` and the open immersion `j : U ⟶ X` of its complement, the
short complex `0 ⟶ j_! j^{-1} F ⟶ F ⟶ i_* i^{-1} F ⟶ 0` is short exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem openClosedShortComplex_shortExact :
    (openClosedShortComplex.{u, v} i j hij F).ShortExact

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.shortExact_etaleModuleExtensionByZero_directImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 095L** for module coefficients.  Let `X` be a scheme, let `i : Z ⟶ X`
be a closed immersion and let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion whose image is the complement of
the image of `i`, and let `Λ` be a ring.  For every sheaf `ℱ` of `Λ`-modules on the small étale
site of `X` the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` and the unit of `i^{-1} ⊣ i_*` form a short exact
sequence
`0 → j_! j^{-1} ℱ → ℱ → i_* i^{-1} ℱ → 0`
of sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExact_etaleModuleExtensionByZero_directImage (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
    {Z U X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ) (F : EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X) :
    ∃ h : (etaleModuleExtensionByZeroAdj.{u, r} Λ j).counit.app F ≫
        (etaleModuleInverseImageAdj.{u, r} Λ i).unit.app F = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk ((etaleModuleExtensionByZeroAdj.{u, r} Λ j).counit.app F)
        ((etaleModuleInverseImageAdj.{u, r} Λ i).unit.app F) h).ShortExact

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.shortExact_extensionByZero_etaleAbelianDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 095L.** Let `X` be a scheme, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and
let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion whose image is the complement of the image of `i`.  For
every abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X` the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` and the unit
of `i^{-1} ⊣ i_*` form a short exact sequence
`0 → j_! j^{-1} F → F → i_* i^{-1} F → 0`
of abelian sheaves on `X_étale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExact_extensionByZero_etaleAbelianDirectImage {Z U X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    ∃ h : (extensionByZeroAdj.{u, v} j).counit.app F ≫
        (etaleAbelianInverseImageDirectImageAdj.{u, v} i).unit.app F = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk ((extensionByZeroAdj.{u, v} j).counit.app F)
        ((etaleAbelianInverseImageDirectImageAdj.{u, v} i).unit.app F) h).ShortExact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095N, the quasi-compact quasi-separated presentation.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme and `Λ` a Noetherian ring. A sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is
constructible exactly when it is the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of extensions by
zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves at quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects of
`X_étale`.

The hypotheses `hshriek` and `hgen` are carried; see the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteShriekPresentation
    [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    (hshriek : ∀ U : SmallEtale B X.1 X.property,
      CompactSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj U) →
      QuasiSeparatedSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj U) →
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R U))
    (hgen : ∀ G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R),
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R G →
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → SmallEtale B X.1 X.property),
          (∀ i, CompactSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj (U i)) ∧
            QuasiSeparatedSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj (U i))) ∧
          ∃ p : (∐ fun i => moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R (U i)) ⟶ G, Epi p)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F ↔
      HasFiniteShriekPresentation.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R
        (fun W ↦ CompactSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj W) ∧
          QuasiSeparatedSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj W)) F
declarations.comment: quasi-compact quasi-separated presentation, carrying as explicit hypotheses the sheaves-of-modules case of Stacks 03S8 (hshriek), that an extension by zero of a constant free rank-one module sheaf is constructible, and the finite generation step of the proof (hgen), that a constructible sheaf of modules is a quotient of a finite direct sum of such sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_affineShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095N, the affine presentation.** The étale objects of the presentation may be taken
affine: a sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is constructible exactly when it is the cokernel of a
map between finite direct sums of extensions by zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves at
affine objects of `X_étale`.

The hypotheses `hshriek` and `hgen` are carried; see the module documentation. The refinement of a
covering sieve of `X_étale` by a finite family with affine sources, which is what makes the affine
form of `hgen` reachable, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_finite_affine_refinement_of_mem_topology`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_affineShriekPresentation
    [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    (hshriek : ∀ U : SmallEtale B X.1 X.property, SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.1 X.property U →
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R U))
    (hgen : ∀ G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R),
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R G →
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → SmallEtale B X.1 X.property),
          (∀ i, SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.1 X.property (U i)) ∧
          ∃ p : (∐ fun i => moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R (U i)) ⟶ G, Epi p)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F ↔
      HasFiniteShriekPresentation.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R
        (SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.1 X.property) F
declarations.comment: affine presentation, carrying as explicit hypotheses the sheaves-of-modules case of Stacks 03S8 at affine objects (hshriek) and the finite generation step of the proof by affine objects (hgen)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_qcqsShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095N, the quasi-compact quasi-separated presentation.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme and `Λ` a Noetherian ring. A sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is
constructible exactly when it is the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of extensions by
zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves at quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects of
`X_étale`.

Nothing is granted. The two inputs of
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteShriekPresentation` are discharged:
constructibility of the generators is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriekConstant` (Stacks 03S8 for modules) and
the finite generation step of the proof is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_epi_sigma_moduleShriekConstant_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_qcqsShriekPresentation
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ F ↔
      HasFiniteShriekPresentation.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X Λ
        (fun W ↦ CompactSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj W) ∧
          QuasiSeparatedSpace ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.1 X.property).obj W)) F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteAffineShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095N, the affine presentation.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme and `Λ` a Noetherian ring. A sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is constructible exactly
when it is the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of extensions by zero of constant free
rank-one module sheaves at *affine* objects of `X_étale`.

Nothing is granted: this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_affineShriekPresentation_of_gen` with its
hypothesis discharged by the affine form of the finite generation step proved just above.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteAffineShriekPresentation
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ F ↔
      HasFiniteShriekPresentation.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X Λ
        (SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.1 X.property) F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_affineShriekPresentation_of_gen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095N, the affine presentation, with `hshriek` discharged.** Let `X` be a
quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and `Λ` a Noetherian ring. A sheaf of `Λ`-modules on
`X_étale` is constructible exactly when it is the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of
extensions by zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves at affine objects of `X_étale`.

Only the finite generation step `hgen` of the proof remains as a hypothesis; constructibility of
the generators is `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriekConstant`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_affineShriekPresentation_of_gen
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (hgen : ∀ G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R),
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R G →
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → SmallEtale B X.obj X.property),
          (∀ i, SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.obj X.property (U i)) ∧
          ∃ p : (∐ fun i ↦ moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R (U i)) ⟶ G, Epi p)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F ↔
      HasFiniteShriekPresentation.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R
        (SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.obj X.property) F
declarations.comment: affine presentation, carrying as the only explicit hypothesis the finite generation step of the proof (hgen), that a constructible sheaf of modules is a quotient of a finite direct sum of extensions by zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_colimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095P, part (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`F = colim_{i ∈ I} F_i` be a filtered colimit of abelian sheaves on `X_étale`. If `F` and all the
`F_i` are constructible, then the ind-object `F_i` is essentially constant with value `F`.

Nothing is assumed. Abelian groups are `ULift ℤ`-modules, a ring which is Noetherian and lives in
the coefficient universe, so the system is carried to one of sheaves of modules by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_uliftIntEquivalence`, part (3) of the tag applies to
it with nothing assumed, and the witness is brought back along the equivalence of sheaf
categories, which preserves the colimit and is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_colimit
    (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    {I : Type v} [Category.{v'} I] [IsFiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : Cocone F) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (F.obj i))
    (hcolim : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X t.pt) :
    ∃ (i : I) (r : t.pt ⟶ F.obj i),
      EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith F t i r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_colimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095P, part (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`F = colim_{i ∈ I} F_i` be a filtered colimit of abelian sheaves on `X_étale`. If `F` and all the
`F_i` are constructible, then the ind-object `F_i` is essentially constant with value `F`.

Nothing beyond the instance hypotheses is assumed: the input of the sheaves-of-abelian-groups case
of Stacks 09Z4, Stacks 095N for `ℤ`-modules, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasFiniteShriekPresentation_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_int`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_colimit
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.1 S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.1 S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ)]
    {I : Type v} [Category.{v'} I] [IsFiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : Cocone F) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (F.obj i))
    (hcolim : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X t.pt) :
    ∃ (i : I) (r : t.pt ⟶ F.obj i),
      EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith F t i r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_colimit
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a
Noetherian ring, and let `F = colim_{i ∈ I} F_i` be a filtered colimit of sheaves of `Λ`-modules
on `X_étale`. If `F` and all the `F_i` are constructible, then the ind-object `F_i` is essentially
constant with value `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_colimit
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.1 S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)]
    {I : Type v} [Category.{v'} I] [IsFiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (t : Cocone F) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (F.obj i))
    (hcolim : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R t.pt) :
    ∃ (i : I) (r : t.pt ⟶ F.obj i),
      EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith F t i r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf_colimit
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let `F = colim_{i ∈ I} F_i` be a
filtered colimit of sheaves of sets on `X_étale`. If `F` and all the `F_i` are constructible, then
the ind-object `F_i` is essentially constant with value `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf_colimit

    {I : Type v} [Category.{v'} I] [IsFiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : Cocone F) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X (F.obj i))
    (hcolim : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X t.pt) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_colimit'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095P, part (3), for a coefficient ring in any universe.** A filtered colimit of
constructible sheaves of `R`-modules whose value is constructible is essentially constant as an
ind-object.

The cocone is carried to `Shrink.{u + 1} R`-modules by the equivalence of sheaf categories,
which preserves the colimit, and the witness found there is brought back by
`CategoryTheory.EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith.of_equivalence`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_colimit'
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    {I : Type v} [Category.{v₀} I] [IsFiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (t : Cocone F) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (F.obj i))
    (hcolim : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R t.pt) :
    ∃ (i : I) (r : t.pt ⟶ F.obj i),
      EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith F t i r
declarations.comment: part (3), for a Noetherian coefficient ring in any universe

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Q, part (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective morphism of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on `Y_étale` — arbitrary, with no torsion
assumption. Then `ℱ` is constructible if and only if `f⁻¹ℱ` is constructible.

The forward implication is Stacks 095G, `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_pullback`,
and needs neither surjectivity of `f` nor quasi-compactness. The converse is carried out in the
category of sheaves of `ℤ`-modules, where Stacks 095Q is already unconditional:
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective`. Only the
quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `X` and `Y`, which the source's statement assumes,
are hypotheses.

The passage between the two categories is the one place with content. Going out is immediate,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleCatIntEquivalence`, a finite abelian group
being a finitely generated `ℤ`-module; the module development is pinned to a Noetherian ring in
`Type (u + 1)`, so the descent happens at `ULift ℤ` and is transported back by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_int_of_uliftIntRestrictScalars`. Coming back is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_int`, which needs
`ℱ` to be torsion — and that is exactly what the constructibility of `f⁻¹ℱ` supplies, through the
stalk criterion `AlgebraicGeometry.torsionSheafProperty_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pullback`.
Stacks 093C for torsion abelian sheaves is not used: the module form of Stacks 093C, which the
library proves, is what the descent above consumes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective
    (hf : Function.Surjective (B.inclusion.map f).base)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B Y F ↔
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X ((smallEtaleAbelianPullbackFunctor B f).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective_general
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes and let
`ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on `Y_étale`, with no torsion assumption. Then `ℱ` is constructible if and
only if `f⁻¹ℱ` is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective_general
    (hf : Function.Surjective (B.inclusion.map f).base)
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B Y 𝓕 ↔
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X ((smallEtaleAbelianPullbackFunctor B f).obj 𝓕)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Q for sheaves of modules.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective morphism of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, `Λ` a Noetherian ring and `ℱ` a sheaf of `Λ`-modules on
`Y_étale`. Then `ℱ` is constructible if and only if `f⁻¹ℱ` is constructible.

The forward implication is Stacks 095G, `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback`,
and needs neither surjectivity of `f` nor quasi-compactness. The converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback`.

Nothing is granted. The two statements of the source that were once hypotheses here are both
proved in the library, and both are supplied from `hXc`, `hXq`, `hYc` and `hYq`, the
quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `X` and `Y` that the source's statement assumes:
Stacks 095N on the quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes of `B`, from the unconditional
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_qcqsShriekPresentation`, and Stacks 093C (2) on
`Y`, from `AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfPresentations`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pullback_iff_of_surjective
    (hf : Function.Surjective (B.inclusion.map f).base)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.1 Y.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y Λ F ↔
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ ((smallEtaleModulePullbackFunctor B Λ f).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_pullback_iff_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Q, part (1).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective morphism of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes and let `ℱ` be a sheaf of sets on `Y_étale`. Then `ℱ` is constructible
if and only if `f⁻¹ℱ` is constructible.

Nothing is assumed. The forward implication is Stacks 095G,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_pullback`, and needs neither surjectivity of `f`
nor quasi-compactness. The converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf_pullback`, whose Stacks 09Y9
is supplied from
`isConstructibleSetSheaf_iff_hasFiniteQCSRepresentableCoequalizerPresentation_unconditional`,
which assumes nothing beyond quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `X` and does not use
Stacks 0245. Both hypotheses of the library's Stacks 03SA (1) are discharged as described above.

Parts (2) and (3) of the tag are not proved here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_pullback_iff_unconditional
    (hf : Function.Surjective (B.inclusion.map f).base)
    (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj) (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (hYc : CompactSpace Y.obj) (hYq : QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) (Type (u + 1))) :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B Y F ↔
      IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X ((smallEtaleSetPullback B f).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095R for sheaves of sets.** Let `p : T ⟶ S` be a finite morphism of finite
presentation of a big étale site and let `ℱ` be a constructible sheaf of sets on `T_étale`. Then
`p_*ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of sets on `S_étale`. No hypothesis is imposed on `S` or `T`.

By Stacks 095F constructibility may be checked on the covering of `S` by its affine opens, and
over an affine open `U` the restriction of `p_*ℱ` is the direct image of the restriction of `ℱ`
along the base change of `p` to `U`, which is again finite and of finite presentation; there the
source's reduction applies: base change along the surjection of Stacks 095K (1) (Stacks 095Q (1)
and 0959), replace the pullback by its finite étale thickening (the unit of a finite universal
homeomorphism is an isomorphism), and conclude by Stacks 095H.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite {T S : B.Scheme} (p : T ⟶ S)
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map p)] (hfp : FinitePresentation (B.inclusion.map p))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B T F) :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B S ((B.smallPushforward p (Type (u + 1))).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 095R], abelian sheaves.** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a finite and finitely presented
morphism of a big étale site. If `ℱ` is a constructible abelian sheaf on `T_étale`, then `f_*ℱ`
is a constructible abelian sheaf on `S_étale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_finitePresentation {T S : B.Scheme}
    (f : T ⟶ S) [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] (hfp : FinitePresentation (B.inclusion.map f))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B T F) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B S ((B.smallPushforward f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 095R], sheaves of modules.** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a finite and finitely
presented morphism of a big étale site and let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring. If `ℱ` is a
constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `T_étale`, then `f_*ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of
`Λ`-modules on `S_étale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_finitePresentation {T S : B.Scheme}
    (f : T ⟶ S) [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] (hfp : FinitePresentation (B.inclusion.map f))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B T Λ F) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B S Λ ((B.smallPushforward f (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_of_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095R for sheaves of sets and a finite universal homeomorphism.** Let `p : T ⟶ S` be a
finite morphism of a big étale site which is in addition a universal homeomorphism, and let `ℱ`
be a constructible sheaf of sets on `T_étale`. Then `p_*ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of sets on
`S_étale`. No hypothesis is imposed on `S` or `T`, and no finite presentation of `p` is needed.

By Stacks 095F constructibility may be checked on the covering of `S` by its affine opens, and
over an affine open `U` the restriction of `p_*ℱ` is the direct image of the restriction of `ℱ`
along the base change of `p` to `U`, which is again finite and a universal homeomorphism; the
source of that base change is finite over the affine `U`, hence affine, so both are quasi-compact
and quasi-separated and
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_of_universalHomeomorphism_of_compactSpace`
applies.

Stacks 095Q (1) is carried as the hypothesis `h095Q`, exactly as in that theorem; it quantifies
over all morphisms of the site, so the Zariski reduction does not add to what is granted.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_pushforward_of_universalHomeomorphism
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map p)] [UniversalHomeomorphism (B.inclusion.map p)]
    (h095Q : SetConstructibilityDescendsAlongSurjective B)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B T F) :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B S ((B.smallPushforward p (Type (u + 1))).obj F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets, and only the case of a finite universal homeomorphism — equivalently of a finite, surjective and universally injective morphism; the finite presentation of the tag's hypothesis is not needed and is dropped. The general finite, finitely presented case is NOT proved: it needs the thickening reduction of Stacks 095K together with the equivalence of small étale topoi of Stacks 04DZ on the size-bounded site, which this library does not carry. Stacks 095Q (1)'s descent is granted as the only hypothesis, and nothing is assumed of S or T.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_directImage_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Finite direct image preserves constructibility.** Let `Λ : Type` be a Noetherian ring and
`f : X ⟶ Y` a finite morphism of finite presentation of `B`. If `ℱ` is a constructible sheaf of
`Λ`-modules on Mathlib's small étale site of `X`, then `f_*ℱ` is constructible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_directImage_of_isFinite {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (B.inclusion.map f)]
    {F : EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj} (hF : IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ F) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ
      ((etaleModuleDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ (B.inclusion.map f)).obj F)
declarations.comment:
sheaves of Λ-modules, Λ a Noetherian ring in Type, on Mathlib's small étale site
(IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule); f finite and of finite presentation, no hypothesis on X or Y

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_etaleModuleDirectImage_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095R for sheaves of modules, in the model `EtaleModules`.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
finite morphism of finite presentation, `Λ` a Noetherian ring and `ℱ` a constructible sheaf of
`Λ`-modules on `X_étale`. Then `f_* ℱ` is constructible.

By Stacks 095F it suffices to work over the affine opens of `Y`, the direct image commuting with
restriction to an open by Stacks 0959. Over an affine `Y`, Stacks 095K (1) gives a
surjective affine `Y' ⟶ Y` and a thickening `Z' ⊆ Y' ×_Y X` with `Z' ⟶ Y'` finite étale; by
Stacks 095Q and 0959 it suffices to treat the base change, where the direct image is that along
the finite étale `Z' ⟶ Y'` of the inverse image to `Z'` (a thickening induces an equivalence of
small étale topoi), constructible by Stacks 095H.

The coefficient ring lives in `Type (u + 1)`, the universe of the library's Stacks 095Q and 095H
for sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_etaleModuleDirectImage_of_isFinite {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] (hfp : FinitePresentation f) (F : EtaleModules.{u, u + 1} Λ X)
    (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleModule Λ F) :
    IsConstructibleEtaleModule Λ ((etaleModuleDirectImage.{u, u + 1} Λ f).obj F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleAbelianSheaf_etaleAbelianDirectImage_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 095R], for sheaves of abelian groups.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite morphism
of finite presentation and `F` a constructible abelian sheaf on `X_étale`. Then `f_* F` is
constructible.

As a sheaf of `ULift ℤ`-modules, `F` is constructible, so `f_* F` is a constructible sheaf of
`ULift ℤ`-modules by the module case of the tag
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_etaleModuleDirectImage_of_isFinite`). It is
moreover torsion: `F` is torsion, being constructible
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.torsionSheafProperty_of_isConstructibleEtaleAbelianSheaf`), and the
direct image along the quasi-compact quasi-separated `f` of a torsion sheaf is torsion
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.torsionSheafProperty_smallEtaleDirectImageAb`, Tag 0DDD (1) in degree
zero). A constructible torsion sheaf of `ULift ℤ`-modules has constructible underlying abelian
sheaf. No torsion hypothesis is imposed on `F`.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isZero_rightDerived_etaleModuleDirectImage_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a ring and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an integral morphism of schemes. Then the higher
direct images of every sheaf of `Λ`-modules `F` on the small étale site of `X` vanish:
`R^q f_* F = 0` for every `q > 2 · 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_etaleModuleDirectImage_of_isIntegralHom (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] (F : EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : 2 * 0 < q) :
    IsZero (((etaleModuleDirectImage.{u, r} Λ f).rightDerived q).obj F)
declarations.comment:
the case n = 0: for an integral morphism — a finite one, for instance, which is
what a proper morphism with zero-dimensional fibres is — R^q f_* F = 0 for every q > 0 and every
sheaf of Λ-modules F, with no torsion hypothesis. The general bound 2n is NOT proved: its
induction needs the curve case, Tag 03SC, which is not formalized here.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ProperFibreDimension.isZero_rightDerived_etaleAbelianDirectImage_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 095U], its dévissage.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes — in
the source's sense, so `[IsProper f]` together with `[QuasiCompact f]`, Mathlib's `IsProper`
asking only for *locally* of finite type — all of whose fibres have dimension at most `n`. Then
for **any** abelian torsion sheaf `F` on `X_étale` and every `q > 2n`,

`R^q f_* F = 0`.

The case `n = 0` is proved outright: [Stacks, Tag 02LS] makes `f` finite, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isFinite_iff_isProper_and_forall_finite_preimage_singleton` fed with
`AlgebraicGeometry.finite_preimage_singleton_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le_zero`, finiteness
gives integrality, and the vanishing then comes from [Stacks, Tag 03QP] (2), already in this
library, through `hasEtaleDirectImageBound_zero_of_isIntegralHom`.

One input about `f` itself is assumed, and nothing else:

* `hdev` is the outcome of the source's dévissage for `f` when `n ≥ 1`: a factorisation
  `f = h ≫ g` in which `h` already satisfies the bound in dimension `n - 1` and `g`, the curve
  leg, satisfies the bound `2`. The bound for the curve leg is the conclusion of
  [Stacks, Tag 03SC] (through [Stacks, Tag 0DDF]); **Tag 03SC is deliberately not formalized
  here.** The existence of the factorisation is the
  geometry of the source's steps 5–7 (reduction, normalization, and the graph of a rational
  function in `X × P^1`), which is likewise unavailable here, and which is why it is a
  hypothesis about `f` rather than a statement proved for every proper `f`.

What the file proves is the step that turns that input into the bound: the Leray/composition
bound `hasEtaleDirectImageBound_comp`, and under it the purely homological
`isZero_rightDerived_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_etaleAbelianDirectImage_of_isProper
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [QuasiCompact f] (n : ℕ) (hdim : HasFibreDimLE f n)
    (hdev : 1 ≤ n → ∃ (C : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ C) (g : C ⟶ Y), f = h ≫ g ∧
      QuasiCompact h ∧ QuasiSeparated h ∧
      HasEtaleDirectImageBound h (2 * (n - 1)) ∧ HasEtaleDirectImageBound g 2)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 * n < q) :
    IsZero (((etaleAbelianDirectImage.{u, u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj F)
declarations.comment: the dévissage, with the curve input still open. PROVED: the tag's own conclusion, R^q f_* F = 0 for every q > 2n and every abelian TORSION sheaf F, for f proper in the source's sense (IsProper together with QuasiCompact, since Mathlib's IsProper asks only for locally of finite type) with every fibre of dimension at most n. The content proved outright is the Leray/composition step that makes the bounds add, 2(n-1) + 2 = 2n: that is hasEtaleDirectImageBound_comp, and under it isZero_rightDerived_comp, obtained from the Grothendieck spectral sequence of Tag 015N with no hypothesis beyond Tag 015M's acyclicity criterion. The base case n = 0 is proved outright as well: Tag 02LS, proved in this library by isFinite_iff_isProper_and_forall_finite_preimage_singleton together with finite_preimage_singleton_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le_zero, makes f finite and therefore integral, and Tag 03QP (2) then gives the vanishing. ASSUMED, about the given f and nothing more: hdev, for n >= 1, a factorisation f = h ≫ g in which h already has the bound 2(n-1) and the curve leg g has the bound 2 — the latter is the conclusion of Tag 03SC (via Tag 0DDF), and TAG 03SC IS OWNED BY ANOTHER ITEM OF THIS PROJECT and is deliberately NOT formalized here, while the existence of the factorisation is the geometry of the source's steps 5-7 (reduction, normalization, graph of a rational function in X x P^1), also not available in this repository. The general bound is therefore NOT proved unconditionally.

registrations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isZero_rightDerived_etaleAbelianDirectImage_of_isProper
registrations.comment: f proper (Mathlib's IsProper, which implies quasi-compact) with every fibre of topological Krull dimension at most n, F any abelian torsion sheaf on the small étale site of X: R^q f_* F = 0 for all q > 2n

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ConstructibleDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
The full subcategory of the unbounded derived category of small-étale
`Λ`-module sheaves with constructible cohomology sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev ConstructibleDerivedCategory (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.1 S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ConstructibleEtaleDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095W.** `D_c(X_ét, Λ)`: the full subcategory of the unbounded derived category of
sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the small étale site of `X` on the complexes all of whose cohomology
sheaves are constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev ConstructibleEtaleDerivedCategory (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
declarations.comment: the full subcategory of D(X_ét, Λ) of complexes whose cohomology sheaves are constructible, for module sections in any universe containing that of the schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_derivedRestriction
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring, let `X` be a scheme and let `U` be an object of the small étale
site of `X`. If a complex `K` of étale sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X` lies in `D_c(X_étale, Λ)`,
then its restriction `K|_U` lies in `D_c(U_étale, Λ)`.
