declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_derivedRestriction
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B U.obj.left Λ
      ((moduleRestriction.{u, r, max (u + 1) r} B X.obj X.property U
        Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_derivedModuleExtensionByZero
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring, let `X` be a scheme and let `U` be an object of the small étale
site of `X` whose structure morphism `j : U ⟶ X` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. If a complex
`M` of étale sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `U` lies in `D_c(U_étale, Λ)`, then `j_! M` lies in
`D_c(X_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_derivedModuleExtensionByZero
    (hqc : QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom))
    (hqs : QuasiSeparated (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hM : IsConstructible B U.obj.left Λ M) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ
      ((moduleExtensionByZero.{u, r} B X.obj X.property U Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_derivedPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Y.** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of schemes. If a
complex of étale sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `Y` lies in `D_c(Y_étale, Λ)`, that is has
constructible cohomology sheaves in every degree, then its derived inverse image `Lf^*K` lies in
`D_c(X_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_derivedPullback {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (g : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B Y Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_mapDerivedCategory_smallEtaleSheafPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Y.** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of schemes. If
`K ∈ D_c(Y_étale, Λ)`, that is the cohomology sheaves of `K` are constructible in every degree,
then `Lf^*K ∈ D_c(X_étale, Λ)`.

Inverse image of module sheaves is exact, so `Lf^*` is the termwise functor
`CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategory` and `Hⁱ(Lf^*K) ≅ f⁻¹(HⁱK)`, which is constructible by
Tag 095G; this is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_derivedPullback`, whose sheafification
and inverse-image instances are supplied by the small étale site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_mapDerivedCategory_smallEtaleSheafPullback {X Y : B.Scheme}
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B Y Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_shriekConstant_cover_of_isConstructible_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Z.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a
Noetherian ring, let `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` and let `b` be an integer for which `H^b(K)` is
constructible. Then there are finitely many affine objects `U i` of the small étale site of `X`
and a map `F[-b] ⟶ K`, where `F = ⊕ᵢ j_{U i!} Λ-underline`, inducing a surjection on degree-`b`
cohomology.

A complex `A` representing `K` is chosen;
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_epi_comp_sigma_moduleShriekConstant_affine` — Tags 093B and
095P in the shape the source's proof quotes them — covers the degree-`b` cocycles of `A` well
enough for the canonical surjection onto `H^b(K)` to survive, and
`Stacks.Homology.exists_single_map_epi_derivedHomology` turns that cover into the
required map in the derived category.

Nothing is granted; see "What the proof rests on" in the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_shriekConstant_cover_of_isConstructible_homology (X : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (g : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) (b : ℤ)
    (hK : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ
      ((homologyFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).obj K)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → SmallEtale B X.obj X.property),
      (∀ i, IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).obj (U i))) ∧
      ∃ f : (singleFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).obj
          (∐ fun i : Fin n ↦ moduleShriekConstant.{u, r, r} B X Λ (U i)) ⟶ K,
        Epi ((homologyFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).map f)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_shriekConstant_cover_of_isConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 095Z.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a
Noetherian ring, let `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` and let `b` be an integer such that `H^b(K)` is
constructible. Then there exist a sheaf `F = ⊕ᵢ j_{U i!} Λ-underline`, a finite direct sum with
every `U i` an affine object of `X_étale`, and a map `F[-b] ⟶ K` in `D(X_étale, Λ)` inducing a
surjection `F ⟶ H^b(K)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_shriekConstant_cover_of_isConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf (X : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) (b : ℤ)
    (hK : IsConstructibleModuleEtaleSheaf B X Λ
      ((homologyFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).obj K)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → SmallEtale B X.obj X.property),
      (∀ i, IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).obj (U i))) ∧
      ∃ f : (singleFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).obj
          (∐ fun i : Fin n ↦ moduleShriekConstant.{u, r, r} B X Λ (U i)) ⟶ K,
        Epi ((singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).inv.app
              (∐ fun i : Fin n ↦ moduleShriekConstant.{u, r, r} B X Λ (U i)) ≫
          (homologyFunctor (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) b).map f)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (3) ⟹ (1).** An object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a
bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules has constructible cohomology
sheaves.

A flat constructible sheaf is constructible, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_isConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf`, and a complex
of constructible sheaves has constructible cohomology, by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_forall_isConstructibleModuleSheaf`, which is where
the weak Serre hypothesis `hSerre` is used; see "Where the weak Serre property comes from" in the
module documentation for why it is still a hypothesis at a free coefficient universe, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.isWeakSerreClass_isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty` for what discharges it
at `max (u + 1) r`. The bound is not needed for this implication and is not used.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex
    (hSerre : (isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty.{u, w, r} B X Λ).IsWeakSerreClass)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, w, r} B X Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ K
declarations.comment: the implication (3) => (1), from the weak Serre property `hSerre` of the constructible sheaves of modules

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_shriekSum
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (2) ⟹ (3).** A bounded above complex whose terms are finite
direct sums of sheaves `j_{U!} Λ-underline` with `U` affine is a bounded above complex of flat
constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules, so an object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` satisfying condition (2)
satisfies condition (3).

The same complex is used; each term is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of affine shriek
constants, which is flat constructible by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf_sigma_moduleShriekConstant_of_quasiSeparated`,
and flat constructibility is invariant under isomorphism by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf_congr`. That input conjoins Tag 03S8 with the
flatness of `j_{U!} Λ-underline`, which the source leaves unstated, and the closure of flat
constructible sheaves under finite direct sums; see "Why quasi-separatedness is assumed" in the
module documentation for why it is the only hypothesis on `X` that enters. Quasi-compactness of
`X` is not needed for this implication and is not assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_shriekSum
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K) :
    IsRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (2) ⟹ (1).** An object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a
bounded above complex whose terms are finite direct sums of sheaves `j_{U!} Λ-underline` with
`U` affine has constructible cohomology sheaves, so it lies in the constructible derived
category of Tag 095W.

This is the composite of the implications (2) ⟹ (3) and (3) ⟹ (1), and nothing is carried. The
weak Serre property the second step needs is at this coefficient universe Stacks 03RZ (3),
`AlgebraicGeometry.isWeakSerreClass_isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty`; the flat
constructibility of a finite affine shriek sum which the first step needs is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf_sigma_moduleShriekConstant_of_quasiSeparated`,
and that is the only reason `X` is asked to be quasi-separated. Quasi-compactness of `X` is not
needed and is not assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_isConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (1) ⟹ (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme, let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `K ∈ D^-(X_étale, Λ)` have constructible cohomology
sheaves. Then `K` is represented by a bounded above complex each of whose terms is a finite
direct sum of sheaves `j_{U!} Λ-underline` with `U` an affine object of the small étale site
of `X`.

Boundedness above of `K` is the vanishing `hvan` of `H^i(K)` for `i > b`, which by
`DerivedCategory.isLE_iff` says exactly that `K` lies in `D^-(X_étale, Λ)`; it is the standing
assumption of the source's equivalence.

The proof chooses a cochain complex `A` with `A^i = 0` for `i > b` representing `K`
(`DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isLE`) and resolves it by the finite affine shriek sums
using `Stacks.Homology.BoundedAboveResolution.exists_quasiIso_isStrictlyLE_of_coversEpis`. The
three closure properties that engine needs of the class of finite affine shriek sums are
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isAffineShriekSum_zero`,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isAffineShriekSum_biprod` and
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isAffineShriekSum_of_iso`, and the covering property is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.coversEpis_isAffineShriekSum`, which rests on Stacks 093B (2) with
Stacks 095P and on Stacks 03S8 for sheaves of modules. The weak Serre class the engine tests its
kernels against is the constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules, Stacks 03RZ (3), supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isWeakSerreClass_isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty`. Nothing is carried.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_isConstructible
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K) (b : ℤ)
    (hvan : ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) i).obj K)) :
    IsRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_isConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (1) ⟹ (3).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme, let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `K ∈ D^-(X_étale, Λ)` have constructible cohomology
sheaves. Then `K` is represented by a bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves of
`Λ`-modules.

This is the composite of (1) ⟹ (2),
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_isConstructible`, with
(2) ⟹ (3),
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_shriekSum`. Both
steps are unconditional.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_isConstructible
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K) (b : ℤ)
    (hvan : ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) i).obj K)) :
    IsRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_constructibleFlat
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960, the implication (3) ⟹ (2).** An object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a
bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules is represented by a bounded
above complex each of whose terms is a finite direct sum of sheaves `j_{U!} Λ-underline` with
`U` an affine object of the small étale site of `X`.

This is the composite of (3) ⟹ (1),
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex`,
with (1) ⟹ (2),
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_isConstructible`. No
boundedness hypothesis on `K` is needed here: condition (3) exhibits a complex which vanishes
above some degree `a`, and `DerivedCategory.isLE_Q_obj_iff` transports that bound to `K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_constructibleFlat
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K) :
    IsRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0960.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a Noetherian
ring and let `K ∈ D^-(X_étale, Λ)`, the bound being the hypothesis `hvan`. Then the following
are equivalent:

1. `K` lies in `D_c(X_étale, Λ)`, i.e. every cohomology sheaf of `K` is constructible;
2. `K` is represented by a bounded above complex whose terms are finite direct sums of sheaves
   `j_{U!} Λ-underline` with `U` an affine object of the small étale site of `X`;
3. `K` is represented by a bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

The equivalence is closed along the cycle (1) ⟹ (2) ⟹ (3) ⟹ (1), by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex_of_isConstructible`,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex_of_shriekSum` and
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex`,
whose weak Serre hypothesis is discharged at this coefficient universe by Stacks 03RZ (3),
`AlgebraicGeometry.isWeakSerreClass_isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty`. The three remaining
implications are also stated separately, as the composites they are; `hvan` is used only in
(1) ⟹ (2), the other two steps producing their own bound.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_tfae
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) (b : ℤ)
    (hvan : ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) i).obj K)) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsConstructible B X Λ K,
        IsRepresentedByAffineShriekSumComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K,
        IsRepresentedByBoundedAboveConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K]

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.minus_and_isConstructible_derivedTensor_of_arbitraryScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0961.** Let `X` be a scheme, `Λ` a Noetherian ring and `K, L ∈ D_c^-(X_étale, Λ)`.
Then `K ⊗_Λ^L L` is in `D_c^-(X_étale, Λ)`: it is bounded above, and all of its cohomology
sheaves are constructible.

Nothing is asked of the scheme, and no part of the conclusion is assumed. The only thing asked of
the derived tensor product `T` is `hcomp`, which says that `T` *is* the derived tensor product:
its value on a pair of complexes whose right member is a bounded above complex of flat sheaves is
the total tensor complex. Both halves of the conclusion come from one complex `Tot(P ⊗_Λ G)`,
where `P` and `G` are the bounded above representatives with flat étale stalks of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isStrictlyLE_flat_etaleModuleStalk_of_isLE` — boundedness above with
the bound `a + b`, and constructibility of the cohomology sheaves by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_homology_mapBifunctor`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem minus_and_isConstructible_derivedTensor_of_arbitraryScheme
    (hcomp : IsDerivedTensorOnFlatComplexes.{u, w} B X Λ T)
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K.obj) (hL : IsConstructible B X Λ L.obj) :
    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t (C := Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ))).minus ((T.obj K.obj).obj L.obj) ∧
      IsConstructible B X Λ ((T.obj K.obj).obj L.obj)
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary scheme: both halves of the conclusion, the boundedness estimate for the derived tensor product and the constructible case alike, from the bounded above representative with flat etale stalks of Stacks 05T7 and 093B (2), the quasi-compact quasi-separated case of Stacks 0960 and 095I, and Zariski descent for constructibility, Stacks 095F

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.minus_and_isConstructible_etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0961.** Let `X` be a scheme, `Λ` a Noetherian ring and `K, L ∈ D_c^-(X_étale, Λ)`.
Then `K ⊗_Λ^L L` is in `D_c^-(X_étale, Λ)`: it is bounded above, and all of its cohomology
sheaves are constructible.

The derived tensor product is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor`, the
derived functor of the tensor product of sheaves of `Λ`-modules on K-flat resolutions, and
nothing is assumed of it or of `X`. That it is computed by the total tensor complex on a bounded
above complex of flat sheaves is proved,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isDerivedTensorOnFlatComplexes_etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor`, and the
rest is the arbitrary-scheme argument of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.minus_and_isConstructible_derivedTensor_of_arbitraryScheme`.
declarations.statement:
theorem minus_and_isConstructible_etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor (X : B.Scheme)
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K.obj) (hL : IsConstructible B X Λ L.obj) :
    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t (C := Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) w} Λ))).minus
        (((etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor B X Λ).obj K.obj).obj L.obj) ∧
      IsConstructible B X Λ (((etaleModuleSheafDerivedTensor B X Λ).obj K.obj).obj L.obj)
declarations.comment: for the derived tensor product of sheaves of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of an arbitrary scheme, built on K-flat resolutions (Stacks 06YS, 06YU) and shown to be computed by total tensor complexes on bounded above complexes of flat sheaves (Stacks 06YQ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleFiniteTor_derivedRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0962, part (1).** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `j : U ⟶ X` be an étale
morphism of schemes, the object `U` of the small étale site of `X`. If `K` lies in
`D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`, then its restriction `K|_U`, the image of `K` under the derived functor of
the restriction functor of Tag 03S3, lies in `D_ctf(U_étale, Λ)`.

This is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryRestriction`, whose output
is `K|_U` by construction: constructibility by Tag 095X part (1), and locally finite Tor
dimension by the finite-Tor-dimension half of Tag 0963 at the structure morphism of `U`,
transported along Tag 03S3 part (3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteTor_derivedRestriction
    (T : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over V))
    (T' : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).over V))
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructibleFiniteTor.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T K) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteTor.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B U.obj.left Λ T'
      ((moduleRestriction.{u, r, max (u + 1) r} B X.obj X.property U Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        K)
declarations.comment: part (1): for K in D_ctf(X_et, Λ), the restriction K|_U — the image of K under the derived restriction functor of Tag 03S3 — satisfies membership of D_ctf(U_et, Λ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleFiniteTor_derivedExtensionByZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0962, part (2).** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `j : U ⟶ X` be an étale
morphism of schemes, the object `U` of the small étale site of `X`, which is quasi-compact and
quasi-separated. If `M` lies in `D_ctf(U_étale, Λ)`, then its extension by zero `j_! M`, the
image of `M` under the derived functor of the extension-by-zero functor of Tag 03S3, lies in
`D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`.

This is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryExtensionByZero`, whose
output is `j_! M` by construction: constructibility by Tag 095X part (2), and locally finite Tor
dimension read at the stalks by Tag 03S5 and Tag 0DJJ.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteTor_derivedExtensionByZero
    (hqc : QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom))
    (hqs : QuasiSeparated (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom))
    (T : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over V))
    (T' : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).over V))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hM : IsConstructibleFiniteTor.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B U.obj.left Λ T' M) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteTor.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T
      ((moduleExtensionByZero.{u, r} B X.obj X.property U Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
declarations.comment: part (2): for j quasi-compact and quasi-separated and M in D_ctf(U_et, Λ), the extension by zero j_! M — the image of M under the derived extension-by-zero functor of Tag 03S3 — satisfies membership of D_ctf(X_et, Λ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0962.** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `j : U ⟶ X` be an étale morphism of
schemes, that is an object `U` of the small étale site of `X`. Then

1. the restriction `K|_U` of an object `K` of `D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)` is an object of
   `D_ctf(U_étale, Λ)`, and
2. the extension by zero `j_! M` of an object `M` of `D_ctf(U_étale, Λ)` is an object of
   `D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`, when `j` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

The two clauses are the two components of the pair; the quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness of `j`, which the source asks for in part (2) only, are hypotheses of the
second component alone. The first component is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryRestriction` and the second
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryExtensionByZero`.
declarations.statement:
public def constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryEtale
    (T : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over V))
    (T' : ∀ V : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B U.obj.left Λ).over V)) :
    (ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T →
        ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B U.obj.left Λ T') ×
      (QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom) →
        QuasiSeparated (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom) →
        ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B U.obj.left Λ T' →
        ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T)
declarations.comment: both parts, in the two components of the pair: part (1) with `K|_U` the restriction of Tag 03S3, part (2) with the quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `j` as the premises of that component. The constructible-cohomology halves are the two parts of Tag 095X; the finite-Tor-dimension half of part (1) is that of Tag 0963 at the structure morphism of `U`, and that of part (2) is read at the stalks, by Tag 03S5 for sheaves of modules and Tag 0DJJ on the slices over affine objects, over which `U ×_X V'` is quasi-compact

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryPullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0963.** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of schemes. The
derived inverse image of an object of `D_{ctf}(Y_étale, Λ)` is an object of
`D_{ctf}(X_étale, Λ)`.

Constructibility of the cohomology sheaves of `Lf^*K` is Tag 095Y, which is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleDerivedCategoryPullback`. Locally finite Tor dimension of
its image under the change of coefficients is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.pullbackPreservesLocallyFiniteTorDimension`.

`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryPullback` is the same statement
taking the finite-Tor-dimension half as a hypothesis, which this one discharges.
declarations.statement:
public def constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryPullback_unconditional
    (T : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) w, r} B Y Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) w r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) w, r} B Y Λ).over U))
    (T' : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) w, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) w r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) w, r} B X Λ).over U))
    (K : ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) w, r, d} B Y Λ T) :
    ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) w, r, d} B X Λ T'
declarations.comment: the constructible-cohomology half by Tag 095Y, the finite-Tor-dimension half by Tag 0DJJ read at the stalks on the slices of the constant coefficient ringed sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.clopen_refinement_iff_closedPoints_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0968.** For a spectral space, every open cover has a finite pairwise
disjoint clopen refinement if and only if the canonical map from its closed points to its
connected components is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem clopen_refinement_iff_closedPoints_bijective
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [SpectralSpace X] :
    (∀ {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Opens X), IsOpenCover U →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → Clopens X),
        (∀ j, ∃ i, (W j : Set X) ⊆ U i) ∧
        (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ j, (W j : Set X) ∧
        Pairwise (Disjoint on W)) ↔
    Function.Bijective (fun x : closedPoints X => (x.1 : ConnectedComponents X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_finite_disjoint_clopen_refinement_of_unique_closed_specialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0968, unique-specialization refinement.** If the closed points of a spectral space
form a closed subset and every point specializes to a unique closed point, every open cover has a
finite refinement by pairwise-disjoint clopen subsets.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_disjoint_clopen_refinement_of_unique_closed_specialization
    {ι X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SpectralSpace X]
    (hclosed : IsClosed (closedPoints X))
    (hunique : ∀ x : X, ∃! x₀ : closedPoints X, Specializes x x₀.1)
    {U : ι → Opens X} (hU : IsOpenCover U) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → Clopens X),
      (∀ j, ∃ i, (W j : Set X) ⊆ U i) ∧
      (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ j, (W j : Set X) ∧
      Pairwise (Disjoint on W)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedPoints_to_connectedComponents_bijective_of_unique_specialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0968, unique-specialization refinement.** Under the same hypotheses, sending a
closed point to its connected component is a bijection from the closed points of `X` to
`π₀(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedPoints_to_connectedComponents_bijective_of_unique_specialization
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SpectralSpace X]
    (hclosed : IsClosed (closedPoints X))
    (hunique : ∀ x : X, ∃! x₀ : closedPoints X, Specializes x x₀.1) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun x₀ : closedPoints X ↦ ConnectedComponents.mk x₀.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.WLocalSpace
declarations.doc:
A spectral space is w-local if its closed points form a closed subset and every point has a
unique closed specialization. Existence of a closed specialization is automatic for spectral
spaces, so the class records its uniqueness.
declarations.statement: class WLocalSpace (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop extends SpectralSpace X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.IsWLocalMap
declarations.doc: A map is w-local if it is spectral and sends every closed point to a closed point.
declarations.statement:
structure IsWLocalMap {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) : Prop extends IsSpectralMap f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.wLocalSpace_of_isClosed
declarations.doc: A closed subspace of a w-local space is w-local.
declarations.statement:
theorem wLocalSpace_of_isClosed {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [WLocalSpace X]
    {Y : Set X} (hY : IsClosed Y) : WLocalSpace Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.spectralSpace_pullback
declarations.doc: A profinite base change of the component map of a spectral space is spectral.
declarations.statement:
instance spectralSpace_pullback (S : ProfiniteBaseChangeOfComponentMap) :
    SpectralSpace S.Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isHomeomorph_connectedComponentsLift_toT
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `π₀(Y) → T` induced by the pullback projection is a
homeomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomeomorph_connectedComponentsLift_toT
    (S : ProfiniteBaseChangeOfComponentMap.{u}) :
    IsHomeomorph S.toT.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsLift

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedPoints_pullback
declarations.doc:
Closed points in the profinite pullback of a w-local space are precisely those lying
over closed points of the original space.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedPoints_pullback (S : ProfiniteBaseChangeOfComponentMap.{u})
    [WLocalSpace S.X] :
    closedPoints S.Y = S.toX ⁻¹' closedPoints S.X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.wLocalSpace_pullback
declarations.doc: A profinite base change of the component map of a w-local space is w-local.
declarations.statement:
theorem wLocalSpace_pullback (S : ProfiniteBaseChangeOfComponentMap.{u})
    [WLocalSpace S.X] : WLocalSpace S.Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.toX_isWLocalMap
declarations.doc:
The projection to a w-local space from its profinite base change over the space of
connected components is a w-local map.
declarations.statement:
theorem toX_isWLocalMap (S : ProfiniteBaseChangeOfComponentMap.{u})
    [WLocalSpace S.X] : IsWLocalMap S.toX

declarations.name: Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings
declarations.doc:
An algebra *identifies local rings* if for every prime `q` of the target the canonical map
from the localization of the source at the preimage of `q` to the localization of the target at
`q` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IdentifiesLocalRings (R S : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] :
    Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.identifiesLocalRings_tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096F.** Base change preserves the property of identifying local
rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem identifiesLocalRings_tensorProduct
    (A B A' : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A A']
    (h : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B) :
    Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A' (A' ⊗[A] B)

registrations.name: Algebra.IsLocalIso.instTensorProduct
registrations.comment: local_isomorphism_base_change

declarations.name: Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings.trans
declarations.doc: If `R → S` and `S → T` identify local rings, then so does `R → T`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isLocalIso_of_left_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096H.** If the base-to-middle and base-to-top maps of an algebra
tower are local isomorphisms, then so is the middle-to-top map.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalIso_of_left_of_comp
    (A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] [CommSemiring C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    [Algebra.IsLocalIso A B] [Algebra.IsLocalIso A C] :
    Algebra.IsLocalIso B C

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.identifiesLocalRings_of_left_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096H.** In an algebra tower, if the base-to-middle and base-to-top
maps identify local rings, then so does the middle-to-top map.
declarations.statement:
theorem identifiesLocalRings_of_left_of_comp
    (A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] [CommSemiring C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    (hAB : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B)
    (hAC : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A C) :
    Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings B C

declarations.name: Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings.of_isLocalIso
declarations.doc: A local isomorphism identifies local rings.
declarations.statement: public theorem of_isLocalIso [Algebra.IsLocalIso R S] : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings R S

declarations.name: Algebra.IsLocalIso.quasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**A local isomorphism is quasi-finite**: it is of finite type, every fibre ring
`κ(p) ⊗[A] B` is a finite `κ(p)`-module, and it is quasi-finite at every prime of `B`. All three
come from `Algebra.IsLocalIso.etale`, an étale algebra being of finite presentation and formally
unramified.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_fin_localization_away
declarations.doc:
A local isomorphism admits a finite cover by principal localizations that
are principal localizations of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fin_localization_away
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsLocalIso A B] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → B) (f : Fin n → A),
      Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (Localization.Away (g i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bijective_forgetToTop_morphism_over
declarations.doc:
If the structure sheaf of `Y` is the inverse image of that of `X`, then
forgetting the sheaf map bijects morphisms `Z ⟶ Y` over `X` with continuous
maps between the underlying spaces over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_forgetToTop_morphism_over
    {X Y Z : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ X) (q : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsIso (inverseImageStructureMap p)] :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun f : {f : Z ⟶ Y // f ≫ p = q} ↦
        (⟨f.1.base, congrArg (fun k : Z ⟶ X ↦ k.base) f.2⟩ :
          {g : Z.toTopCat ⟶ Y.toTopCat // g ≫ p.base = q.base}))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.existsUnique_algHom_of_specTopMap_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096L.** A continuous map of affine spectra over `Spec A` is uniquely
induced by an `A`-algebra homomorphism when the structural map of its target identifies local
rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_algHom_of_specTopMap_over
    (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C]
    (hB : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B)
    (g : Spec.topObj (CommRingCat.of C) ⟶ Spec.topObj (CommRingCat.of B))
    (hg : g ≫ Spec.topMap (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) =
      Spec.topMap (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C))) :
    ∃! f : B →ₐ[A] C, Spec.topMap (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) = g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.IsIndZariski
declarations.doc:
A commutative `A`-algebra is ind-Zariski if it is a filtered colimit of
`A`-algebras whose structure maps are local isomorphisms. The stages and the lifted
target lie in the maximum of the source and target carrier universes.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsIndZariski (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] : Prop

declarations.name: Algebra.IsIndZariski.tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
The base change of an ind-Zariski algebra map is ind-Zariski: if `B` is ind-Zariski over `A`
and `A'` is any `A`-algebra, then `B ⊗[A] A'` is ind-Zariski over `A'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsIndZariski.tensorProduct (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (A' : Type w) [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [CommRing A'] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A A'] (h : IsIndZariski A B) :
    IsIndZariski A' (B ⊗[A] A')

declarations.name: Algebra.IsIndZariski.comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 096Q.** If `B` is ind-Zariski over `A` and `C` is ind-Zariski over `B`, then `C` is
ind-Zariski over `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IsIndZariski.comp (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    (hAB : Algebra.IsIndZariski A B) (hBC : Algebra.IsIndZariski B C) :
    Algebra.IsIndZariski A C

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isIndZariski_of_left_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 096R.** Ind-Zariski maps cancel on the left in an algebra tower: if `B` and `C` are
ind-Zariski over `A`, then `C` is ind-Zariski over `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIndZariski_of_left_of_comp (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    (hAB : Algebra.IsIndZariski A B) (hAC : Algebra.IsIndZariski A C) :
    Algebra.IsIndZariski B C

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isIndZariski_of_colimitPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 096S.** A filtered colimit of ind-Zariski `A`-algebras is ind-Zariski over `A`: if
`B` is presented as the colimit of a filtered diagram of `A`-algebras each of which is ind-Zariski
over `A`, then `B` is ind-Zariski over `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIndZariski_of_colimitPresentation {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] {J : Type*} [Category* J] [IsFiltered J] [EssentiallySmall.{max u v} J]
    (pres : ColimitPresentation J (CommAlgCat.of A (ULift.{u} B)))
    (hpres : ∀ j, Algebra.IsIndZariski A (pres.diag.obj j)) :
    Algebra.IsIndZariski A B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.identifiesLocalRings_of_isIndZariski
declarations.doc: An ind-Zariski map identifies the local rings at every prime of its target.
declarations.statement:
theorem identifiesLocalRings_of_isIndZariski
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (h : IsIndZariski.{u, v, w} A B) :
    Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B

declarations.name: Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings.of_isIndZariski
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 096T.** An ind-Zariski algebra identifies local rings: for every prime `q` of `B`
the canonical map from the localization of `A` at the preimage of `q` to the localization of
`B` at `q` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings.of_isIndZariski {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (h : Algebra.IsIndZariski A B) :
    Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.existsUnique_ringHom_comp_algebraMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, the final assertion. A ring map `A → A'` carrying a subset
`Z' ⊆ Spec A'` into a subset `Z ⊆ Spec A` induces exactly one `A`-algebra map
`A_Z^~ → (A')_{Z'}^~`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_ringHom_comp_algebraMap {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
    {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)} {Z' : Set (PrimeSpectrum A')}
    (h : PrimeSpectrum.comap φ '' Z' ⊆ Z) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid Z) B] (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra A' B']
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid Z') B'] :
    ∃! ψ : B →+* B', ψ.comp (algebraMap A B) = (algebraMap A' B').comp φ
declarations.comment: functoriality: the unique induced algebra map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.range_comap_algebraMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, assertion (1). The spectrum of `A_Z^~` maps onto the set of
points of `Spec A` specializing to `Z = D(f) ∩ V(I)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_comap_algebraMap (f : A) (I : Ideal A) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid (basicLocallyClosed f I)) B] :
    Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)) =
      {p : PrimeSpectrum A | ∃ q ∈ basicLocallyClosed f I, p ⤳ q}
declarations.comment: part (1), the image of Spec of the localization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.homeomorphSetOfSpecializesTo
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, assertion (1) as the homeomorphism it asserts:
`Spec (A_Z^~)` is homeomorphic to the set of points of `Spec A` specializing to
`Z = D(f) ∩ V(I)`.
declarations.comment: part (1), the homeomorphism onto the set of specializations

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.nonvanishingSubmonoid_eq_of_basicLocallyClosed_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, assertion (2). The source's multiplicative set — the elements
whose image in `A/I` divides a power of the image of `f` — depends only on the underlying subset
`D(f) ∩ V(I)`, and so therefore does `A_Z^~`.
declarations.comment: part (2), dependence only on the underlying subset

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.algEquivOfBasicLocallyClosedEq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, assertion (2) as the statement about the algebra: the algebras
attached to two presentations of one locally closed subset are isomorphic as `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def algEquivOfBasicLocallyClosedEq {f f' : A} {I I' : Ideal A}
    (h : basicLocallyClosed f I = basicLocallyClosed f' I') (B B' : Type u) [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid (basicLocallyClosed f I)) B]
    [CommRing B'] [Algebra A B']
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid (basicLocallyClosed f' I')) B'] : B ≃ₐ[A] B'
declarations.comment: part (2), the algebra attached to the subset

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.basicLocallyClosed_eq_range_inter_zeroLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, the topological half of assertion (3). Inside the image of
`Spec (A_Z^~)` the subset `Z = D(f) ∩ V(I)` is cut out by `I` alone: a prime specializing into
`Z` and containing `I` already avoids `f`, so `Z` is closed in that image.
declarations.statement:
theorem basicLocallyClosed_eq_range_inter_zeroLocus (f : A) (I : Ideal A) (B : Type u)
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid (basicLocallyClosed f I)) B] :
    basicLocallyClosed f I =
      Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)
declarations.comment: part (3), Z is closed in the image of Spec of the localization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.surjective_quotientAwayLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096V**, assertion (3). The ring `A_Z^~` surjects onto
`Γ(Z, 𝒪_Z) = (A/I)_f`, so `Z` is a closed subscheme of `Spec (A_Z^~)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_quotientAwayLift (f : A) (I : Ideal A) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsLocalization (nonvanishingSubmonoid (basicLocallyClosed f I)) B] (C : Type u) [CommRing C]
    [Algebra (A ⧸ I) C] [IsLocalization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk I f) C] :
    Function.Surjective (quotientAwayLift f I B C)
declarations.comment: part (3), Z is a closed subscheme of Spec of the localization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localization_comap_range
declarations.doc:
The points of the localization are precisely those specializing to
`D(f) ∩ V(I)`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationSubmonoid_eq_of_locallyClosedPoints_eq
declarations.doc:
The selected multiplicative subset, hence the localized `A`-algebra, depends only on the
underlying locally closed subset.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizationSubmonoid_eq_of_locallyClosedPoints_eq
    (I J : Ideal A) (f g : A) (h : locallyClosedPoints I f = locallyClosedPoints J g) :
    localizationSubmonoid I f = localizationSubmonoid J g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationToCoordinateRing_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc: The locally closed subscheme is closed in the selected localization.
declarations.statement:
instance localizationToCoordinateRing_isClosedImmersion
    (I : Ideal A) (f : A) :
    IsClosedImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (localizationToCoordinateRing I f)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationSubmonoid_le_comap
declarations.doc:
A map taking `D(g) ∩ V(J)` into `D(f) ∩ V(I)` preserves the selected multiplicative
sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizationSubmonoid_le_comap
    (h : A →+* A') (I : Ideal A) (f : A) (J : Ideal A') (g : A')
    (hZ : ∀ q ∈ locallyClosedPoints J g,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap h q ∈ locallyClosedPoints I f) :
    localizationSubmonoid I f ≤ (localizationSubmonoid J g).comap h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationMap_unique
declarations.doc: The canonical map is the unique map of `A`-algebras extending `h`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizationMap_unique
    (h : A →+* A') (I : Ideal A) (f : A) (J : Ideal A') (g : A')
    (hZ : ∀ q ∈ locallyClosedPoints J g,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap h q ∈ locallyClosedPoints I f) :
    ∃! k : localizationRing I f →+* localizationRing J g,
      k.comp (algebraMap A (localizationRing I f)) =
        (algebraMap A' (localizationRing J g)).comp h

registrations.name: PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_isEmbedding
registrations.comment: part (1): embedding

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.basicStratum_eq_basicLocallyClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096W.** The stratum `Z(E', E'')` is the locally closed subset
`D(∏_{f ∈ E'} f) ∩ V(∑_{f ∈ E''} f A)`, hence of the shape to which Tag 096V applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem basicStratum_eq_basicLocallyClosed (E' E'' : Finset A) :
    basicStratum E' E'' = basicLocallyClosed (∏ g ∈ E', g) (Ideal.span (E'' : Set A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isConstructible_basicStratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096X**, the observation that each stratum is constructible: a stratum
is a finite intersection of basic opens and complements of basic opens.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructible_basicStratum (E' E'' : Finset A) :
    Topology.IsConstructible (basicStratum E' E'')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_mem_vanishingPatternStratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096X**, the covering half. Every point of `Spec A` lies in the stratum
of its own vanishing pattern on `E`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_vanishingPatternStratum (E : Finset A) (q : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    ∃ σ : A → Bool, q ∈ vanishingPatternStratum E σ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.vanishingPatternStratum_disjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096X**, the disjointness half. Two vanishing patterns differing on `E`
have disjoint strata.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_vanishingPatternStrata_refines
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 096Y.** Every finite constructible partition of an affine spectrum is
refined by the stratification according to the vanishing pattern of finitely many elements.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_vanishingPatternStrata_refines {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {P : Set (Set (PrimeSpectrum A))} (hP : Setoid.IsPartition P)
    (hP_finite : P.Finite) (hP_constructible : ∀ T ∈ P, Topology.IsConstructible T) :
    ∃ E : Finset A, local_Refines (vanishingPatternStrata E) P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationRing
declarations.doc:
The ring `A_E`, formed as the product of the localizations attached to all
vanishing-pattern strata of `Spec A`.
declarations.statement: abbrev stratificationRing (E : Finset A) : Type u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.specStratificationRingIso
declarations.doc:
The spectrum `X_E = Spec(A_E)` of the stratification ring is the coproduct of the spectra
`X_{E', E''} = Spec(A^~_{Z(E', E'')})` over all decompositions `E = E' ⨿ E''`.
declarations.statement:
def specStratificationRingIso (E : Finset A) :
    Spec (.of (stratificationRing E)) ≅
      ∐ fun E' : {E' : Finset A // E' ⊆ E} =>
        Spec (.of (localizationRing (stratumIdeal E E') (stratumOpenElement E'.val)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedStrata
declarations.doc: The coproduct `Z_E` of the coordinate schemes of all vanishing patterns.
declarations.statement: def closedStrata (E : Finset A) : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedStrataMap
declarations.doc: The canonical map from the coproduct of strata to `X_E`.
declarations.statement:
def closedStrataMap (E : Finset A) :
    closedStrata E ⟶ Spec (.of (stratificationRing E))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedStrataMap_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc: `Z_E` is a closed subscheme of `X_E`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedStrataMap_isClosedImmersion (E : Finset A) :
    IsClosedImmersion (closedStrataMap E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedPoints_mem_closedStrataMap_range
declarations.doc: Every closed point of `X_E` belongs to `Z_E`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedPoints_mem_closedStrataMap_range (E : Finset A)
    (x : Spec (.of (stratificationRing E))) (hx : IsClosed {x}) :
    x ∈ Set.range (closedStrataMap E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.locallyClosedPoints_restrictStratum
declarations.doc:
Restriction of a vanishing pattern carries its locally closed stratum
into the corresponding stratum for the smaller finite set.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyClosedPoints_restrictStratum (E₁ E₂ : Finset A)
    (h : E₁ ⊆ E₂) (i : {E' : Finset A // E' ⊆ E₂})
    (q : PrimeSpectrum A)
    (hq : q ∈ locallyClosedPoints
      (stratumIdeal E₂ i) (stratumOpenElement i.val)) :
    q ∈ locallyClosedPoints
      (stratumIdeal E₁ (restrictStratum E₁ E₂ h i))
      (stratumOpenElement (restrictStratum E₁ E₂ h i).val)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationRingMap
declarations.doc: The canonical transition map `A_{E₁} → A_{E₂}` for `E₁ ⊆ E₂`.
declarations.statement:
def stratificationRingMap (E₁ E₂ : Finset A) (h : E₁ ⊆ E₂) :
    stratificationRing E₁ →+* stratificationRing E₂

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationRingMap_comp_algebraMap
declarations.doc: The transition maps respect the structure maps from `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationRingMap_comp_algebraMap (E₁ E₂ : Finset A) (h : E₁ ⊆ E₂) :
    (stratificationRingMap E₁ E₂ h).comp (stratificationAlgebraMap E₁) =
      stratificationAlgebraMap E₂

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationRingMap_id
declarations.doc: The transition map for an identity inclusion is the identity.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationRingMap_id (E : Finset A) :
    stratificationRingMap E E (Finset.Subset.refl E) = RingHom.id _

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationRingMap_comp
declarations.doc: The transition maps compose for a chain of finite subsets.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationRingMap_comp (E₁ E₂ E₃ : Finset A)
    (h₁₂ : E₁ ⊆ E₂) (h₂₃ : E₂ ⊆ E₃) :
    (stratificationRingMap E₂ E₃ h₂₃).comp (stratificationRingMap E₁ E₂ h₁₂) =
      stratificationRingMap E₁ E₃ (h₁₂.trans h₂₃)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationSchemeMap
declarations.doc: The corresponding transition arrow `X_{E₂} → X_{E₁}`.
declarations.statement:
def stratificationSchemeMap (E₁ E₂ : Finset A) (h : E₁ ⊆ E₂) :
    Spec (.of (stratificationRing E₂)) ⟶ Spec (.of (stratificationRing E₁))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedStrataTransition
declarations.doc:
The transition arrow restricts to a morphism `Z_{E₂} → Z_{E₁}` of
closed subschemes, commuting with their inclusions into the affine schemes.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationColimitRing
declarations.doc:
The colimit of the rings attached to all finite vanishing stratifications
of `Spec A`, with the canonical transition maps for inclusion.
declarations.statement: abbrev stratificationColimitRing : Type u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationColimitMap_comp_algebraMap
declarations.doc: The structure map from `A` agrees with the map through any finite stage.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationColimitMap_comp_algebraMap (E : Finset A) :
    (stratificationColimitMap (A := A) E).comp (stratificationAlgebraMap E) =
      stratificationColimitAlgebraMap (A := A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0974.** The canonical closed subscheme `Z = lim Z_E` of
`X_w = Spec A_w = lim X_E`.
declarations.statement: def stratificationLimit : StratificationLimit A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationColimit_isIndZariski_and_faithfullyFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0975**, part (1): the canonical map `A → A_w` from a commutative ring to its
stratification colimit is ind-Zariski and faithfully flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationColimit_isIndZariski_and_faithfullyFlat :
    IsIndZariski.{u, u, u} A (stratificationColimitRing (A := A)) ∧
      (stratificationColimitAlgebraMap (A := A)).FaithfullyFlat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationLimit_closedScheme_bijective
declarations.doc: The limiting closed subscheme `Z` of `X_w` maps bijectively onto `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationLimit_closedScheme_bijective (L : StratificationLimit A) :
    Function.Bijective (L.inclusion ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (stratificationColimitAlgebraMap (A := A)))).base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bijective_stratificationLimitClosedScheme_toBase
declarations.doc:
The morphism `X_w → X` induces a bijection from the limiting closed subscheme `Z` onto
`X = Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_stratificationLimitClosedScheme_toBase :
    Function.Bijective (stratificationLimitInclusion (A := A) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (stratificationColimitAlgebraMap (A := A)))).base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.range_inclusion_eq_closedPoints
declarations.doc:
The limiting closed subscheme `Z` of `X_w` has as its underlying set exactly the closed
points of `X_w`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_inclusion_eq_closedPoints (L : StratificationLimit A) :
    Set.range L.inclusion.base = closedPoints (stratificationLimitScheme (A := A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.existsUnique_specializes_closedScheme
declarations.doc:
Every point of `X_w` specializes to exactly one point of its limiting closed subscheme
`Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_specializes_closedScheme (L : StratificationLimit A)
    (x : stratificationLimitScheme (A := A)) :
    ∃! z : L.closedScheme, x ⤳ L.inclusion.base z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationLimitScheme_wLocal
declarations.doc: The limiting scheme `X_w` of the finite vanishing stratifications of `Spec A` is w-local.
declarations.statement:
instance stratificationLimitScheme_wLocal :
    WLocalSpace (stratificationLimitScheme (A := A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.range_stratificationLimitInclusion_eq_closedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0975**, part (3): the limiting closed subscheme `Z` of `X_w` is exactly the set of
closed points of `X_w`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_stratificationLimitInclusion_eq_closedPoints :
    Set.range (stratificationLimitInclusion (A := A)).base =
      closedPoints (stratificationLimitScheme (A := A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.existsUnique_specializes_stratificationLimitClosedScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0975**, part (5): every point of `X_w` specializes to exactly one point of the
limiting closed subscheme `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_specializes_stratificationLimitClosedScheme
    (x : stratificationLimitScheme (A := A)) :
    ∃! z : stratificationLimitClosedScheme (A := A),
      x ⤳ (stratificationLimitInclusion (A := A)).base z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationLimit_closedScheme_isReduced
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0975**, part (4): the limiting closed subscheme `Z` of `X_w` is a reduced scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratificationLimit_closedScheme_isReduced (L : StratificationLimit A) :
    IsReduced L.closedScheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.stratificationLimitClosedScheme_isReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0975**, part (4): the limiting closed subscheme `Z` of `X_w` is a reduced
scheme.
declarations.statement:
instance stratificationLimitClosedScheme_isReduced :
    IsReduced (stratificationLimitClosedScheme (A := A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.mk_finset_le
declarations.doc:
Finite subsets of a type of size at most an infinite cardinal themselves
form a type of size at most that cardinal.
declarations.statement:
theorem mk_finset_le {A : Type u} (κ : Cardinal.{u})
    (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (hA : Cardinal.mk A ≤ κ) :
    Cardinal.mk (Finset A) ≤ κ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.mk_stratificationRing_le
declarations.doc: Each finite stratification ring `A_E` has cardinality at most `κ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mk_stratificationRing_le {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (hA : Cardinal.mk A ≤ κ)
    (E : Finset A) :
    Cardinal.mk (stratificationRing E) ≤ κ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.mk_stratificationColimitRing_le
declarations.doc:
The ring `A_w` has cardinality at most every infinite cardinal bounding
the cardinality of `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mk_stratificationColimitRing_le {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (hA : Cardinal.mk A ≤ κ) :
    Cardinal.mk (stratificationColimitRing (A := A)) ≤ κ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.existsUnique_wLocal_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0977.** A ring map `A → B` with `Spec B` w-local factors through `A → A_w` by
exactly one ring map `A_w → B` whose induced map of spectra is w-local.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_wLocal_lift
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) [WLocalSpace (Spec (.of B))] :
    ∃! g : stratificationColimitRing (A := A) →+* B,
      g.comp (stratificationColimitAlgebraMap (A := A)) = f ∧
        IsWLocalMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_fiberwise_incomparable
declarations.doc:
If the spectrum of `A` is profinite and distinct prime ideals of `B` lying over the same
prime ideal of `A` are incomparable, then the spectrum of `B` is profinite.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_fiberwise_incomparable
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hA : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (hfiber : ∀ q q' : Ideal B, q.IsPrime → q'.IsPrime →
      Ideal.comap f q = Ideal.comap f q' → q ≤ q' → q = q') :
    IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_quasiFinite
declarations.doc:
A quasi-finite algebra over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has profinite prime
spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_quasiFinite
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.QuasiFinite A B] (hA : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_unramified
declarations.doc:
An unramified algebra over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has profinite prime
spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_unramified
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.Unramified A B] (hA : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale algebra over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has profinite prime spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_etale
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.Etale A B] (hA : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_identifiesLocalRings'
declarations.doc:
A ring map identifying local rings preserves profiniteness of prime spectra.

This is the form for an arbitrary ring homomorphism between commutative rings in possibly
different universes.  The unprimed
`isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_identifiesLocalRings` is the form for an `Algebra`
instance in a single universe.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProfiniteStacks_primeSpectrum_of_identifiesLocalRings'
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hA : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (hf : letI := f.toAlgebra; Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B) :
    IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_isAlgebraic_residueField
declarations.doc:
A ring map inducing algebraic extensions on residue fields preserves profiniteness of
prime spectra.
declarations.statement:
theorem primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_isAlgebraic_residueField
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hA : CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (halg : ∀ q : Ideal B, ∀ [q.IsPrime],
      letI := (Ideal.ResidueField.map (q.comap f) q f rfl).toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic (q.comap f).ResidueField q.ResidueField) :
    CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_weaklyEtale
declarations.doc:
A weakly étale algebra over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has profinite prime
spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_weaklyEtale
    (A B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.WeaklyEtale A B]
    (hA : CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
    TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_identifiesLocalRings
declarations.doc:
An algebra identifying local rings over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has profinite
prime spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_identifiesLocalRings
    (A B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (hid : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B)
    (hA : CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_isLocalIso
declarations.doc:
A local isomorphism over a ring with profinite prime spectrum has target with profinite
prime spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_isLocalIso
    (A B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsLocalIso A B]
    (hA : CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum A) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_directLimit
declarations.doc:
A filtered colimit of rings with profinite prime spectra has profinite prime spectrum: here
the colimit is the direct limit of a directed system over a nonempty directed preorder, and the
ring `B` is presented as that colimit by a ring isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem primeSpectrum_isProfinite_of_directLimit
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (G : ι → Type*) [∀ i, CommRing (G i)] (f : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → G i →+* G j)
    [DirectedSystem G fun i j h => (f i j h : G i → G j)]
    (hG : ∀ i, CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum (G i)) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum (G i)) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum (G i)))
    (B : Type*) [CommRing B]
    (e : B ≃+* Ring.DirectLimit G fun i j h => (f i j h : G i → G j)) :
    CompactSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧ T2Space (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
      TotallyDisconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_isIndZariski_wLocal_of_isProfiniteStacks_zeroLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0979.** Let `A` be a ring and `I` an ideal whose closed subset `V(I) ⊆ Spec A` is a
profinite topological space. Then there is an ind-Zariski ring map `A → B` such that `Spec B` is
w-local, the set of its closed points is `V(I·B)`, and `A ⧸ I → B ⧸ I·B` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIndZariski_wLocal_of_isProfiniteStacks_zeroLocus (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : IsProfiniteStacks (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra A B),
      Algebra.IsIndZariski A B ∧ WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum B) ∧
        closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum B) =
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.map (algebraMap A B) : Set B) ∧
        Function.Bijective (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.closedPoints_of_mem_zeroLocus_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 097A, part (1).** Let `I` be an ideal of `A` whose zero locus is the set of closed
points of `Spec A`, and let `f : A →+* B` induce algebraic extensions of residue fields. Then
every prime of `B` containing the extended ideal `I B` is a closed point of `Spec B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedPoints_of_mem_zeroLocus_map
    {A : Type*} {B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A)
    (hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (halg : ∀ q : Ideal B, ∀ [q.IsPrime],
      letI := (Ideal.ResidueField.map (q.comap f) q f rfl).toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic (q.comap f).ResidueField q.ResidueField) :
    PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map f I : Set B) ⊆ closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_isIndZariski_wLocal_of_isAlgebraic_residueField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 097A, part (2).** Let `I` be an ideal of `A` whose zero locus is the set `X₀` of
closed points of `X = Spec A`, and let `f : A →+* B` induce algebraic extensions of residue
fields. Then there is an ind-Zariski ring map `B → C` such that `B ⧸ I·B → C ⧸ I·C` is an
isomorphism, the space `Y = Spec C` is w-local, the induced map `p : Y → X` is w-local, and
`p⁻¹(X₀)` is the set of closed points of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIndZariski_wLocal_of_isAlgebraic_residueField (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A)
    (hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (halg : ∀ q : Ideal B, ∀ [q.IsPrime],
      letI := (Ideal.ResidueField.map (q.comap f) q f rfl).toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic (q.comap f).ResidueField q.ResidueField) :
    ∃ (C : Type v) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra B C),
      Algebra.IsIndZariski B C ∧
        Function.Bijective (algebraMap (B ⧸ Ideal.map f I)
          (C ⧸ (Ideal.map f I).map (algebraMap B C))) ∧
        WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum C) ∧
        IsWLocalMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap ((algebraMap B C).comp f)) ∧
        closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum C) =
          PrimeSpectrum.comap ((algebraMap B C).comp f) ⁻¹' closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_surjective_indZariski_range_comap_eq_preimage_components
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 097C.** A closed union of connected components of an affine spectrum
is the spectrum of a surjective ind-Zariski algebra, homeomorphic to that union via
contraction.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjective_indZariski_range_comap_eq_preimage_components
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (T : Set (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum A))) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra A B),
      IsIndZariski.{u, u, u} A B ∧
      Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B) ∧
      IsEmbedding (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)) ∧
      Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)) =
        ((↑) : PrimeSpectrum A → ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum A)) ⁻¹' T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_indZariski_of_profinite_component_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 097D.** A profinite space over the connected components of an affine
spectrum is realized by the spectrum of an ind-Zariski algebra, with its canonical component
space and cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_indZariski_of_profinite_component_map
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (T : Type v) [TopologicalSpace T]
    (hT : IsProfiniteStacks T)
    (f : C(T, ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum A))) :
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra A B),
      IsIndZariski.{u, max u v, max u v} A B ∧
      ∃ g : C(PrimeSpectrum B, T),
      ∃ e : ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum B) ≃ₜ T,
        (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B, e (ConnectedComponents.mk p) = g p) ∧
        IsPullback
          (TopCat.ofHom (⟨fun p => ULift.up (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) p),
            continuous_uliftUp.comp (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap A B))⟩ :
              C(PrimeSpectrum B, ULift.{v} (PrimeSpectrum A))))
          (TopCat.ofHom (⟨fun p => ULift.up (g p), continuous_uliftUp.comp g.continuous⟩ :
            C(PrimeSpectrum B, ULift.{u} T)))
          (TopCat.ofHom (⟨fun p => ULift.up (ConnectedComponents.mk p.down),
            continuous_uliftUp.comp
              (ConnectedComponents.continuous_coe.comp continuous_uliftDown)⟩ :
                C(ULift.{v} (PrimeSpectrum A),
                  ULift.{v} (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum A)))))
          (TopCat.ofHom (⟨fun t => ULift.up (f t.down),
            continuous_uliftUp.comp (f.continuous.comp continuous_uliftDown)⟩ :
              C(ULift.{u} T, ULift.{v} (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum A)))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bijective_of_wLocalMap_identifiesLocalRings
declarations.doc:
A ring map whose map of spectra is a w-local map of w-local spaces, which identifies all
local rings and bijects connected components, is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_of_wLocalMap_identifiesLocalRings
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)]
    [WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)]
    (hlocal : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B)
    (hwlocal : IsWLocalMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
    (hcomponents : Function.Bijective
      (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap A B)).connectedComponentsMap) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap A B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isIndZariski_of_wLocalMap_identifiesLocalRings
declarations.doc:
A w-local morphism between w-local affine spectra that identifies local rings
is ind-Zariski.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIndZariski_of_wLocalMap_identifiesLocalRings
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)]
    [WLocalSpace (PrimeSpectrum B)]
    (hlocal : Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B)
    (hwlocal : IsWLocalMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) :
    IsIndZariski.{u, v, max u v} A B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_faithfullyFlat_indZariski_extension
declarations.doc:
A map identifying local rings becomes ind-Zariski after a faithfully flat
ind-Zariski extension of its target.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_faithfullyFlat_indZariski_extension
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hf : letI := f.toAlgebra; Algebra.IdentifiesLocalRings A B) :
    ∃ (B' : Type v) (_ : CommRing B') (g : B →+* B'),
      g.FaithfullyFlat ∧
        (letI := g.toAlgebra; IsIndZariski.{v, v, max u v} B B') ∧
        (letI := (g.comp f).toAlgebra;
          IsIndZariski.{u, v, max u v} A B')

declarations.name: StacksDraft.IndEtale
declarations.doc:
**Ind-étaleness with the base and the algebra in independent universes.** For `A : Type u` and
`B : Type v`, the `A`-algebra `B` is *ind-étale* if `ULift.{u} B` is a filtered colimit of étale
`A`-algebras in `CommAlgCat.{max u v} A`. This is the shape of the `ind_etale` field of
`IsLocalRing.IsHenselization`, and in a common universe it is the usual condition
(`StacksDraft.indEtale_iff`).
declarations.statement: abbrev IndEtale (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] : Prop

declarations.name: Algebra.weaklyEtale_of_ind_etale
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 097N.** A filtered colimit of étale algebras is weakly étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyEtale_of_ind_etale {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] (h : StacksDraft.IndEtale A B) :
    Algebra.WeaklyEtale A B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.indEtaleQuotientBaseChange
declarations.doc: Extension of scalars along `A → A ⧸ I`, restricted to ind-étale algebras.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def indEtaleQuotientBaseChange (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) : IndEtaleAlgebra A ⥤ IndEtaleAlgebra (A ⧸ I)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.indEtaleQuotientLift
declarations.doc: The canonical lift of an ind-étale algebra over `A ⧸ I` to one over `A`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def indEtaleQuotientLift (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) : IndEtaleAlgebra (A ⧸ I) ⥤ IndEtaleAlgebra A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.indEtaleBaseChange_hasFullyFaithfulRightAdjoint
declarations.doc: Quotient base change is left adjoint to the canonical lift.
declarations.statement:
public theorem indEtaleBaseChange_hasFullyFaithfulRightAdjoint
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    Nonempty (indEtaleQuotientBaseChange A I ⊣ indEtaleQuotientLift A I)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.indEtaleQuotientLift_baseChangeIso
declarations.doc: The quotient of a lifted algebra is naturally the original algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem indEtaleQuotientLift_baseChangeIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
