            {x : S' | ∃ n > 0, ((X : S'[X]) - C x) ^ n ∈ lifts (algebraMap R' S')} = ⊤

declarations.name: FixedPoints.quotientComparison_injective
declarations.doc:
**(Well-definedness of `R^G/I^G ⊆ (R/I)^G`.)** The canonical comparison map
`φ` is injective, so `R^G / I^G` is (isomorphic to) a subring of `(R/I)^G`.

Proof: `φ` is `Ideal.Quotient.lift` of `toFixedQuot : R^G → (R/I)^G`, so it
suffices to show `ker(toFixedQuot) = I^G = invariantIdeal`. If `a ∈ R^G` maps to `0`,
then `mk_I (a : R) = 0` in `R/I`, i.e. `a ∈ I`; and `a ∈ R^G`, so
`a ∈ invariantIdeal R G I` by definition (`I.comap (R^G).subtype`). Conversely the
quotient by `invariantIdeal` already kills these, so the lifted map is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientComparison_injective :
    Function.Injective (compMap R G I hcompat)

declarations.name: FixedPoints.compMap_isIntegral
declarations.doc:
**(Integrality.)** Via the comparison map `φ`, the ring `(R/I)^G` is an
integral extension of `R^G / I^G`: every element of `(R/I)^G` is a root of a monic
polynomial with coefficients in the image of `R^G / I^G`.

Proof: by `Algebra.IsIntegral.mk`, fix `b ∈ (R/I)^G`. Take the monic witness `P`
over `R^G/I^G` from `compMap_polyWitness b`, with `map φ P = (X - C b)^{|G|}`.
Then under the algebra structure `φ.toAlgebra`, `aeval b P = (map φ P).eval b
= ((X - C b)^{|G|}).eval b = (b - b)^{|G|} = 0` (using
`Polynomial.aeval_def`, `Polynomial.eval_map`, `Polynomial.eval_pow`,
`Polynomial.eval_sub`, `Polynomial.eval_X`, `Polynomial.eval_C`), and `P` is
monic, so `b` is integral.
declarations.statement:
theorem compMap_isIntegral :
    letI := (compMap R G I hcompat).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsIntegral (FixedPoints.subring R G ⧸ invIdeal R G I)
      (FixedPoints.subring (R ⧸ I) G)

declarations.name: FixedPoints.quotientComparison_comap_isHomeomorph
declarations.doc:
**(Homeomorphism on spectra.)** The induced map on prime spectra
`Spec(φ) : Spec((R/I)^G) → Spec(R^G/I^G)` is a homeomorphism for the Zariski topologies.
This is `PrimeSpectrum.isHomeomorph_comap` (the abstract form of Stacks 09EF) applied to the
two facts read off from `quotientComparison_polyWitness` and `quotientComparison_injective`: every
`b ∈ (R/I)^G` has `b ^ |G|` in the range of `φ`, and `ker φ = 0` is nil.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientComparison_comap_isHomeomorph :
    IsHomeomorph (PrimeSpectrum.comap (compMap R G I hcompat))

declarations.name: FixedPoints.quotientComparison_residueField_isPurelyInseparable
declarations.doc:
**(Purely inseparable residue extensions.)** For every prime `𝔮 ⊆ (R/I)^G` with
contraction `𝔭 = φ⁻¹(𝔮) ⊆ R^G/I^G`, the induced extension of residue fields
`κ(𝔭) → κ(𝔮)` is purely inseparable. This is the abstract form of Stacks 09EF,
`isPurelyInseparable_residueField_of_sub_C_pow_witness`, applied to the monic witness
`quotientComparison_polyWitness`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientComparison_residueField_isPurelyInseparable
    (q : Ideal (FixedPoints.subring (R ⧸ I) G)) [q.IsPrime] :
    letI := (Ideal.ResidueField.map (q.comap (compMap R G I hcompat)) q
      (compMap R G I hcompat) rfl).toAlgebra
    IsPurelyInseparable (Ideal.ResidueField (q.comap (compMap R G I hcompat)))
      (Ideal.ResidueField q)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.inertia_fixedSubalgebra_isIntegralClosure_and_etale_localization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 09EH.** The subring of the integral closure fixed by the inertia group is the
integral closure in the fixed field, and its localization at the prime below the chosen maximal
ideal is étale over the original discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem inertia_fixedSubalgebra_isIntegralClosure_and_etale_localization
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [IsGalois K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (P : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [P.IsMaximal] :
    let B := integralClosure A L
    letI := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    letI : SMulCommClass Gal(L/K) A B :=
      ⟨fun g a b ↦ by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
        change galRestrict A K L B g (algebraMap A B a * b) =
          algebraMap A B a * galRestrict A K L B g b
        rw [map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes]⟩
    let I := P.inertia Gal(L/K)
    let B' := FixedPoints.subalgebra A B I
    let L' := IntermediateField.fixedField I
    let inclusion : B' →ₐ[A] L := (integralClosure A L).val.comp B'.val
    let iota : B' →ₐ[A] L' :=
      inclusion.codRestrict (L'.toSubalgebra.restrictScalars A) (fun b ↦ by
        change (inclusion b : L) ∈ L'
        rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
        intro g hg
        exact (algebraMap_galRestrict_apply A g (b : B)).symm.trans
          (congrArg (algebraMap B L) (b.property ⟨g, hg⟩)))
    letI := iota.toAlgebra
    IsIntegralClosure B' A L' ∧
      Algebra.Etale A (Localization.AtPrime (P.under B'))

declarations.name: krasner_lemma
declarations.doc:
**Krasner's lemma (Stacks Tag 09EI).** Let `A` be a complete local Noetherian
domain of Krull dimension `1` with maximal ideal `m`. If `α` is a root of `P` that
is not a root of `P'`, then for every `c` there is an `n` such that any polynomial
`Q` whose coefficients all lie in `m ^ n` makes `P + Q` have a root `β` with
`β - α ∈ m ^ c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem krasner_lemma
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1)
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A]
    (P : A[X]) (α : A)
    (hroot : P.eval α = 0)
    (hderiv : (derivative P).eval α ≠ 0) :
    ∀ c : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ Q : A[X], (∀ i, Q.coeff i ∈ (maximalIdeal A) ^ n) →
      ∃ β : A, (P + Q).eval β = 0 ∧ β - α ∈ (maximalIdeal A) ^ c

declarations.name: Krasner.exists_finite_separable_extension_tensorProduct_equiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09EJ.** Let `A` be a Noetherian local ring whose completion at its maximal ideal is a
one-dimensional domain. A finite separable extension of the fraction field of the completion is
obtained by scalar extension from a finite separable extension of the fraction field of `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_separable_extension_tensorProduct_equiv
    {A K Khat M : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsDomain (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)]
    (hAhat_dim : ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) = 1)
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field Khat]
    [Algebra (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) Khat]
    [IsFractionRing (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) Khat]
    [Field M] [Algebra Khat M] [FiniteDimensional Khat M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable Khat M] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    letI : Algebra A Khat :=
      ((algebraMap Ahat Khat).comp (algebraMap A Ahat)).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K Khat :=
      (IsFractionRing.lift (A := A) (K := K) (L := Khat) (g := algebraMap A Khat)
        ((IsFractionRing.injective Ahat Khat).comp
          (by
            dsimp only [Ahat]
            exact AdicCompletion.of_injective (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))).toAlgebra
    ∃ L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K),
      FiniteDimensional K L ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K L ∧
        Nonempty (TensorProduct K Khat L ≃ₐ[Khat] M)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.HasMixedCharacteristic
declarations.doc:
A discrete valuation ring has mixed characteristic `(0, p)` if `p` is positive, its residue
field has characteristic `p`, and its fraction field has characteristic zero.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasMixedCharacteristic (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (p : ℕ) : Prop

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.integerLocalization
declarations.doc: The localization `ℤ_(p)` associated to a mixed-characteristic discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev integerLocalization (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] {p : ℕ} (h : HasMixedCharacteristic A p) : Type

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.mixedCharacteristicRingHom
declarations.doc: The canonical map `ℤ_(p) → A` attached to a mixed-characteristic discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def mixedCharacteristicRingHom (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] {p : ℕ} (h : HasMixedCharacteristic A p) :
    integerLocalization A h →+* A

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.absoluteRamificationIndex
declarations.doc:
The absolute ramification index of a mixed-characteristic discrete valuation ring, namely the
ramification index of its canonical extension `ℤ_(p) → A`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def absoluteRamificationIndex (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] {p : ℕ} (h : HasMixedCharacteristic A p) : ℕ

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.hasMixedCharacteristic_iff_mixedCharZero_and_integerLocalization_extension
declarations.doc:
For a discrete valuation ring, the residue-field formulation of mixed characteristic agrees
with Mathlib's `MixedCharZero`; moreover, the maximal ideal lies over `(p)` and the canonical map
from `ℤ_(p)` is an injective local homomorphism whose source is a discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasMixedCharacteristic_iff_mixedCharZero_and_integerLocalization_extension
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (p : ℕ) :
    (HasMixedCharacteristic A p ↔
      0 < p ∧ CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p ∧ MixedCharZero A p) ∧
      ∀ h : HasMixedCharacteristic A p,
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).under ℤ = Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} ∧
          Function.Injective (mixedCharacteristicRingHom A h) ∧
          IsLocalHom (mixedCharacteristicRingHom A h) ∧
          IsDiscreteValuationRing (integerLocalization A h)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.integralClosures_after_finite_fraction_field_extension
declarations.doc:
The integral closures attached to a finite extension `K₁/K` and an extension of discrete
valuation rings `A → B` have the product, spectral, local, henselian, inseparable, separable,
and Nagata properties listed in Stacks Project, Tag 09EM.
declarations.statement:
theorem integralClosures_after_finite_fraction_field_extension
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    (K₁ : Type uK₁) (L₁ : Type uL₁) (A₁ : Type uA₁) (B₁ : Type uB₁)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L] [Field K₁]
    [CommRing L₁] [CommRing A₁] [CommRing B₁]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [IsExtension A B]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K K₁]
    [Algebra A K₁] [Algebra K L₁] [Algebra B L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra K₁ L₁]
    [Algebra A A₁] [Algebra B B₁] [Algebra A B₁] [Algebra A₁ B₁] [Algebra B₁ L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A K K₁]
    [IsScalarTower K L L₁] [IsScalarTower K K₁ L₁] [IsScalarTower B L L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B B₁] [IsScalarTower A A₁ B₁] [IsScalarTower B B₁ L₁]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [Module.Finite K K₁]
    (eL₁ : L₁ ≃ₐ[K] ((L ⊗[K] K₁) ⧸ nilradical (L ⊗[K] K₁)))
    (eA₁ : A₁ ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A K₁)
    (eB₁ : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] integralClosure B L₁)
    (eL₁_left : ∀ x : L,
      eL₁ (algebraMap L L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : L →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eL₁_right : ∀ x : K₁,
      eL₁ (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eB₁_coe : ∀ x : B₁, ((eB₁ x : integralClosure B L₁) : L₁) = algebraMap B₁ L₁ x)
    (hfieldSquare : ∀ x : K, algebraMap L L₁ (algebraMap K L x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ (algebraMap K K₁ x))
    (hringSquare : ∀ x : A₁, algebraMap B₁ L₁ (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ ((eA₁ x : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁)) :
    IsNonemptyFiniteProductOfFiniteFieldExtensions L L₁ ∧
      IsDedekindDomain A₁ ∧
      IsFiniteProductOfDedekindDomains B₁ ∧
      (∃ π : A,
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {π} ∧
        IsRegular (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] A₁) π) ∧
        (∃ e : Localization.Away (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] A₁) π) ≃+* (L ⊗[K] K₁),
          (∀ b : B, e (algebraMap (B ⊗[A] A₁) _
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : B →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) b)) =
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : L →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) (algebraMap B L b)) ∧
          (∀ a : A₁, e (algebraMap (B ⊗[A] A₁) _
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) a)) =
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁)
              ((eA₁ a : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁))) ∧
        ∃ g : (B ⊗[A] A₁) →+* B₁,
          g.IsIntegral ∧ RingHom.ker g ≤ nilradical (B ⊗[A] A₁) ∧
          Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap g) ∧
          (∀ b : B, g ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : B →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) b) =
            algebraMap B B₁ b) ∧
          (∀ a : A₁, g ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) a) =
            algebraMap A₁ B₁ a)) ∧
      Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)) ∧
      Finite (MaximalSpectrum A₁) ∧
      Nonempty (MaximalSpectrum A₁) ∧
      (∀ p : MaximalSpectrum A₁,
        Finite {q : MaximalSpectrum B₁ //
          q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁) = p.asIdeal} ∧
        Nonempty {q : MaximalSpectrum B₁ //
          q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁) = p.asIdeal}) ∧
      (∀ p : Ideal A₁, p.IsMaximal →
        ∃ q : Ideal B₁, q.IsMaximal ∧ q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁) = p) ∧
      (∀ q : Ideal B₁, q.IsMaximal →
        (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).IsMaximal ∧
        ∃ (_ : q.IsPrime) (_ : (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).IsPrime),
          (∃ _ : IsDomain (Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl),
            IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl)) ∧
          (∃ _ : IsDomain (Localization q.primeCompl),
            IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization q.primeCompl)) ∧
          ∃ φ : Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl →+*
              Localization q.primeCompl,
            Function.Injective φ ∧ IsLocalHom φ ∧
              ∀ x : A₁, φ (algebraMap A₁ _ x) = algebraMap B₁ _ (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x)) ∧
      (HenselianLocalRing A → ∃ _ : IsDomain A₁, IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁) ∧
      (IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A →
        ∃ _ : IsDomain A₁, IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁) ∧
      (HenselianLocalRing B →
        IsFiniteProductOfDiscreteValuationRings B₁) ∧
      (IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B →
        IsFiniteProductOfDiscreteValuationRings B₁) ∧
      (IsPurelyInseparable K K₁ →
        (∃ _ : IsDomain A₁, IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁) ∧
        (∃ _ : IsDomain B₁, IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁)) ∧
      (Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁ →
        IsReduced (L ⊗[K] K₁) ∧
        IsNonemptyFiniteProductOfFiniteSeparableFieldExtensions L L₁ ∧
        Module.Finite A A₁ ∧ Module.Finite B B₁) ∧
      (IsNagataRing A → Module.Finite A A₁) ∧
      (IsNagataRing B → Module.Finite B B₁)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.IsWeakSolution
declarations.doc: Every localization arising from the base change has ramification index one.
declarations.statement:
def IsWeakSolution
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    {K₁ : Type uK₁}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L] [Field K₁]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra A K₁]
    [IsExtension A B] [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A K K₁]
    [Module.Finite K K₁]
    (D : IntegralClosureBaseChange A B K L K₁) : Prop

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.IsSolution
declarations.doc:
Every localization arising from the base change is formally smooth for the adic topology
defined by the maximal ideal of the target localization.

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.IsSeparableSolution
declarations.doc: A solution whose finite extension `K₁/K` is separable.

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.weakSolution_isInseparable_and_inseparable_isSolution
declarations.doc:
For `k[[x]] → k[[x^(1/p)]]` in positive characteristic `p`, every weak solution is
inseparable, while every finite inseparable extension of `k((x))` is a solution.
declarations.statement:
theorem weakSolution_isInseparable_and_inseparable_isSolution
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (k : Type uk) (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [Field k] [PerfectField k] [CharP k p]
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k K] [Algebra k L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower k A B] [IsScalarTower k A K] [IsScalarTower k B L]
    [IsScalarTower k K L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsExtension A B] [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L]
    (eA : A ≃ₐ[k] PowerSeries k) (eB : B ≃ₐ[k] PowerSeries k)
    (eK : K ≃ₐ[k] LaurentSeries k) (eL : L ≃ₐ[k] LaurentSeries k)
    (hAB : ∀ a : A, eB (algebraMap A B a) =
      PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X ^ p) (eA a))
    (_hAK : ∀ a : A, eK (algebraMap A K a) = (eA a : LaurentSeries k))
    (_hBL : ∀ b : B, eL (algebraMap B L b) = (eB b : LaurentSeries k)) :
    (∀ (K₁ : Type uK₁) [Field K₁] [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra A K₁]
        [IsScalarTower A K K₁] [Module.Finite K K₁]
        (D : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁, uL₁, uA₁, uB₁}
          A B K L K₁),
        D.IsWeakSolution → ¬ Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁) ∧
      ∀ (K₁ : Type uK₁) [Field K₁] [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra A K₁]
        [IsScalarTower A K K₁] [Module.Finite K K₁],
        ¬ Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁ →
          ∃ D : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁,
              max uL uK₁, uK₁, max uL uK₁} A B K L K₁,
            D.IsSolution.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁, max uL uK₁, uK₁, max uL uK₁, v}

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.formallySmooth_localizations_after_finite_fraction_field_extension
declarations.doc:
Formal smoothness of an extension of discrete valuation rings persists at every local factor
after a finite extension of the fraction field.  The integral closure upstairs is the reduced
tensor product, and it is the unreduced tensor product whenever `L ⊗_K K₁` is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallySmooth_localizations_after_finite_fraction_field_extension
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    (K₁ : Type uK₁) (L₁ : Type uL₁) (A₁ : Type uA₁) (B₁ : Type uB₁)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L] [Field K₁]
    [CommRing L₁] [CommRing A₁] [CommRing B₁]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [IsExtension A B]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K K₁]
    [Algebra A K₁] [Algebra K L₁] [Algebra B L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra K₁ L₁]
    [Algebra A A₁] [Algebra B B₁] [Algebra A B₁] [Algebra A₁ B₁] [Algebra B₁ L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A K K₁]
    [IsScalarTower K L L₁] [IsScalarTower K K₁ L₁] [IsScalarTower B L L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B B₁] [IsScalarTower A A₁ B₁] [IsScalarTower B B₁ L₁]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [Module.Finite K K₁]
    (eL₁ : L₁ ≃ₐ[K] ((L ⊗[K] K₁) ⧸ nilradical (L ⊗[K] K₁)))
    (eA₁ : A₁ ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A K₁)
    (eB₁ : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] integralClosure B L₁)
    (eL₁_left : ∀ x : L,
      eL₁ (algebraMap L L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : L →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eL₁_right : ∀ x : K₁,
      eL₁ (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eB₁_coe : ∀ x : B₁, ((eB₁ x : integralClosure B L₁) : L₁) = algebraMap B₁ L₁ x)
    (hfieldSquare : ∀ x : K, algebraMap L L₁ (algebraMap K L x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ (algebraMap K K₁ x))
    (hringSquare : ∀ x : A₁, algebraMap B₁ L₁ (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ ((eA₁ x : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁))
    (hformal : RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max uA uB} (algebraMap A B)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)) :
    (∃ eB : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] ((B ⊗[A] A₁) ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[A] A₁)),
        (∀ x : A₁, eB (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) x))) ∧
      (IsReduced (L ⊗[K] K₁) →
        (∃ eL : L₁ ≃ₐ[L] (L ⊗[K] K₁),
        (∀ x : L₁, Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (eL x) = eL₁ x) ∧
        (∀ x : K₁, eL (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x)) ∧
      (∃ eB : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] (B ⊗[A] A₁),
        (∀ x : A₁, eB (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] A₁) x))) ∧
      (∀ q : Ideal B₁, q.IsMaximal →
        (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).IsMaximal ∧
        ∃ (_ : q.IsPrime) (_ : (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).IsPrime),
          (∃ _ : IsDomain (Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl),
            IsDiscreteValuationRing
              (Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl)) ∧
          (∃ _ : IsDomain (Localization q.primeCompl),
            IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization q.primeCompl)) ∧
          ∃ φ : Localization (q.comap (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).primeCompl →+*
              Localization q.primeCompl,
            Function.Injective φ ∧ IsLocalHom φ ∧
              (∀ x : A₁, φ (algebraMap A₁ _ x) =
                algebraMap B₁ _ (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x)) ∧
              RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max uA₁ uB₁} φ
                (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization q.primeCompl)))

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isField_tensorProduct_and_isDVR_baseChange_of_totallyRamified
declarations.doc:
A finite separable extension totally ramified with respect to the lower discrete valuation
ring preserves a weakly unramified extension after tensor-product base change. The tensor
product is canonically the integral closure in the base-changed fraction field.
declarations.statement:
theorem isField_tensorProduct_and_isDVR_baseChange_of_totallyRamified
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL) (K₁ : Type uK₁)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L] [Field K₁]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [FaithfulSMul A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra A K₁] [IsScalarTower A K K₁]
    [FiniteDimensional K K₁] [Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁]
    (hweak : Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    (htot : IsTotallyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K₁) :
    let A₁ := integralClosure A K₁
    let B₁ := B ⊗[A] A₁
    let L₁ := L ⊗[K] K₁
    let C₁ := integralClosure B L₁
    ∃ hL₁ : IsField L₁,
      letI := hL₁.toField
      ∃ hA₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁,
        letI := hA₁
        ∃ hBdom : IsDomain B₁,
          letI := hBdom
          ∃ hB₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁,
            letI := hB₁
            let f : A₁ →+* B₁ := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
            Function.Injective f ∧
              Ideal.map f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₁) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B₁ ∧
              ∃ hCdom : IsDomain C₁,
                letI := hCdom
                ∃ hC₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing C₁,
                  letI := hC₁
                  ∃ _ : IsFractionRing C₁ L₁,
                    ∃ e : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] C₁,
                      (∀ a : A₁,
                        ((e ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[A] B₁) a) : C₁)
                            : L₁) =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L₁) (a : K₁)) ∧
                        let f' : A₁ →+* C₁ :=
                          e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
                        Function.Injective f' ∧
                          Ideal.map f' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₁) =
                            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C₁

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.weakSolutions_and_solutions_go_down_and_compose
declarations.doc:
Weak solutions and solutions descend along a tower of extensions of discrete valuation
rings. Conversely, they compose provided every field factor of the intermediate reduced tensor
product is respectively a weak solution or a solution for the upper extension.
declarations.statement:
theorem weakSolutions_and_solutions_go_down_and_compose
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (C : Type uC)
    (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL) (M : Type uM) (K₁ : Type uK₁)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDomain C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M] [Field K₁]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra A M]
    [Algebra B L] [Algebra B M] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K M] [Algebra L M]
    [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra A K₁]
    [IsExtension A B] [IsExtension B C]
    [IsExtension A C]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A B M]
    [IsScalarTower B C M] [IsScalarTower A C M]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsScalarTower B L M] [IsScalarTower A K K₁] [Module.Finite K K₁]
    (DAB : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁, uL₁, uA₁, uB₁}
      A B K L K₁)
    (DAC : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uC, uK, uM, uK₁, uM₁, uA₂, uC₁}
      A C K M K₁) :
    letI := DAB.commRingL₁
    letI := DAB.algebraLL₁
    ((DAC.IsWeakSolution → DAB.IsWeakSolution) ∧
      (DAC.IsSolution.{uA, uC, uK, uM, uK₁, uM₁, uA₂, uC₁, max uA₂ uC₁} →
        DAB.IsSolution.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁, uL₁, uA₁, uB₁, max uA₁ uB₁})) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Fin n → Type uE)
        [∀ i, Field (E i)] [∀ i, Algebra L (E i)] [∀ i, Algebra B (E i)]
        [∀ i, IsScalarTower B L (E i)] [∀ i, Module.Finite L (E i)],
        0 < n → Nonempty (DAB.L₁ ≃ₐ[L] ∀ i, E i) →
          ∀ DBC : ∀ i, IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uB, uC, uL, uM, uE, uN₁, uB₂, uC₂}
              B C L M (E i),
            ((DAB.IsWeakSolution ∧ ∀ i, (DBC i).IsWeakSolution) →
              DAC.IsWeakSolution) ∧
            ((DAB.IsSolution.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK₁, uL₁, uA₁, uB₁, max uA₁ uB₁} ∧
                ∀ i, (DBC i).IsSolution.{uB, uC, uL, uM, uE, uN₁, uB₂, uC₂, max uB₂ uC₂}) →
              DAC.IsSolution.{uA, uC, uK, uM, uK₁, uM₁, uA₂, uC₁, max uA₂ uC₁})

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.normal_extension_acts_transitively_on_maximalSpectrum_integralClosure
declarations.doc:
After a finite normal extension `K₁/K`, the automorphisms of `K₁` over `K` act
compatibly on the reduced base change `L₁`, on the integral closure `A₁` of `A` in `K₁`,
and on the integral closure `B₁` of `B` in `L₁`.  The resulting action on the maximal
ideals of `B₁` is transitive.
declarations.statement:
theorem normal_extension_acts_transitively_on_maximalSpectrum_integralClosure
    (A B K L K₁ L₁ A₁ B₁ : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L] [Field K₁]
    [CommRing L₁] [CommRing A₁] [CommRing B₁]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [FaithfulSMul A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K K₁]
    [Algebra A K₁] [Algebra K L₁] [Algebra B L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra K₁ L₁]
    [Algebra A A₁] [Algebra B B₁] [Algebra A B₁] [Algebra A₁ B₁] [Algebra B₁ L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A K K₁]
    [IsScalarTower K L L₁] [IsScalarTower K K₁ L₁] [IsScalarTower B L L₁]
    [IsScalarTower A B B₁] [IsScalarTower A A₁ B₁] [IsScalarTower B B₁ L₁]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [Module.Finite K K₁] [Normal K K₁]
    (eL₁ : L₁ ≃ₐ[K] ((L ⊗[K] K₁) ⧸ nilradical (L ⊗[K] K₁)))
    (eA₁ : A₁ ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A K₁)
    (eB₁ : B₁ ≃ₐ[B] integralClosure B L₁)
    (eL₁_left : ∀ x : L,
      eL₁ (algebraMap L L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : L →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eL₁_right : ∀ x : K₁,
      eL₁ (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] K₁) x))
    (eB₁_coe : ∀ x : B₁, ((eB₁ x : integralClosure B L₁) : L₁) = algebraMap B₁ L₁ x)
    (_hfieldSquare : ∀ x : K, algebraMap L L₁ (algebraMap K L x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ (algebraMap K K₁ x))
    (hringSquare : ∀ x : A₁, algebraMap B₁ L₁ (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) =
      algebraMap K₁ L₁ ((eA₁ x : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁)) :
    ∃ (ρL₁ : (K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) →* (L₁ ≃ₐ[L] L₁))
        (ρA₁ : (K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) →* (A₁ ≃ₐ[A] A₁))
        (ρB₁ : (K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) →* (B₁ ≃ₐ[B] B₁)),
      (∀ (g : K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) (x : K₁),
        ρL₁ g (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x) = algebraMap K₁ L₁ (g x)) ∧
      (∀ (g : K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) (x : A₁),
        (((eA₁ (ρA₁ g x) : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁)) =
          g ((eA₁ x : integralClosure A K₁) : K₁)) ∧
      (∀ (g : K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) (x : B₁),
        algebraMap B₁ L₁ (ρB₁ g x) = ρL₁ g (algebraMap B₁ L₁ x)) ∧
      (∀ (g : K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁) (x : A₁),
        ρB₁ g (algebraMap A₁ B₁ x) = algebraMap A₁ B₁ (ρA₁ g x)) ∧
      ∀ q q' : MaximalSpectrum B₁, ∃ g : K₁ ≃ₐ[K] K₁,
        q'.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (ρB₁ g).symm.toRingHom

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.intermediateField_eq_adjoin
declarations.doc:
If `n` is prime to the residue characteristic of `A`, then every intermediate field
`K ⊆ L ⊆ K_1` is of the form `L = K[pi^{1/d}]` for some positive divisor `d | n`: `L` is generated
over `K` by the `d`-th root `(pi')^{n/d}` of `pi`, and `[L : K] = d` and `[K_1 : L] = n / d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem intermediateField_eq_adjoin [Fact (Irreducible (kummerPoly K π n))]
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π)
    (hcop : ringChar (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) = 0 ∨
      Nat.Coprime (ringChar (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) n)
    (L : IntermediateField K (K1 K π n)) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ d ∣ n ∧
      L = IntermediateField.adjoin K {(piRoot K π n) ^ (n / d)} ∧
      Module.finrank K L = d ∧
      Module.finrank L (K1 K π n) = n / d

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.isDiscreteValuationRing_A1
declarations.doc: `A_1` is a discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_A1 [Fact (Irreducible (kummerPoly K π n))]
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (A1 K π n)

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.exists_ramificationIdx_eq
declarations.doc:
`A_1` has a unique maximal ideal `m` lying over `m_A`, and the ramification index of `m`
over `m_A` is `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ramificationIdx_eq (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    ∃ m : Ideal (A1 K π n), m.IsMaximal ∧
      m.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ∧
      (∀ m' : Ideal (A1 K π n), m'.IsMaximal →
        m'.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) → m' = m) ∧
      Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) m = n

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.isTotallyRamified_K1
declarations.doc:
`K_1 / K` is totally ramified with respect to `A`, whatever the residue characteristic of
`A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyRamified_K1 [Fact (Irreducible (kummerPoly K π n))]
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    IsTotallyRamified A K (K1 K π n)

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.isTamelyRamified_K1
declarations.doc:
If `n` is prime to the residue characteristic of `A`, then `K_1 / K` is tamely ramified
with respect to `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTamelyRamified_K1 [Fact (Irreducible (kummerPoly K π n))]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable K (K1 K π n)]
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π)
    (hcop : ringChar (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) = 0 ∨
      Nat.Coprime (ringChar (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) n) :
    IsTamelyRamified A K (K1 K π n)

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.finrank_K1
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_K1 (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    Module.finrank K (K1 K π n) = n

declarations.name: Stacks.KummerExtension.integralClosure_eq_adjoin
declarations.doc:
The integral closure `A_1` of `A` in `K_1` is the `A`-subalgebra `A[pi'] = A[pi^{1/n}]`
generated by `pi'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem integralClosure_eq_adjoin (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    (A1 K π n) = Algebra.adjoin A {piRoot K π n}

declarations.name: Stacks.EisensteinExtension.exists_totallyRamifiedExtension_with_uniformizer_eq
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` and residue characteristic
`p > 0`, with uniformizer `π`, and let `n > 1`. For every power `q` of `p` there is a separable
extension `L / K` of degree `q`, totally ramified with respect to `A` with ramification index
`q`, whose integral closure `B` of `A` is a discrete valuation ring with a uniformizer `π_B`
satisfying `π_B^q = π + π^n b` and `π_B^q = π + π_B^{nq} b'` for some `b, b'` in `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_totallyRamifiedExtension_with_uniformizer_eq
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π) (p n q : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (_hres : ringChar (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) = p)
    (hn : 1 < n) (hq : ∃ r : ℕ, q = p ^ r) :
    ∃ (L : Type v) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : Algebra A L)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing (integralClosure A L)),
      Module.finrank K L = q ∧
        Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTotallyRamified A K L ∧
        Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure A L)) = q ∧
        ∃ πB b b' : integralClosure A L,
          Irreducible πB ∧
            πB ^ q = algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) π +
              (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) π) ^ n * b ∧
            πB ^ q = algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) π + πB ^ (n * q) * b'

declarations.name: Stacks.DiscreteValuationRing.AdjoinPthRoot.statement1_not_pth_power
declarations.doc:
If the residue class `abar` of `a` is not a `p`-th power in the residue field `kappa_A`,
then `a` is not a `p`-th power in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement1_not_pth_power
    (ha : ¬ ∃ b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, IsLocalRing.residue A a = b ^ p) :
    ¬ ∃ b : K, algebraMap A K a = b ^ p

declarations.name: Stacks.DiscreteValuationRing.AdjoinPthRoot.statement2_integralClosure
declarations.doc:
The integral closure of `A` in `K[a^{1/p}]` equals
`A[a^{1/p}] = A[alpha]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement2_integralClosure
    (ha : ¬ ∃ b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, IsLocalRing.residue A a = b ^ p) :
    integralClosure A (FieldExt (A := A) (K := K) p a)
      = ringExt (A := A) (K := K) p a

declarations.name: Stacks.DiscreteValuationRing.AdjoinPthRoot.statement3_dvr_weaklyUnramified
declarations.doc:
The ring `A[a^{1/p}] = A[alpha]` is a discrete valuation ring, and the extension
`A ⊆ A[a^{1/p}]` is weakly unramified: every uniformizer (irreducible element) of `A` maps to a
uniformizer (irreducible element) of `A[a^{1/p}]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement3_dvr_weaklyUnramified
    (ha : ¬ ∃ b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, IsLocalRing.residue A a = b ^ p) :
    haveI : Fact (Irreducible (polyK (A := A) (K := K) p a)) :=
      ⟨statement1_irreducible p a ha⟩
    letI B := ringExt (A := A) (K := K) p a
    haveI : IsDomain B := inferInstance
    IsDiscreteValuationRing B
      ∧ (∀ ϖ : A, Irreducible ϖ → Irreducible (algebraMap A B ϖ))

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.weaklyUnramified_or_adjoin_root_or_after_totallyRamified_baseChange
declarations.doc:
For a weakly unramified extension `A → B` of discrete valuation rings with `B`
Nagata, followed by a purely inseparable extension of fraction fields of prime degree `p`,
either the composite extension is weakly unramified, the upper DVR is generated by a
`p`-th root of a uniformizer of `A`, or a separable totally ramified degree-`p` base change
makes both maps between the resulting integral closures weakly unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyUnramified_or_adjoin_root_or_after_totallyRamified_baseChange
    (A B C K L M : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [FaithfulSMul A B] [FaithfulSMul B C]
    [IsScalarTower A B C]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B C)]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra A M] [Algebra B M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K M] [Algebra L M]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower B C M]
    [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower B L M]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsScalarTower A B M] [IsScalarTower A K M]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [FiniteDimensional L M] [IsPurelyInseparable L M]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank L M = p)
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π)
    (hNagata : IsNagataRing B)
    (hweak : Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap A C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C ∨
      (∃ x : C, x ^ p = algebraMap A C π ∧ Algebra.adjoin B {x} = ⊤) ∨
      ∃ (K₁ : Type u) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
        (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : FiniteDimensional K K₁)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁),
        Module.finrank K K₁ = p ∧
          IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsTotallyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K₁ ∧
          let L₁ := L ⊗[K] K₁
          let M₁ := M ⊗[K] K₁
          let A₁ := integralClosure A K₁
          let B₁ := integralClosure B L₁
          let C₁ := integralClosure C M₁
          IsField L₁ ∧ IsField M₁ ∧
            ∃ hA₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁,
              letI := hA₁
              ∃ hB₁dom : IsDomain B₁,
                letI := hB₁dom
                ∃ hB₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁,
                  letI := hB₁
                  ∃ hC₁dom : IsDomain C₁,
                    letI := hC₁dom
                    ∃ hC₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing C₁,
                      letI := hC₁
                      ∃ (g : L₁ →+* M₁) (f : A₁ →+* B₁) (f' : B₁ →+* C₁),
                        Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Injective f' ∧
                          (∀ l : L, g
                            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : L →ₐ[K] L₁) l) =
                            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : M →ₐ[K] M₁)
                              (algebraMap L M l)) ∧
                          (∀ k : K₁, g
                            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L₁) k) =
                            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] M₁) k) ∧
                          (∀ a : A₁, ((f a : B₁) : L₁) =
                            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : K₁ →ₐ[K] L₁) (a : K₁)) ∧
                          (∀ b : B₁, ((f' b : C₁) : M₁) = g (b : L₁)) ∧
                          Ideal.map f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₁) =
                            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B₁ ∧
                          Ideal.map f' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B₁) =
                            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C₁

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.exists_residueField_section_compatible
declarations.doc:
A local ring of prime characteristic with nilpotent maximal ideal has a coefficient field,
and it can be extended compatibly across a local homomorphism whose target also has nilpotent
maximal ideal and whose residue field extension is separable.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_residueField_section_compatible
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CharP A p]
    (hA : IsNilpotent (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) :
    ∃ σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A →+* A,
      (IsLocalRing.residue A).comp σ = RingHom.id _ ∧
      ∀ (A' : Type v) [CommRing A'] [IsLocalRing A'] [Algebra A A']
        [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A A')],
        IsNilpotent (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A') →
        Algebra.IsSeparableExtension (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A') →
        ∃ σ' : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A' →+* A',
          (IsLocalRing.residue A').comp σ' = RingHom.id _ ∧
          (algebraMap A A').comp σ =
            σ'.comp (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
              (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A'))

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isGalois_and_ramification_cases_of_adjoin_root_artinSchreier
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` of characteristic
`p > 0`. If `L = K[z]` and `z ^ p - z = ξ`, then `L / K` is Galois and is either
trivial, unramified of degree `p`, totally ramified of ramification index `p`, or
weakly unramified with purely inseparable residue extension of degree `p`.

Moreover, for a uniformizer `π` of `A`, an integral `ξ` gives one of the first two
cases; a pole of order prime to `p` gives the totally ramified case; and a pole whose
positive order is divisible by `p` and whose leading coefficient is not a `p`-th
power in the residue field gives the weakly unramified, residually inseparable case.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGalois_and_ramification_cases_of_adjoin_root_artinSchreier
    (A : Type uA) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP K p]
    (ξ : K) (z : L)
    (hz : z ^ p - z = algebraMap K L ξ)
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin K {z} = ⊤)
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    ∃ hfin : Module.Finite K L,
      letI := hfin
      let B := integralClosure A L
      let mA := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
      let trivial : Prop := Function.Surjective (algebraMap K L)
      let unramified : Prop :=
        Module.finrank K L = p ∧
          ∀ m : Ideal B, m.IsMaximal → ∃ _ : m.LiesOver mA,
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA m = 1 ∧
              @Algebra.IsSeparable (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ m) _ _
                (Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver m mA)
      let totallyRamified : Prop :=
        Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTotallyRamified A K L ∧
          ∀ m : Ideal B, m.IsMaximal → m.LiesOver mA →
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA m = p
      let residuallyInseparable : Prop :=
        ∃ hDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing B,
          letI := hDVR
          let mB := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
          ∃ _ : mB.LiesOver mA,
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA mB = 1 ∧
              letI := Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver mB mA
              IsPurelyInseparable (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ mB) ∧
                Module.finrank (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ mB) = p
      IsGalois K L ∧
        (trivial ∨ unramified ∨ totallyRamified ∨ residuallyInseparable) ∧
        ((∃ a : A, ξ = algebraMap A K a) → trivial ∨ unramified) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), 0 < n → ¬p ∣ n → IsUnit a →
          ξ = (algebraMap A K π)⁻¹ ^ n * algebraMap A K a → totallyRamified) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), 0 < n → p ∣ n →
          (¬∃ b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, IsLocalRing.residue A a = b ^ p) →
          ξ = (algebraMap A K π)⁻¹ ^ n * algebraMap A K a →
            residuallyInseparable)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_isGalois_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_of_charP
declarations.doc:
In equal characteristic `p`, a weakly unramified extension `A ⊆ B` followed
by a degree-`p` Galois extension of fraction fields admits a finite Galois base
extension which is totally ramified over `A` and is a weak solution for `A → C`,
provided the image of the residue field of `A` in that of `B` is the intersection
of all sets of `p ^ n`-th powers for `n ≥ 1`.

This is Tag 09F1 as stated.  The two consequences of `hresidue` that the proof consumes are
isolated in `exists_isGalois_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_of_charP_of_perfectCore_le`, which is
strictly more general: it drops the inclusion `image ⊆ perfectCore` entirely, keeping only
perfectness of `κ_A` and `perfectCore κ_B p ⊆ image`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isGalois_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_of_charP
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (C : Type uC)
    (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL) (M : Type uM)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDomain C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra B M] [Algebra A M]
    [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsScalarTower B C M] [IsScalarTower B L M]
    [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsExtension A B] [IsExtension B C]
    [IsExtension A C]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP K p]
    [FiniteDimensional L M] [IsGalois L M]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank L M = p)
    (hweak : IsWeaklyUnramified A B)
    (hresidue : ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B,
      (∃ a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
          algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) a = x) ↔
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B, y ^ (p ^ n) = x) :
    ∃ (K₁ : Type uK) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : Module.Finite K K₁) (_ : IsGalois K K₁),
      IsTotallyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K₁ ∧
        ∃ D : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uC, uK, uM, uK,
            max uM uK, uK, max uM uK} A C K M K₁,
          D.IsWeakSolution

declarations.name: main_statement
declarations.doc:
**Lemma 15.117.13 (Stacks tag 09F2).**
Let `p` be prime, `A` a commutative ring containing a primitive `p`-th root of unity `ζ`
(encoded by `f : ℤ[ζ_p] → A`), and `w = 1 - ζ`. Then there is ONE common polynomial
`P ∈ A[z]` such that:

* (Statement 1, integrality) `P` *is* the quotient `((1 + w z)^p - 1)/w^p` over `A`:
  `w^p · P = (1 + wz)^p - 1` in `A[z]`, `P = ∑_{0 < i ≤ p} c_i z^i`, and
  `w^{p-i} · c_i = (p choose i)` for `0 < i ≤ p` (predicate `intProp`). In particular `P` is
  monic of degree `p`. The corresponding statement in `(A[w⁻¹])[z]` (predicate `quotChar`) is
  recorded too, but it is weaker — vacuous when `w` is nilpotent, see
  `quotChar_of_isNilpotent` — so it is `intProp` that carries the assertion "`P ∈ A[z]`";
* (Statement 1, shape) `P(z) = z^p - z + ∑_{0 < i < p} a_i z^i` with `a_i ∈ (w)`
  (predicate `shapeProp`);
* (Statement 2, functional equation)
  `P(z_1 + z_2 + w z_1 z_2) = P(z_1) + P(z_2) + w^p P(z_1) P(z_2)` in `A[z_1, z_2]`
  (predicate `funcEq`).

Bundling all of them into a single existential guarantees they hold for the same `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem main_statement :
    ∃ P : A[X], intProp f P ∧ quotChar f P ∧ shapeProp f P ∧ funcEq f P

declarations.name: isGalois_and_ramification_cases_of_adjoin_root_cyclotomic_quotient
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a mixed-characteristic discrete valuation ring containing a primitive
`p`-th root of unity, and let `P` be the cyclotomic quotient polynomial of Tag 09F2.
If `L = K[z]` with `P(z) = ξ`, then `L / K` is Galois and is either trivial,
unramified of degree `p`, totally ramified with ramification index `p`, or weakly
unramified with purely inseparable residue extension of degree `p`.

Moreover, for a uniformizer `π` of `A`, an integral `ξ` gives one of the first two
cases; a pole of positive order not divisible by `p` gives the totally ramified case;
and a pole whose order is divisible by `p` and whose leading coefficient is not a
`p`-th power in the residue field gives the weakly unramified, residually inseparable
case.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGalois_and_ramification_cases_of_adjoin_root_cyclotomic_quotient
    (A : Type uA) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [CharZero K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p]
    (f : CyclotomicRing p ℤ ℚ →+* A) (P : Polynomial A)
    (hP : intProp f P ∧ quotChar f P ∧ shapeProp f P ∧ funcEq f P)
    (ξ : K) (z : L)
    (hz : Polynomial.aeval z P = algebraMap K L ξ)
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin K {z} = ⊤)
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    ∃ hfin : Module.Finite K L,
      letI := hfin
      let B := integralClosure A L
      let mA := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
      let trivial : Prop := Function.Surjective (algebraMap K L)
      let unramified : Prop :=
        Module.finrank K L = p ∧
          ∀ m : Ideal B, m.IsMaximal → ∃ _ : m.LiesOver mA,
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA m = 1 ∧
              @Algebra.IsSeparable (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ m) _ _
                (Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver m mA)
      let totallyRamified : Prop :=
        Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTotallyRamified A K L ∧
          ∀ m : Ideal B, m.IsMaximal → m.LiesOver mA →
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA m = p
      let residuallyInseparable : Prop :=
        ∃ hDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing B,
          letI := hDVR
          let mB := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
          ∃ _ : mB.LiesOver mA,
            Ideal.ramificationIdx' mA mB = 1 ∧
              letI := Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver mB mA
              IsPurelyInseparable (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ mB) ∧
                Module.finrank (A ⧸ mA) (B ⧸ mB) = p
      IsGalois K L ∧
        (trivial ∨ unramified ∨ totallyRamified ∨ residuallyInseparable) ∧
        ((∃ a : A, ξ = algebraMap A K a) → trivial ∨ unramified) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), 0 < n → ¬p ∣ n → IsUnit a →
          ξ = (algebraMap A K π)⁻¹ ^ n * algebraMap A K a → totallyRamified) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), 0 < n → p ∣ n →
          (¬∃ b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, IsLocalRing.residue A a = b ^ p) →
          ξ = (algebraMap A K π)⁻¹ ^ n * algebraMap A K a →
            residuallyInseparable)

declarations.name: Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.exists_totallyRamified_galoisExtension_isWeakSolution_or_finiteLevel
declarations.doc:
In mixed characteristic, a weakly unramified tower followed by a Galois extension of
prime degree admits a finite, totally ramified base extension. This base extension
is either a weak solution for the full tower or makes the canonical tensor-product
extension a degree-`p` extension of finite level.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_totallyRamified_galoisExtension_isWeakSolution_or_finiteLevel
    (A B C K L M : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDomain C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra A M] [Algebra B M]
    [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsScalarTower B C M] [IsScalarTower B L M]
    [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension B C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A C]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharZero K]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p]
    (hweak : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsWeaklyUnramified A B)
    (f : CyclotomicRing p ℤ ℚ →+* B)
    [FiniteDimensional L M] [IsGalois L M]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank L M = p) :
    ∃ (K₁ : Type u) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : Module.Finite K K₁),
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsTotallyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K₁ ∧
        ((∃ D : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.{u, u, u, u, u, u, u, u} A C K M
          K₁,
            D.IsWeakSolution) ∨
          let L₁ := L ⊗[K] K₁
          let M₁ := M ⊗[K] K₁
          ∃ (hL₁ : IsField L₁) (hM₁ : IsField M₁),
            letI := hL₁.toField
            letI := hM₁.toField
            let ι : L₁ →ₐ[K] M₁ :=
              Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L M) (AlgHom.id K K₁)
            letI : Algebra L₁ M₁ := ι.toRingHom.toAlgebra
            let B₁ := integralClosure B L₁
            ∃ (hB₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁) (hfrac : IsFractionRing B₁ L₁)
              (hfin : Module.Finite L₁ M₁),
              letI := hB₁
              letI := hfrac
              letI := hfin
              ∃ P : Polynomial B,
                intProp f P ∧ quotChar f P ∧ shapeProp f P ∧ funcEq f P ∧
                  IsDegreePExtensionOfFiniteLevel B₁ L₁ M₁ p
                    ((algebraMap B B₁).comp f) (P.map (algebraMap B B₁)))

declarations.name: Stacks.DiscreteValuationRing.EppLevelInduction.exists_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_or_extensionLevel_le
declarations.doc:
The traditional Tag 09F5 interface.  The global residue-field hypothesis identifies the
perfect core with the image of the base residue field, so the finite-support alternative in
`exists_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_or_extensionLevel_le_or_finiteSupport_of_uniformizer` is
impossible.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_totallyRamified_isWeakSolution_or_extensionLevel_le
    (A B C K L M : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDomain C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra A M] [Algebra B M]
    [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsScalarTower B C M] [IsScalarTower B L M]
    [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension B C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A C]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharZero K]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p]
    (hweak : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsWeaklyUnramified A B)
    (f : CyclotomicRing p ℤ ℚ →+* B) (P : Polynomial B)
    (hP : intProp f P ∧ quotChar f P ∧ shapeProp f P ∧ funcEq f P)
    [Module.Finite L M]
    (hfinite : Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.IsDegreePExtensionOfFiniteLevel B L M p f P)
    (l : ℚ)
    (hlevel : ∃ (π : B) (e₁ : ℕ) (he₁ : 0 < e₁)
        (hne : (Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.extensionLevelNumerators B L M P π).Nonempty),
        Irreducible π ∧ Associated (wElt f) (π ^ e₁) ∧
          l = Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.extensionLevel B L M P π e₁ he₁ hne)
    (hl : 0 < l)
    (hresidue : ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B,
      (∃ a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
          algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) a = x) ↔
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B, y ^ (p ^ n) = x) :
    ∃ (K₁ : Type u) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : Module.Finite K K₁)
      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K K₁),
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsTotallyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K₁ ∧
        ((∃ D : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.{u, u, u, u, u, u, u, u}
            A C K M K₁, D.IsWeakSolution) ∨
          let L₁ := L ⊗[K] K₁
          let M₁ := M ⊗[K] K₁
          ∃ (hL₁ : IsField L₁) (hM₁ : IsField M₁),
            letI := hL₁.toField
            letI := hM₁.toField
            let ι : L₁ →ₐ[K] M₁ :=
              Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L M) (AlgHom.id K K₁)
            letI : Algebra L₁ M₁ := ι.toRingHom.toAlgebra
            let B₁ := integralClosure B L₁
            ∃ (hB₁ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁) (hfrac : IsFractionRing B₁ L₁)
              (hfin : Module.Finite L₁ M₁),
              letI := hB₁
              letI := hfrac
              letI := hfin
              let f₁ := (algebraMap B B₁).comp f
              let P₁ := P.map (algebraMap B B₁)
              Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.IsDegreePExtensionOfFiniteLevel B₁ L₁ M₁ p f₁ P₁ ∧
                ∃ (π₁ : B₁) (e₁ : ℕ) (he₁ : 0 < e₁)
                  (hne : (Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.extensionLevelNumerators B₁ L₁ M₁ P₁
                    π₁).Nonempty),
                  Irreducible π₁ ∧ Associated (wElt f₁) (π₁ ^ e₁) ∧
                    Stacks.DegreePExtensionLevel.extensionLevel B₁ L₁ M₁ P₁ π₁ e₁ he₁ hne ≤
                      max 0 (max (l - 1) (2 * l - (p : ℚ))))

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.eval_sub_pow_sub_mem_uniformizer_zpow
declarations.doc:
For the Kummer polynomial `P` associated to a primitive `p`-th root of unity,
if `w = 1 - ζ` has order `e₁` and `π ^ n P(z)` is integral, then
`P(z) ≡ z ^ p - z` modulo `π ^ (e₁ - n) B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eval_sub_pow_sub_mem_uniformizer_zpow
    (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : CyclotomicRing p ℤ ℚ →+* B) (P : Polynomial B)
    (hP : shapeProp f P)
    (π : B) (hπ : Irreducible π) (e₁ n : ℕ)
    (hw : Associated (wElt f) (π ^ e₁)) (z : K)
    (hz : ∃ b : B,
      (algebraMap B K π) ^ n * P.eval₂ (algebraMap B K) z = algebraMap B K b) :
    ∃ b : B,
      P.eval₂ (algebraMap B K) z - (z ^ p - z) =
        (algebraMap B K π) ^ ((e₁ : ℤ) - n) * algebraMap B K b

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.add_mul_correction_sModEq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09F7.** The correction term in the finite-level group law vanishes modulo
`π ^ (-2n + p e₁) B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem add_mul_correction_sModEq
    {B K : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Field K]
    [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    {p n e₁ : ℕ} {π w : B} {ξ₁ ξ₂ : K}
    (hw : Associated w (π ^ e₁))
    (hξ₁ : ξ₁ ∈ FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton B⁰
      ((algebraMap B K π) ^ (-(n : ℤ))))
    (hξ₂ : ξ₂ ∈ FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton B⁰
      ((algebraMap B K π) ^ (-(n : ℤ)))) :
    SModEq (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton B⁰
        ((algebraMap B K π) ^ (-(2 : ℤ) * n + p * e₁ : ℤ)) : Submodule B K)
      (ξ₁ + ξ₂ + (algebraMap B K w) ^ p * ξ₁ * ξ₂) (ξ₁ + ξ₂)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_finite_extension_isWeakSolution
declarations.doc:
Epp's theorem in the complete case: under the residue-field intersection
hypothesis, every finite extension at the top of a weakly unramified tower admits
a finite base extension which is a weak solution for the full tower.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_extension_isWeakSolution
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (C : Type uC)
    (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL) (M : Type uM)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [IsDomain C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra C M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra B M] [Algebra A M]
    [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsScalarTower B C M] [IsScalarTower B L M]
    [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension B C]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsExtension A C]
    [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L] [IsFractionRing C M]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p]
    [IsAlgClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B]
    (hweak : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsWeaklyUnramified A B)
    [Module.Finite L M]
    (hresidue : ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B,
      (∃ a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
          algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) a = x) ↔
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B, y ^ (p ^ n) = x) :
    ∃ (K₁ : Type uK) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : Module.Finite K K₁),
      ∃ D : IsDiscreteValuationRing.IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uC, uK, uM, uK,
          max uM uK, uK, max uM uK} A C K M K₁,
        D.IsWeakSolution

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09H4**.
Over a perfect ring `S` of exponential characteristic `p`, the polynomial `f.expand R p`
and `f` have the same number of distinct roots in `S`: the Frobenius bijection on `S`
identifies the root sets.

declarations.name: IntermediateField.bijOn_algHom_apply_of_adjoin_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09H7**.
Let `E = F(α₀, …, α_{n-1})` and let `L` be a field extension of `F`. Write
`Kᵢ = F(α₀, …, α_{i-1})` and `Pᵢ` for the minimal polynomial of `αᵢ` over `Kᵢ`. Then
`φ ↦ (φ(α₀), …, φ(α_{n-1}))` is a bijection from the `F`-embeddings `E → L` onto the tuples
`(β₀, …, β_{n-1})` for which there are `F`-embeddings `ψᵢ : Kᵢ → L` (`i ≤ n`) such that `βᵢ` is
a root of `Pᵢ` twisted by `ψᵢ`, and `ψᵢ₊₁` extends `ψᵢ` and sends `αᵢ` to `βᵢ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IntermediateField.bijOn_algHom_apply_of_adjoin_eq_top {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L]
    (α : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) (hgen : adjoin F (α '' Set.Iio n) = ⊤) :
    Set.BijOn (fun (φ : E →ₐ[F] L) (i : Fin n) ↦ φ (α i)) Set.univ
      {β | ∃ ψ : ∀ i ≤ n, adjoin F (α '' Set.Iio i) →ₐ[F] L, ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n),
        ((minpoly (adjoin F (α '' Set.Iio i)) (α i)).map (ψ i hi.le : _ →+* L)).IsRoot
          (β ⟨i, hi⟩) ∧
        (ψ (i + 1) (Order.add_one_le_of_lt hi)).comp (inclusion <| adjoin.mono _ _ _ <|
          Set.image_mono <| Set.Iio_subset_Iio (Nat.le_add_right i 1)) = ψ i hi.le ∧
        ψ (i + 1) (Order.add_one_le_of_lt hi)
          ⟨α i, Set.mem_of_subset_of_mem (subset_adjoin _ _) <|
            Set.mem_image_of_mem α <| Set.mem_Iio.2 (Nat.lt_add_one i)⟩ =
          β ⟨i, hi⟩}

declarations.name: Field.card_algHom_eq_prod_natSepDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09H8**.
Let `E = F(α₀, …, α_{n-1})` be an algebraic extension and `L` an algebraically closed field
extension of `F`. Then the number of `F`-embeddings `E → L` is the product over `i < n` of the
separable degrees of the minimal polynomials of `αᵢ` over `F(α₀, …, α_{i-1})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Field.card_algHom_eq_prod_natSepDegree (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra F L] [IsAlgClosed L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (α : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) (hgen : adjoin F (α '' Set.Iio n) = ⊤) :
    Nat.card (E →ₐ[F] L) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (minpoly (adjoin F (α '' Set.Iio i)) (α i)).natSepDegree

declarations.name: IsPurelyInseparable.exists_tower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09HI**.
A finite purely inseparable extension `E/F` of characteristic exponent `p` admits a tower of
generators: there exist `x₀, …, x_{n-1} ∈ E` whose `F`-adjunction is all of `E`, and at each
step `xᵢ` lies outside `F(x₀, …, x_{i-1})` while `xᵢ ^ p` lies inside it.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.exists_tower
    (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar F p]
    [FiniteDimensional F E] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → E), adjoin F (Set.range x) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ i, x i ∉ adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i) ∧ x i ^ p ∈ adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i)

declarations.name: IsPurelyInseparable.exists_tower_finrank_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09HI** (each step has degree `p`).
The tower of `IsPurelyInseparable.exists_tower` can be chosen so that, in addition, each step
`F(x₀, …, x_{i-1}) ⊆ F(x₀, …, x_i)` has degree `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.exists_tower_finrank_eq
    (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar F p]
    [FiniteDimensional F E] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → E), adjoin F (Set.range x) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ i, x i ∉ adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i) ∧ x i ^ p ∈ adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i) ∧
        Module.finrank (adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i)) (adjoin F (x '' Set.Iio i))⟮x i⟯ = p

declarations.name: Stacks.FieldTheory.KummerExtension.isGalois_isCyclic_finrank_dvd_and_kummerCharacter_injective_of_adjoin_root_eq_top
declarations.doc:
A field extension generated by an `n`-th root is finite Galois when the
base field contains a primitive `n`-th root of unity. Its Galois group is
cyclic, its degree divides `n`, and, for a nonzero generator, its Kummer
character is injective and is given by `σ ↦ σ(b) / b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGalois_isCyclic_finrank_dvd_and_kummerCharacter_injective_of_adjoin_root_eq_top
    (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (b : L)
    (hpow : b ^ n ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin K {b} = ⊤) :
    ∃ hfin : Module.Finite K L,
      letI := hfin
      IsGalois K L ∧ IsCyclic (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧ Module.finrank K L ∣ n ∧
        ∀ hb : b ≠ 0,
          Function.Injective
            (kummerCharacter K L n (by omega) ζ hζ b hb hpow) ∧
          ∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
            algebraMap K L
                (((kummerCharacter K L n (by omega) ζ hζ b hb hpow σ :
                    rootsOfUnity n K) : Kˣ) : K) =
              σ b / b

declarations.name: transcendental_pi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09I8**.
The real number `π` is transcendental over `ℚ`: it is not a root of any nonzero polynomial with
rational coefficients (Lindemann, *Über die Zahl π*, Math. Ann. 20 (1882), 213–225). If it were,
the conjugates `α` of `π i` would satisfy `∏ (1 + exp α) = 0`, contradicting the estimate
`LindemannWeierstrass.exp_polynomial_approx`.
declarations.statement: theorem transcendental_pi : Transcendental ℚ π

Because `π` is transcendental over `ℚ`, the simple extension `ℚ(π)` is `ℚ`-algebra isomorphic to
the field of rational functions `RatFunc ℚ`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def adjoinPiAlgEquivRatFunc : ℚ⟮π⟯ ≃ₐ[ℚ] RatFunc ℚ

The extension `ℚ(π)/ℚ` is purely transcendental, witnessed by the transcendental element `π`.

declarations.name: Transcendental.purelyTranscendental_adjoin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09I8** (immediate generalization).
If `x ∈ K` is transcendental over `k`, then the simple extension `k⟮x⟯` is purely
transcendental over `k`. The Stacks tag records the special case `Q(π)/Q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Transcendental.purelyTranscendental_adjoin
    {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x) :

declarations.name: trdeg_exp_1_pi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09I9**.
The transcendence degree of `ℚ(e, π)` over `ℚ` is either `1` or `2`.

The lower bound needs transcendence of `π`, which is `transcendental_pi` (Tag 09I8).
declarations.statement:
theorem trdeg_exp_1_pi :
    Algebra.trdeg ℚ (ℚ⟮rexp 1, π⟯) = 1 ∨ Algebra.trdeg ℚ (ℚ⟮rexp 1, π⟯) = 2

declarations.name: exists_intermediateField_purelyTranscendental_and_algebraic_ne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09IA**.
The decomposition of an extension `E/F` as a purely transcendental extension followed by an
algebraic one is not unique. Concretely, taking `E = F(t)`, both `F(t)` and `F(t^2)` are
intermediate fields that are purely transcendental over `F` and over which `E` is algebraic, yet
they are distinct.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_purelyTranscendental_and_algebraic_ne
    (F : Type u) [Field F] :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (_ : Algebra F E) (K L : IntermediateField F E),
    PurelyTranscendental F K ∧ Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E ∧
    PurelyTranscendental F L ∧ Algebra.IsAlgebraic L E ∧
    K ≠ L

declarations.name: exists_intermediateField_purelyTranscendental_and_algebraic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09IA**.
Every field extension `E/F` admits an intermediate field `F'` such that `F'/F` is
purely transcendental and `E/F'` is algebraic. (The Stacks tag also notes that this
decomposition is not unique, e.g. for `F(t)/F` one can take either `F(t)` itself or
`F(t²)` as the purely transcendental part.)
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_purelyTranscendental_and_algebraic
    (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] :
    ∃ F' : IntermediateField F E, PurelyTranscendental F F' ∧ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F' E

declarations.name: IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain_and_comap_surjective_and_quasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Variant of Krull–Akizuki.** Let `A` be a Noetherian domain of Krull dimension at most one
with fraction field `K`, let `L/K` be a finite field extension and let `C` be the integral closure
of `A` in `L`. Then `C` is a Dedekind domain, the map `Spec(C) → Spec(A)` is surjective, and `C`
is quasi-finite over `A`; the latter says that every fibre `κ(𝔭) ⊗[A] C` is a finite-dimensional
`κ(𝔭)`-vector space, whence `Spec(C) → Spec(A)` has finite fibres and induces finite residue field
extensions. Neither `A` integrally closed nor `L/K` separable is assumed, so `C` need not be a
finite `A`-algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDedekindDomain_and_comap_surjective_and_quasiFinite
    (A K L C : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Ring.DimensionLEOne A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Algebra C L] [IsScalarTower A C L] [IsIntegralClosure C A L] :
    IsDedekindDomain C ∧ Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A C)) ∧
      Algebra.QuasiFinite A C
declarations.comment:
Finite fibres and finiteness of the induced residue field extensions are packaged
as `Algebra.QuasiFinite A C`, from which they follow by name; `dim A = 1` is weakened to
`Ring.DimensionLEOne A`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.integralClosure_reducedTensorProduct_isNoetherian_and_spec_surjective
declarations.doc:
Let `A → B` be an essentially finite type extension of discrete valuation
rings with fraction fields `K → L`. If `K'/K` is algebraic and the integral
closure `A'` of `A` in `K'` is Noetherian, then the integral closure `B'` of `B`
in the reduction of `L ⊗[K] K'` is Noetherian. The canonical map
`Spec(B') → Spec(A')` is surjective and all corresponding residue field
extensions are finitely generated.
declarations.statement:
theorem integralClosure_reducedTensorProduct_isNoetherian_and_spec_surjective
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [FaithfulSMul A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType A B]
    (K' : Type v) [Field K'] [Algebra K K'] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K K']
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A K K']
    [IsNoetherianRing (integralClosure A K')] :
    let L' := (L ⊗[K] K') ⧸ nilradical (L ⊗[K] K')
    let A' := integralClosure A K'
    let B' := integralClosure B L'
    IsNoetherianRing B' ∧
      ∃ f : A' →+* B',
        (∀ x : A',
          ((B').val (f x) : L') =
            algebraMap (L ⊗[K] K') L'
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (x : K'))) ∧
        Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ∧
        ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B',
          (Ideal.ResidueField.map (q.asIdeal.comap f) q.asIdeal f rfl).EssFiniteType

declarations.name: Stacks.EliminateRamification.exists_finite_extension_isSolution
declarations.doc:
**Tag 09II.** An essentially finite type extension of discrete valuation rings admits a
finite base-field extension which is a solution.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_extension_isSolution
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsExtension A B] [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType A B] :
    ∃ (K₁ : Type uK) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Algebra K K₁) (_ : Algebra A K₁)
      (_ : IsScalarTower A K K₁) (_ : Module.Finite K K₁),
      ∃ D : IntegralClosureBaseChange.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK, max uL uK, uK, max uL uK}
        A B K L K₁,
        D.IsSolution.{uA, uB, uK, uL, uK, max uL uK, uK, max uL uK, v}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizedBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The normalized pullback of a finite-type scheme over a Dedekind domain along the
integral closure in a finite fraction-field extension, as a scheme over the pullback.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def normalizedBaseChange
    (A K L B : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsIntegralClosure B A L]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [Flat p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p] :
    let g : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    Over (pullback p g)
declarations.comment: the normalization morphism to the base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizedBaseChangeOverIntegralClosure

    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B L]

    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))

    Over (Spec (.of B))
