declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_eq
declarations.doc:
**In every degree `i`, two Čech classes in `Ȟ^i(K, 𝓕)` and `Ȟ^i(L, 𝓕)`, for hypercoverings
`K` and `L` of the final presheaf, whose images under the canonical comparison
`Ȟ^i(-, 𝓕) ⟶ H^i(𝓕)` agree restrict to the same class on a common refinement.**

The coefficients are the sheaf `𝓕` itself, not its degree-zero cohomology presheaf.  On the
common refinement `exists_hom_of_prod` the difference of the two restrictions is killed by the
comparison, so it dies after a further refinement (`exists_hom_cechCohomologyMap_apply_eq_zero`),
and on that refinement the two restrictions agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_eq (i : ℕ)
    (K L : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{max u v w} J)
    (ξK : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) K F i)
    (ξL : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) L F i)
    (h : ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{max u v w} J K i F) ξK =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{max u v w} J L i F) ξL) :
    ∃ (M : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{max u v w} J) (f : M.Hom K) (g : M.Hom L),
      ConcreteCategory.hom (f.cechCohomologyMap F i) ξK =
        ConcreteCategory.hom (g.cechCohomologyMap F i) ξL
declarations.comment: part (2) in every degree, at the hypercovering universe `max u v w`, which is what Tag 01GJ forces; the canonical map is the bottom-row edge map of the spectral sequence of Tag 09VY, i.e. the comparison of Tag 01GY. The size binders are those the chapter's presheaf-side tags carry -- sheafification, enough injectives and `HasExt` at the coefficient universe -- together with `WEqualsLocallyBijective`, a theorem for every essentially small site. See `exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq` for degree zero at a free universe `w`

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09VZ, part (1), in degree zero.**  Every degree-zero cohomology class of
an abelian sheaf is the image, under the canonical comparison `Ȟ⁰(K, 𝓕) ⟶ H⁰(𝓕)` of
[Stacks, Tag 09VY], of a degree-zero Čech class on some hypercovering `K` of the final presheaf.

A hypercovering exists by [Stacks, Tag 0DAX] applied to the identity coverings, and in degree
zero the comparison is an isomorphism, `isIso_cechCohomologyEdge_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq
    (F : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{max (max u v) (max v w)})
    (ξ : (globalCohomologyFunctor.{max u v w} J 0).obj F) :
    ∃ (K : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{max u v w} J)
      (ξK : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) K F 0),
      ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{max u v w} J K 0 F) ξK = ξ
declarations.comment: part (1) in degree i = 0, universe-general: the hypercoverings are at a free universe `w`, which is what keeps this statement from being subsumed by `exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_eq`, which has every degree but is at `max u v w` because Tag 01GJ forces it; the canonical map is the bottom-row edge map of the spectral sequence of Tag 09VY, i.e. the comparison of Tag 01GY

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09VZ, part (2), in degree zero.**  Two degree-zero Čech classes on
hypercoverings `K` and `L` of the final presheaf whose images under the canonical comparison
`Ȟ⁰(-, 𝓕) ⟶ H⁰(𝓕)` of [Stacks, Tag 09VY] agree restrict to the same class on a common
refinement.

Nothing is assumed beyond the source's hypotheses.  The common refinement is the degreewise
product, `exists_hom_of_prod`, which is what products of pairs in `C` are assumed for; that the
two restrictions then agree is
`cechCohomologyMap_apply_eq_of_cechCohomologyEdge_apply_eq`, which rests on the naturality of the
comparison in the hypercovering, `HypercoveringOf.Hom.globalCechEdge_comp_cechCohomologyMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq [HasBinaryProducts C]
    (F : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{max (max u v) (max v w)})
    (K L : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} J)
    (ξK : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) K F 0)
    (ξL : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) L F 0)
    (h : ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{w} J K 0 F) ξK =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{w} J L 0 F) ξL) :
    ∃ (M : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} J) (f : M.Hom K) (g : M.Hom L),
      ConcreteCategory.hom (f.cechCohomologyMap F 0) ξK =
        ConcreteCategory.hom (g.cechCohomologyMap F 0) ξL
declarations.comment: part (2) in degree i = 0, universe-general: the hypercoverings are at a free universe `w`, which is what keeps this statement from being subsumed by `exists_hom_cechCohomologyEdge_eq`, the same part (2) in every degree but with the hypercoverings at `max u v w`, the universe Tag 01GJ forces. The canonical map is the bottom-row edge map of the spectral sequence of Tag 09VY, i.e. the comparison of Tag 01GY, and its naturality in the hypercovering is proved, not assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09VZ, part (1), in every degree.**  Every cohomology class of an abelian
sheaf is the image, under the canonical comparison `Ȟ^i(K, 𝓕) ⟶ H^i(𝓕)` of [Stacks, Tag 09VY], of
a Čech class on some hypercovering `K` of the final presheaf.

The coefficients are the sheaf `𝓕` itself, not its degree-zero cohomology presheaf.  A
hypercovering exists by [Stacks, Tag 0DAX] applied to the identity coverings; the zeroth step of
the abutment filtration is the whole of `H^i(𝓕)` (`isIso_globalStepToAbutment_zero`), the class
descends from there to the bottom step `F^iH^i(𝓕)` after a refinement
(`exists_hom_globalStepToAbutment_eq`, whose engine is the degeneration of
`StacksFrontier/CategoryTheory/Sites/Hypercovering/GlobalDegeneration.lean`), and the bottom step is
the image of `Ȟ^i(L, 𝓕)` under the comparison
(`exists_cechCohomologyEdge_apply_eq_globalStepToAbutment_apply`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_eq (i : ℕ)
    (ξ : (globalCohomologyFunctor.{max u v w} J i).obj F) :
    ∃ (K : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{max u v w} J)
      (ξK : cechCohomology J (⊤_ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) K F i),
      ConcreteCategory.hom (cechCohomologyEdge.{max u v w} J K i F) ξK = ξ
declarations.comment: part (1) in every degree, at the hypercovering universe `max u v w`, which is what Tag 01GJ forces; the canonical map is the bottom-row edge map of the spectral sequence of Tag 09VY, i.e. the comparison of Tag 01GY. The size binders are those the chapter's presheaf-side tags carry -- sheafification, enough injectives and `HasExt` at the coefficient universe -- together with `WEqualsLocallyBijective`, a theorem for every essentially small site, which is carried here because the degeneration of the spectral sequence rests on Tag 01GJ. See `exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_cechCohomologyEdge_zero_eq` for degree zero at a free universe `w`

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.levelFunctor_isContinuous_mk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** The inclusion of the open-set site of one component into the site of
simplicial opens is continuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem levelFunctor_isContinuous_mk (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).IsContinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.levelFunctor_isCocontinuous_mk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** The inclusion of the open-set site of one component into the site of
simplicial opens is cocontinuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem levelFunctor_isCocontinuous_mk (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).IsCocontinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.inverseImageIsoComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** Pulling a sheaf back to a simplicial component is, naturally in that
sheaf, its component in the sheaf-system description.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def inverseImageIsoComponent
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
        (Type u) (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) ≅
      (sheafEquivalenceSimplicialSheafSystem X (Type u)).toEquivalence.functor ⋙
        SimplicialSheafSystem.componentFunctor X (Type u)
          (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
The lower-shriek functor from sheaves of sets on one component to sheaves of sets on the
simplicial site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriek
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) (Type u) ⥤
      Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) (Type u)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriek_adjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** Lower shriek is left adjoint to inverse image from the total
simplicial site to a component.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriek_adjunction
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    componentLowerShriek X n ⊣
      (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
        (Type u) (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriek_preservesFiniteConnectedLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** Lower shriek from a simplicial component preserves finite
connected limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentLowerShriek_preservesFiniteConnectedLimits
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (J : Type vC) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [IsConnected J] :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape J (componentLowerShriek X n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriekAb
declarations.doc:
Lower shriek from sheaves of abelian groups on a component to sheaves of abelian groups on
the total simplicial site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriekAb
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) Ab.{u} ⥤
      Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{u}

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriekAb_adjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0.** Abelian lower shriek is left adjoint to restriction from
the total simplicial site to a component.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriekAb_adjunction
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    componentLowerShriekAb X n ⊣
      (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentLowerShriekAb_exact
declarations.doc: **Stacks 09W0.** Abelian lower shriek from a component of a simplicial space is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentLowerShriekAb_exact
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    [∀ F : (Opens (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{w},
      (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    [HasSheafify (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w}] :
    exactFunctor
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) Ab.{w})
      (Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w})
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))) Ab.{w}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X))

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.exactFunctor_componentLowerShriekAb
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W0**, part (5): `g_{n!}` is exact.  This is `componentLowerShriekAb_exact` for
the registered functor `componentLowerShriekAb` and with no hypotheses: on the small site of
opens of a topological space, with coefficients in abelian groups of the same universe, both
the left Kan extensions and the sheafification used to build lower shriek exist.
declarations.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_componentLowerShriekAb (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    exactFunctor
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) Ab.{u})
      (Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{u})
      (componentLowerShriekAb X n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentRestrictionAb_preservesInjectiveObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W1.** Restriction of abelian sheaves from the site of a simplicial space to the
site of one of its degrees preserves injective objects: it is right adjoint to lower shriek,
which is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRestrictionAb_preservesInjectiveObjects
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    [∀ F : (Opens (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{w},
      (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    [HasSheafify (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w}]
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) Ab.{w}] :
    ((levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{w}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)).PreservesInjectiveObjects
declarations.comment: restriction to a degree preserves injectives

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.injective_component
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W1.** If `I` is an injective abelian sheaf on the site of a simplicial space `X`,
then its degree-`n` component `I n` is an injective abelian sheaf on `X n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_component (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    [∀ F : (Opens (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{w},
      (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    [HasSheafify (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w}]
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))) Ab.{w}]
    (E : SheafSystemEquivalence X Ab.{w})
    (I : Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w}) [Injective I] :
    Injective ((E.toEquivalence.functor.obj I).component (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.componentPullbackNaturalityIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W2.** Restriction to the `n`-th component commutes, naturally in the sheaf, with
inverse image along a map of simplicial spaces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPullbackNaturalityIso
    {X Y : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (n : ℕ) :
    letI : IsMorphismOfSites.{u} (SimplicialOpen.pullback f)
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology Y) :=
        SimplicialOpen.pullback_isMorphismOfSites f
    (levelFunctor X (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
        (Type u) (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) ⋙
      TopCat.Sheaf.pullback (Type u) (f.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))) ≅
    (SimplicialOpen.pullback f).sheafPullback
        (Type u) (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X)
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology Y) ⋙
      (levelFunctor Y (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
        (Type u) (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Y.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology Y)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantSiteFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor from the simplicial-open site of the constant simplicial space to
the site of open subsets of its value.
declarations.statement:
def constantSiteFunctor (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    SimplicialOpen (constantSpace X) ⥤ Opens X

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantSiteFunctor_isContinuous
declarations.doc: The constant-site functor preserves sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem constantSiteFunctor_isContinuous (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    (constantSiteFunctor X).IsContinuous
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology (constantSpace X))
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantSiteFunctor_isCocontinuous
declarations.doc: The constant-site functor lifts covers.
declarations.statement:
theorem constantSiteFunctor_isCocontinuous (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    (constantSiteFunctor X).IsCocontinuous
      (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology (constantSpace X))
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantMorphism_inverseImage_isoRestriction
declarations.doc:
The canonical morphism has inverse image given by restriction along the
constant-site functor, naturally in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def constantMorphism_inverseImage_isoRestriction (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    (constantMorphism X).inverseImage ≅
    (constantSiteFunctor X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology (constantSpace X))
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
declarations.comment: inverse image is restriction along the functor

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantMorphism_inverseImage_component
declarations.doc:
Inverse image of a sheaf is the same sheaf in every simplicial degree,
naturally in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def constantMorphism_inverseImage_component (X : TopCat.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    (constantMorphism X).inverseImage ⋙
      (sheafEquivalenceSimplicialSheafSystem (constantSpace X)
        (Type u)).toEquivalence.functor ⋙
        SimplicialSheafSystem.componentFunctor (constantSpace X) (Type u) n ≅
      𝟭 (TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantMorphism_inverseImage_transition
declarations.doc:
The component identifications respect every cosimplicial transition: the
transition maps of inverse image become identity maps of the original sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem constantMorphism_inverseImage_transition (X : TopCat.{u})
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X) {n m : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (φ : n ⟶ m)
    (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    let S := (sheafEquivalenceSimplicialSheafSystem (constantSpace X)
        (Type u)).toEquivalence.functor.obj
        ((constantMorphism X).inverseImage.obj F)
    (S.transition φ).app V ≫
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget (Type u) X).map
        ((constantMorphism_inverseImage_component X n).app F).hom).app V =
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget (Type u) X).map
        ((constantMorphism_inverseImage_component X m).app F).hom).app V

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantLowerShriek
declarations.doc: Lower shriek takes the degree-zero sheaf.
declarations.comment: part (2): lower shriek is the degree-zero component

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantLowerShriek_adjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W3.** Lower shriek is left adjoint to the inverse image of the constant
morphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def constantLowerShriek_adjunction (X : TopCat.{u}) :
    constantLowerShriek X ⊣ (constantMorphism X).inverseImage

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.constantMorphism_pushforwardEqualizer
declarations.doc:
The direct image of a sheaf on the constant simplicial space is the
equalizer of its two vertex transition maps from degree zero to degree one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def constantMorphism_pushforwardEqualizer (X : TopCat.{u})
    (G : Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology (constantSpace X)) (Type u)) :
    (constantMorphism X).pushforward.obj G ≅
      equalizer (constantFaceMap X G 0) (constantFaceMap X G 1)
declarations.comment: part (3): direct image as an equalizer

registrations.name: augmentationMorphism
registrations.comment: the morphism of topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.augmentationMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism from the topos of a simplicial space to that of its augmentation target,
with the coherent component identifications from the construction in the source proof.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def augmentationMorphism
    (a : Y ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const TopCat).obj X) :
    AugmentationMorphismData Y X a

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_component
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W4 (1).** Inverse image along the augmentation restricts in degree `n`
to inverse image along the component map `a_n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_component
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    (augmentationMorphism Y X a).inverseImage ⋙
      (sheafEquivalenceSimplicialSheafSystem Y (Type u)).toEquivalence.functor ⋙
        SimplicialSheafSystem.componentFunctor Y (Type u) n ≅
      TopCat.Sheaf.pullback (Type u) (a.app n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_transition
declarations.doc:
The inverse-image component isomorphisms intertwine every system transition with
the canonical map between pullbacks induced by the augmentation equation.
declarations.statement:
theorem augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_transition (F : TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X)
    {n m : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (φ : n ⟶ m) (V : (Opens (Y.obj m))ᵒᵖ) :
    let S := (sheafEquivalenceSimplicialSheafSystem Y (Type u)).toEquivalence.functor.obj
      ((augmentationMorphism Y X a).inverseImage.obj F)
    (S.transition φ).app V ≫
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget (Type u) (Y.obj n)).map
          ((augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_component Y X a n).app F).hom).app
            (op ((Opens.map (Y.map φ)).obj V.unop)) =
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget (Type u) (Y.obj m)).map
        ((augmentationMorphism_inverseImage_component Y X a m).app F).hom).app V ≫
          (augmentationPullbackTransition Y X a F φ).app V

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.augmentationMorphism_comp_component
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W4 (3).** The composite of the component inclusion and the augmentation
agrees with the topological morphism induced by `a_n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def augmentationMorphism_comp_component (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    (augmentationMorphism Y X a).inverseImage ⋙
      (levelFunctor Y n).sheafPullbackCocontinuous (Type u)
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Y.obj n))
        (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology Y) ≅
      TopCat.Sheaf.pullback (Type u) (a.app n)
declarations.comment: part (3): composition with a component inclusion

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.augmentationMorphism_pushforwardEqualizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W4 (4).** The direct image of a sheaf on the simplicial site is the
equalizer of the two degree-one transition maps on direct images.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def augmentationMorphism_pushforwardEqualizer
    (G : Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology Y) (Type u)) :
    (augmentationMorphism Y X a).pushforward.obj G ≅
      equalizer (augmentationFaceMap Y X a G 0) (augmentationFaceMap Y X a G 1)
declarations.comment: part (4): direct image as an equalizer

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.w
registrations.comment: part (2): compatibility of augmentation maps

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.freeAbelianRepresentableComplex_quasiIso_constant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W5.** The alternating face-map complex of the free abelian presheaves represented
by `X_n`, augmented towards the constant presheaf of integers, is a resolution in abelian
presheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem freeAbelianRepresentableComplex_quasiIso_constant
    (X : SimplicialObject TopCat.{u}) :
    QuasiIso (AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε.app
      (augmentedFreeAbelianPresheaf X))

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.cohomologySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W6.**  For an abelian sheaf `F` on the site of a simplicial topological space `X`
there is a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence, functorial in `F`: the second spectral
sequence of the double complex `A^{q,p} = I^q(X_p)` of a chosen injective resolution of `F`,
presented from its first page.  Its first page is `cohomologySpectralSequence_pageOneIso`, and its
convergence to `H^{p+q}(X_Zar, F)` is `cohomologySpectralSequence_abutment`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologySpectralSequence :
    Sheaf (SimplicialOpen.grothendieckTopology X) Ab.{w} ⥤
      CohomologicalSpectralSequenceNat Ab.{w} 1
declarations.comment: the spectral sequence, functorial in the abelian sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.cohomologySpectralSequence_pageOneIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W6.**  The first page of the spectral sequence of a simplicial topological space
is `E_1^{p,q} = H^q(X_p, F_p)`, the sheaf cohomology of the restriction of `F` to the space in
simplicial degree `p`, naturally in the abelian sheaf `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologySpectralSequence_pageOneIso (q : ℕ) :
    pageOneFunctor.{u, w} X n q ≅ componentCohomologyFunctor.{u, w} X n q
declarations.comment: the first page is H^q(X_p, F_p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.cohomologySpectralSequence_abutment
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09W6, the convergence.**  The spectral sequence of a simplicial topological space,
with first page `E_1^{p,q} = H^q(X_p, F_p)`, converges to `H^{p+q}(X_Zar, F)`, functorially in the
abelian sheaf `F`: for every `n` there is a finite decreasing filtration of
`H^n(X_Zar, F) = R^nΓ(X_Zar, F)`, natural in `F`, which is the whole group in step `0` and zero in
step `n + 1`, and whose graded pieces are naturally the terms `E_∞^{p,n-p}` of the infinity page.

The filtration is the one the filtration of the total complex of `A^{q,p} = I^q(X_p)` by the
simplicial degree induces on its cohomology (`simplicialFunctorialAbutment`); that cohomology is
`H^n(X_Zar, F)` by `cohomologySpectralSequence_abutmentIso`.
declarations.comment: convergence to H^{p+q}(X_Zar, F), functorially in the abelian sheaf

declarations.name: StacksRelocalization.isMorphismOfSites_overPullback
declarations.doc:
The functor `v = Over.pullback f : C/V ⥤ C/U`, given on objects by `X/V ↦ X ×_V U / U`,
defines a morphism of sites `C/U → C/V`: it is continuous, and the induced pullback on sheaves of
sets is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMorphismOfSites_overPullback :
    (Over.pullback f).IsMorphismOfSites (J.over V) (J.over U)

declarations.name: StacksRelocalization.sheafPushforwardOverMapIso
declarations.doc:
The pushforward `j_*` of the morphism of topoi attached to the continuous and cocontinuous
functor `j = Over.map f` agrees with the pushforward `v^s` of the morphism of sites given by
`v = Over.pullback f`; that is, the two morphisms of topoi coincide.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafPushforwardOverMapIso :
    (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type u) (J.over U) (J.over V) ≅
      (Over.pullback f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) (J.over V) (J.over U)

declarations.name: StacksRelocalization.sheafPullbackOverPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
The pullback `v_s = f⁻¹` of the morphism of sites given by `v = Over.pullback f` is the
restriction functor `j⁻¹` along `j = Over.map f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafPullbackOverPullbackIso :
    (Over.pullback f).sheafPullback (Type u) (J.over V) (J.over U) ≅
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) (J.over U) (J.over V)

declarations.name: StacksRelocalization.sheafPushforwardObjEquiv
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf `F` on `C/U` the sections of `j_*F` over an object `X/V` of `C/V` are the sections
of `F` over `X ×_V U / U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafPushforwardObjEquiv (F : Sheaf (J.over U) (Type u)) (X : Over V) :
    (((Over.map f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type u) (J.over U) (J.over V)).obj F).obj.obj
        (op X) ≃
      F.obj.obj (op ((Over.pullback f).obj X))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialCoverings.total_isSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WD.** If the transition functors in a simplicial family of sites are
cocontinuous and satisfy property P, then the componentwise covering families make its
Grothendieck construction into a site.
declarations.statement:
theorem total_isSite (F : SimplicialObject Cat.{v, u})
    (Cov : ∀ n, Covering.{u, v, max u v} (F.obj n) → Prop)
    (hsite : ∀ n, IsSite (Cov n))
    (_hcocont : IsCocontinuous F Cov)
    (hP : ∀ {m n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (f : m ⟶ n),
      Functor.HasCoverPullbacks (F.map f).toFunctor (Cov m) (Cov n)) :
    IsSite (total F Cov)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing simplicial-site situation of Stacks 09WE. The left summand is case (A), in
which transitions are morphisms of sites represented by continuous functors; the right summand
is case (B), in which transitions are cocontinuous functors satisfying property P.
declarations.statement: structure SimplicialSiteSituation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.transitionMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism of topoi `f_φ : Sh(C_n) → Sh(C_m)` induced by a simplex map
`φ : [m] → [n]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def transitionMorphism (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) (Type u))
      (Sheaf (S.componentTopology m) (Type u))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.totalTopology
declarations.doc:
The topology of the total site: it is generated by covering families lying in one
simplicial degree.
declarations.statement:
def totalTopology (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) :
    GrothendieckTopology S.totalCategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.fiberTransitionModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF** for sheaves of modules: the transition `f_φ^*ℱₘ ⟶ ℱₙ` between the
restrictions of a sheaf of `O`-modules to the components of degrees `m` and `n`, obtained as the
mate of the direct-image transition under the pullback-pushforward adjunction of the transition
morphism of ringed topoi. This is the map the source writes `f_φ^*ℱₘ → ℱₙ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fiberTransitionModules (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (S.totalRingSheaf O)) :
    ((S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj
        ((S.componentModuleRestriction (S.totalRingSheaf O) m).obj M) ⟶
      (S.componentModuleRestriction (S.totalRingSheaf O) n).obj M

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.fiberTransitionModules_id
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF for sheaves of modules: the unit law.** The transition of the restrictions of
a sheaf of `O`-modules attached to an identity simplex map is the canonical identification of
`f_𝟙^*` with the identity functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberTransitionModules_id (n : SimplexCategory)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (S.totalRingSheaf O)) :
    S.fiberTransitionModules O (𝟙 n) M =
      (S.transitionPullbackModulesIdIso O n).hom.app
        ((S.componentModuleRestriction (S.totalRingSheaf O) n).obj M)
declarations.comment: the unit law for the transition of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.fiberTransitionModules_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF for sheaves of modules: the cocycle law.** The transition of the restrictions
of a sheaf of `O`-modules attached to a composite simplex map is the composite of the two
transitions, compared by the pullback compositor of Stacks 09WE.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberTransitionModules_comp {l m n : SimplexCategory} (ψ : l ⟶ m) (φ : m ⟶ n)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (S.totalRingSheaf O)) :
    S.fiberTransitionModules O (ψ ≫ φ) M =
      (S.transitionPullbackModulesCompIso O ψ φ).hom.app
          ((S.componentModuleRestriction (S.totalRingSheaf O) l).obj M) ≫
        (S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).toModulesHom.pullbackModules.map
            (S.fiberTransitionModules O ψ M) ≫
          S.fiberTransitionModules O φ M
declarations.comment: the cocycle law for the transition of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.totalPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF.** The presentation of the sheaves on the total site as systems on the
component topoi, with no hypotheses: the system of restrictions is an equivalence. The
equivalence `Sh(C_total) ≌ SimplicialSheafSystem (componentPseudofunctor S)` of the tag is its
`totalEquivalence` field.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalPresentation (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) :
    SimplicialSheafPresentation S

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.totalPresentation_transition_restriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF.** The transition of the system attached to a sheaf on the total site is the
inverse-image transition of its restrictions: under the identification of the components of the
system with those restrictions, `transition` is `fiberTransition`.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalPresentation_transition_restriction (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (F : Sheaf S.totalTopology (Type u)) {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    (totalPresentation S).transition F φ ≫
        ((totalPresentation S).componentRestrictionIso F n).hom =
      (S.transitionMorphism φ).inverseImage.map
          ((totalPresentation S).componentRestrictionIso F m).hom ≫
        (S.fiberTransition φ).app F

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.fiberRestrictionData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09WF.** The fibre restrictions of a sheaf on the total site of a
simplicial site, together with their specified transitions.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fiberRestrictionData (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) :
    FiberRestrictionData S
declarations.comment: fibre restrictions and their specified transitions

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.fiberTransition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WF.** The inverse-image transition on the restrictions of a total-site sheaf: the
mate of `restrictTransition` under the topos adjunction of `f_φ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fiberTransition (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    S.restrict m ⋙ (S.transitionMorphism φ).inverseImage ⟶ S.restrict n

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialSheafPresentation.systemTransition_id
declarations.doc: The lax unit law of a system, read off on the component in degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem systemTransition_id {S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}}
    (P : SimplicialSheafPresentation S) (F : SimplicialSheafSystem P.diagram)
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    P.systemTransition F (𝟙 n) =
      (canonicalIdentityComparison S n).hom.app (P.systemComponent F n)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialSheafPresentation.systemTransition_comp
declarations.doc:
The lax composition law of a system, read off on the component in degree `l`: the
transition attached to a composite simplex map is the composite of the two transitions,
compared by the canonical inverse-image compositor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem systemTransition_comp {S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}}
    (P : SimplicialSheafPresentation S) (F : SimplicialSheafSystem P.diagram)
    {l m n : SimplexCategory} (ψ : l ⟶ m) (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    P.systemTransition F (ψ ≫ φ) =
      (canonicalCompositionComparison S ψ φ).hom.app (P.systemComponent F l) ≫
        (S.transitionMorphism φ).inverseImage.map (P.systemTransition F ψ) ≫
          P.systemTransition F φ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_preservesLimitsOfShape
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG (4).** Lower shriek from one component of a simplicial site to the total site
commutes with finite connected limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentLowerShriek_preservesLimitsOfShape (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) (L : Type) [SmallCategory L] [FinCategory L] [IsConnected L] :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape L (componentLowerShriek.{u, u} S n)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_exactFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG (7)** for an arbitrary simplicial-site situation: lower shriek from a
simplicial component is exact on abelian sheaves.

The coefficients here are the abelian groups of the site's own universe. The source says
nothing about universes, and the independent coefficient
universe is not reachable: in case (A) the `isMorphismOfSites` field of
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite` fixes the sheaf-value universe of
`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsMorphismOfSites` to the site universe, so Situation 09WE supplies no
morphism of topoi at any other, and Stacks 04JC — which is the source's own Case A argument —
has no input there.

This declaration carries the tag. An independent
coefficient universe is not part of what Stacks 09WG asserts, on three
grounds: the source states clause (7) as *"$g_{n!}$ is exact"* with no universe quantifier at all;
clause (6), `Stmt_09WG__abelian_sum_formula`, which is the
stated *input* of clause (7)'s one-sentence proof, is stated with
`universe u` only and has its conclusion at `Ab.{u}`; and the extra universe is unreachable
from the data Situation 09WE carries, as the paragraph above establishes. So the statement proved
here is the source's clause (7).

The neighbouring clause `09WH__component_injective` is different: its case (A) is not proved
here at all, and whether `ComponentInjective`/`ComponentKInjective` generalise is open. The two are not
symmetric — case (A) of clause (7) *is* proved above.
declarations.statement:
lemma componentLowerShriek_exactFunctor (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    exactFunctor
      (Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) Ab.{u})
      (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})
      (sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (componentFunctor S n) Ab.{u}
        (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG.** The canonical inclusion of the category in simplicial degree `n` into the
total category.
declarations.statement:
def componentFunctor (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    S.component n ⥤ S.totalCategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor_isCocontinuous
declarations.doc: **Stacks 09WG.** The inclusion of a component in the total site is cocontinuous.
declarations.statement:
instance componentFunctor_isCocontinuous (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (componentFunctor S n).IsCocontinuous (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor_pullbacksPreservedBy_inl
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG**, case (A). The inclusion of a component into the total category preserves
the pullback of any two members of a covering family of that component.

This is the pullback clause of the continuity criterion of Stacks 00WW for the component
inclusion, and it is what `CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor_isContinuous`
feeds to that criterion in case (A). It is stated separately because a functor out of the total
category also needs it: for a morphism between simplicial sites in the continuous case, the
functor between the total categories is continuous because the component inclusions are, and
the argument goes through the preserved pullback of this lemma rather than through continuity
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentFunctor_pullbacksPreservedBy_inl (C : SimplicialSite.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (C.coverage n).PullbacksPreservedBy
      (componentFunctor (⟨Sum.inl C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor_isContinuous
declarations.doc: **Stacks 09WG.** The inclusion of a component in the total site is continuous.
declarations.statement:
instance componentFunctor_isContinuous (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (componentFunctor S n).IsContinuous (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG.** The morphism `g_n : Sh(C_n) ⟶ Sh(C_total)` induced by the cocontinuous
component inclusion.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentMorphism (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory)
    [(componentFunctor S n).IsCocontinuous (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology] :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) (Type u))
      (Sheaf S.totalTopology (Type u))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
The lower-shriek functor from sheaves on a simplicial component to sheaves on the total
site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriek (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory)
    [HasWeakSheafify S.totalTopology (Type w)]
    [∀ G : (S.component n)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w, (componentFunctor S n).op.HasLeftKanExtension G] :
    Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) (Type w) ⥤ Sheaf S.totalTopology (Type w)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_adjunction
declarations.doc:
The lower-shriek functor is left adjoint to inverse image along the morphism of topoi
associated to a simplicial component.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriek_adjunction (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    componentLowerShriek.{u, u} S n ⊣ (componentMorphism S n).inverseImage

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_restrictIsoCoproduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG, the sheaf coproduct formula.** On a simplicial site, the degree-`m`
restriction of lower shriek from degree `n` of a sheaf of sets is the coproduct, over the
simplex maps `φ : [n] ⟶ [m]`, of the inverse images of that sheaf along the transitions.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriek_restrictIsoCoproduct (n m : SimplexCategory)
    (G : Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) (Type u)) :
    (componentMorphism S m).inverseImage.obj ((componentLowerShriek.{u, u} S n).obj G) ≅
      ∐ fun φ : n ⟶ m => (S.transitionMorphism φ).inverseImage.obj G

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriekRestrictionIsoCoproduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WG, the abelian sum formula.** On a simplicial site, lower shriek on abelian
sheaves from simplicial degree `n`, restricted back to degree `m`, is naturally the direct sum
over the simplex maps `φ : [n] ⟶ [m]` of the inverse images along the transitions.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentLowerShriekRestrictionIsoCoproduct
    (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n m : SimplexCategory) :
    sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (componentFunctor S n) Ab.{u}
        (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology ⋙
      (componentFunctor S m).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
        (S.componentTopology m) S.totalTopology ≅
      ∐ fun φ : n ⟶ m => transitionInverseImageAb S φ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.injective_componentRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WH**, first assertion: the restriction of an injective abelian sheaf on the total
site of a simplicial-site situation to a component is injective.

Restriction to the component is right adjoint to lower shriek, which is exact by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_exactFunctor` and so preserves
monomorphisms; Mathlib's `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.map_injective` is then the Homology 015Z
step. Exactness holds for an arbitrary situation, so no case distinction is made.

Coefficients sit at the site universe: at an independent coefficient universe the adjunction used
here is not available from the data of a situation, since neither `HasLeftKanExtension` nor
`HasWeakSheafify S.totalTopology Ab` holds there in general.
declarations.statement:
lemma injective_componentRestriction (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory)
    (Inj : Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) [Injective Inj] :
    Injective ((S.restrictAb n).obj Inj)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isKInjective_componentRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09WH**, second assertion: restriction of a K-injective complex of abelian sheaves
on the total site of a simplicial-site situation to a component is K-injective.

Restriction to the component is right adjoint to lower shriek, which is exact by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentLowerShriek_exactFunctor`, and
`CochainComplex.isKInjective_mapHomologicalComplex_of_exact` is the Stacks 08BJ step. Exactness
is available for an arbitrary situation, so no case distinction is made.

Coefficients sit at the site universe, as in the first assertion and for the same reason.
declarations.statement:
theorem isKInjective_componentRestriction (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (n : SimplexCategory)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      (((S.restrictAb n).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
