The sections over `u_i(X_i)` of the colimit `colim f_i^{-1}F_i` of a system of
  sheaves on an inverse system of sites are the filtered colimit of the sections `F_j(u_a(X_i))`
  over the arrows `a : j → i`.

declarations.name: Stacks.WeakSites.ColimitSiteCohomology.cohomologyCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YP, the canonical cohomology diagram and its cocone.** In the situation of
Stacks 0EXZ, with the functors `uC i` exhibiting `C` as the colimit of the sites of the system
(Stacks 09YL and 0A35) and with `𝒢 = colim fᵢ⁻¹Fᵢ`, the cohomology groups `Hᵖ(u_a(X), F_j)`
over the arrows `a : j ⟶ i` form a diagram whose arrows are the canonical cohomology maps,
together with the canonical cocone at `Hᵖ(uᵢ(X), 𝒢)`.
declarations.statement: public def cohomologyCocone : CohomologyCocone.{v, u, max u v w, max u v w} D uC hu K F 𝒢 ι i X p
declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings): canonical cohomology diagram and cocone

declarations.name: Stacks.WeakSites.ColimitSiteCohomology.isColimitCohomologyCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YP.** In the situation of Stacks 0EXZ, set `𝒢 = colim fᵢ⁻¹Fᵢ`. For every index
`i`, every object `X` of the site at `i` and every `p`, the cohomology `Hᵖ(uᵢ(X), 𝒢)` is the
filtered colimit, over the arrows `a : j ⟶ i`, of the cohomology groups `Hᵖ(u_a(X), F_j)`: the
canonical cocone is a colimit cocone. The case `p = 0` is Stacks 09YN.

The colimit structure is a choice; it is unique, `CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit` being a
subsingleton.
declarations.statement:
public def isColimitCohomologyCocone
    (E : CohomologyCocone.{v, u, max u v w, max u v w} D uC hu K F 𝒢 ι i X p :=
      cohomologyCocone.{v, u, w} D uC hu hobj hhom hhom_inj K hK F 𝒢 ι hcolim
        i X p) :
    IsColimit E.cocone
declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings): the canonical cocone is a colimit cocone

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.transitionImage_isoLevelTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YQ, the diagram values.** The transition image of `X_i` at a level `j` below `i`
is `X_j`: the value of the cohomology diagram at `a : j ⟶ i` is the cohomology of `F_j` over the
terminal object of the site of `X_j`, that is over `X_j` itself.
declarations.comment: the affine case: the transition image of the terminal object `X_i` is the terminal object `X_j`, so the value of the cohomology diagram at `a : j ⟶ i` is the cohomology over `X_j`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.toLimitImage_isoLimitTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YQ, the cocone vertex.** The image of `X_i` in the site of the limit is `X`: the
vertex of the cohomology cocone is the cohomology of `𝒢` over the terminal object of the site of
`X`, that is over `X` itself.
declarations.comment: the affine case: the image of the terminal object `X_i` in the site of the limit is the terminal object `X`, so the vertex of the cohomology cocone is the cohomology over `X`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YQ, the affine case.** Let `I` be a directed set, let `(X_i)` be an inverse system
of *affine* schemes over `I` with affine transition morphisms, and let `X = lim X_i`. Let `F` be a
system of abelian sheaves on the small affine etale sites of the `X_i`, let `𝒢` on the small
affine etale site of `X` present the colimit `colim f_i^{-1} F_i`, and let `p` be a degree. Then
`H^p(X, 𝒢)` is the filtered colimit, over the arrows `a : j ⟶ i`, of the groups `H^p(X_j, F_j)`:
the canonical cocone is a colimit cocone.

The base object is `levelTerminal i`, which is `X_i` (`levelTerminal_isTerminal`); its image in
the site of the limit is `X` (`toLimitImage_isoLimitTerminal`) and its transition image at a
level `j` is `X_j` (`transitionImage_isoLevelTerminal`), so the vertex and the values of the
diagram are the cohomology groups of the schemes of the system.

This is Stacks 09YP, applied to the colimit of sites of Stacks 0EYL through
`mem_limitSitePrecoverage_iff` and the three descent clauses above.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine
    (F : InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.AbelianSheafSystem.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc))
    (𝒢 : Sheaf (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX).toGrothendieck Ab.{max u v + 1})
    (ι : ∀ j, (F.obj j).obj ⟶ (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc j).op ⋙ 𝒢.obj)
    (hcolim : IsColimitPresentation.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc) (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc)
      (toLimitSmall_transition D c B hD hX hc) (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX) F 𝒢 ι)
    (i : (sys D c B hD hX hc).I) (p : ℕ)
    (E : CohomologyCocone.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc) (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc)
      (toLimitSmall_transition D c B hD hX hc) (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX) F 𝒢 ι i
      (levelTerminal D c B hD hX hc i) p) :
    IsColimit E.cocone
declarations.comment: the affine case: the schemes `X_i` of the system are affine, so that `X_i` is itself an object of its own small affine etale site and is the terminal one; the sites are the small AFFINE etale sites and the cohomology of THIS statement is the right-derived `sheafSections` of Stacks 09YP on them. The comparison across Stacks 04HR that turns those groups into the library's mainstream etale cohomology of a scheme is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.limitCohomologyFunctorIsoEtaleCohomology` at the limit and `...levelTerminalCohomologyIsoEtaleCohomology` at a level

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine_colimitSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YQ in the affine case, with the colimit sheaf constructed.** Let `(X_i)` be an
inverse system of affine schemes with affine transitions, `X = lim X_i`, and let `F` be a system
of abelian sheaves on their small affine etale sites. Then

`H^p(X, colim_i f_i^{-1} F_i) = colim_i H^p(X_i, F_i)`.

This is `etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine` with the sheaf presenting the colimit, its
legs and its universal property no longer hypotheses but the constructions `colimitSheaf`,
`colimitSheafLegs` and `isColimitPresentation_colimitSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine_colimitSheaf
    (E : CohomologyCocone.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1} (sys D c B hD hX hc)
      (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc) (toLimitSmall_transition D c B hD hX hc)
      (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX) F (colimitSheaf D c B hD hX hc F)
      (colimitSheafLegs D c B hD hX hc F) i (levelTerminal D c B hD hX hc i) p :=
      cohomologyCoconeOfColimitSheaf D c B hD hX hc F i p) :
    IsColimit E.cocone
declarations.comment: the affine case with the colimit sheaf CONSTRUCTED: the sheaf `𝒢` presenting `colim f_i^{-1} F_i` on the site of the limit, its legs and its universal property are the left Kan extension of the system and are no longer hypotheses. The system `F` itself is still given, and the cohomology of THIS statement is the right-derived `sheafSections` of Stacks 09YP on the small AFFINE etale sites; `AffineLimitCohomology.etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine_etaleVertex` is the same colimit with its vertex the library's mainstream etale cohomology of the limit.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.QcqsLimitCohomology.etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YQ for arbitrary levels, over an arbitrary object of a level.** Let `I` be a
directed set, let `(X_i)` be an inverse system of schemes over `I` whose transition morphisms are
affine, and let `X = lim X_i`. Let `F` be a system of abelian sheaves on the small affine etale
sites of the `X_i`, let `𝒢` on the small affine etale site of `X` present the colimit
`colim f_i^{-1} F_i`, let `Z` be an object of the small affine etale site of `X_i` and let `p` be
a degree. Then `H^p(Z_X, 𝒢)`, the cohomology over the image of `Z` in the site of the limit, is
the filtered colimit, over the arrows `a : j ⟶ i`, of the groups `H^p(Z_j, F_j)` over the
transition images of `Z`: the canonical cocone is a colimit cocone.

The schemes `X_i` are arbitrary here; only the transition morphisms are affine. This is Stacks
09YP, in its weak-system form, applied to the colimit of sites of Stacks 0EYL through
`mem_limitSitePrecoverage_iff` and the three descent clauses of that file, none of which uses any
affineness of the levels.

Specialized to affine `X_i` and `Z` the terminal object of the site of `X_i`, the objects carrying
the cohomology are `X_j` and `X`, which is the affine case
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology.etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit_of_affine`. For a
merely quasi-compact and quasi-separated `X_i` there is no such terminal object, and the passage
from the charts `Z` to `X_i` is the Cech / Mayer-Vietoris step along a finite affine cover; this
file supplies only its covering input,
`exists_finite_jointlySurjective_smallAffineEtale`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyColimit_isColimit
    (F : InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.AbelianSheafSystem.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc))
    (𝒢 : Sheaf (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX).toGrothendieck Ab.{max u v + 1})
    (ι : ∀ j, (F.obj j).obj ⟶ (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc j).op ⋙ 𝒢.obj)
    (hcolim : IsColimitPresentation.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc) (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc)
      (toLimitSmall_transition D c B hD hX hc) (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX) F 𝒢 ι)
    (i : (sys D c B hD hX hc).I) (Z : (sys D c B hD hX hc).C i) (p : ℕ)
    (E : CohomologyCocone.{v, v, max u v + 1, max u v + 1}
      (sys D c B hD hX hc) (toLimitSmall D c B hD hX hc)
      (toLimitSmall_transition D c B hD hX hc) (limitSitePrecoverage D c B hX) F 𝒢 ι i Z p) :
    IsColimit E.cocone
declarations.comment: the general case of the levels: the schemes `X_i` are arbitrary — only the transition morphisms are affine — and the cohomology is taken over an arbitrary object `Z` of the small affine etale site of `X_i`, whose transition images and whose image in the site of the limit carry the groups of the diagram and the vertex. For an affine `X_i` the terminal object of that site is `X_i` itself and this specializes to the affine case already recorded in `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.AffineLimitCohomology`; for a merely quasi-compact and quasi-separated `X_i`, which is NOT an object of its own small affine etale site, the identification of this cohomology with `H^p(X_i, F_i)` is the Cech / Mayer-Vietoris descent along a finite affine cover and is NOT performed here — only the covering input is, in `exists_finite_jointlySurjective_smallAffineEtale`. The sites are the small AFFINE etale sites and the cohomology is the right-derived `sheafSections` of the weak-system Stacks 09YP on them, not the library's mainstream etale cohomology of a scheme, the comparison across Stacks 04HR not being performed here. No hypothesis of this statement is an instance of its own conclusion.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.EtaleSheafSystem.isSystemColimit_etaleCohomologyPullback
declarations.doc:
**Étale cohomology commutes with limits of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine
transition morphisms** ([Stacks, Tag 09YQ]). Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed
inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms,
`(F_i, φ_{i'i})` a system of abelian sheaves on the small étale sites of the `X_i`, and
`ι_i : f_i⁻¹F_i ⟶ 𝓕` a colimit of the system of the inverse images on the small étale site of
`X`. Then for every `p` the pull back maps `H^p(X_i, F_i) ⟶ H^p(X, 𝓕)` exhibit `H^p(X, 𝓕)` as
the colimit of the system of the `H^p(X_i, F_i)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem EtaleSheafSystem.isSystemColimit_etaleCohomologyPullback (p : ℕ)
    (F : EtaleSheafSystem D Ab.{u + 1}) (𝓕 : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology c.pt) Ab.{u + 1})
    (ι : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, (smallEtalePullbackAb (c.π.app i)).obj (F.obj i) ⟶ 𝓕)
    (hι : LimitHigherDirectImage.IsPullbackCocone c F ι)
    (hpres : LimitHigherDirectImage.IsPullbackColimitPresentation c 𝓕 F ι) :
    IsSystemColimit (fun i => AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} (F.obj i) p))
      (fun a => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (etaleCohomologyPullback (D.map a) (F.map a) p))
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} 𝓕 p))
      (fun i => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (etaleCohomologyPullback (c.π.app i) (ι i) p))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.SmallEtaleLimitCohomology.isCohomologyColimit_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 09YQ] on Mathlib's small étale sites, in every degree, unconditionally.** Let
`I` be a nonempty directed index, let `(X_i)` be an inverse system of schemes over `Iᵒᵖ` with
**affine** transition morphisms and every `X_i` **quasi-compact and quasi-separated**, let `c` be a
**limit** cone with vertex `X`, and let all the `X_i` and `X` be objects of a big étale site `B`.
Then for every presented system `E` — a system `(F_i)` of abelian sheaves on Mathlib's small étale
sites of the `X_i` in the sense of [Stacks, Tag 0EZL], together with an abelian sheaf `𝒢` on the
small étale site of `X` and legs `ι_i : f_i^{-1}F_i ⟶ 𝒢` exhibiting `𝒢 = colim_i f_i^{-1}F_i` —
and every degree `p`, the cohomology `H^p(X, 𝒢)` is the filtered colimit of the `H^p(X_i, F_i)`
along the legs.

This is `isCohomologyColimit_of_degreeZero_of_affineOpensAcyclic` with all four of its hypotheses
supplied; the module docstring says which theorem supplies each, and how the two instances
on the vertex are derived rather than assumed.

**No identity law** on the system of [Stacks, Tag 0EZL] is used or available: Definition 59.51.1 of
that tag imposes only the cocycle condition, and none of the four suppliers asks for more.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohomologyColimit_of_isLimit (p : ℕ)
    (E : PresentedSystem (c := c) IsColimitPresentation) : IsCohomologyColimit E p
declarations.comment: the whole tag, for ALL degrees `p ≥ 0` and every system of abelian sheaves in the sense of Tag 0EZL, with no hypothesis beyond the source's. The source assumes a directed set, affine transition morphisms, `X = lim X_i` and that every `X_i` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated; those are `IsDirected`, `IsAffineHom (D.map a)`, `hc : IsLimit c`, and the per-level `CompactSpace`/`QuasiSeparatedSpace` instances. The big etale site `B` with `hD`/`hX` is a SIZE device and not a source hypothesis: it fixes which small sites are meant, and `AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSite.exists_contains_of_small` produces one for any small family. The corresponding instances on the VERTEX are derived, not assumed. The conclusion is the tag's equality of groups in elementwise form -- joint surjectivity of the legs together with eventual vanishing, which for a filtered index and abelian coefficients is exactly the assertion that the cocone is colimiting -- and `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.SmallEtaleLimitCohomology.isColimit_stableCohomologyCocone` transports it, in both directions, to a genuine `CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit` whose vertex is the full `H^p(X, 𝒢)`. No identity law is used: Definition 59.51.1 imposes only the cocycle condition, so the naive diagram `i ↦ H^p(X_i, F_i)` is not a functor in general, and `hasCohomologyIdentityLaw_iff_forall_stableCohomologySubgroup_eq_top` says precisely when the two spellings coincide. No hypothesis of this statement is an instance of its own conclusion.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_of_constructible_immersion_cover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YR, for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups.** On a quasi-compact quasi-separated
scheme, a sheaf with values in a concrete category is constructible as soon as there are
constructible locally closed subschemes covering the scheme on each of which its inverse image is
constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_of_constructible_immersion_cover
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) D)
    {I : Type*} (T : I → B.Scheme) (j : ∀ i, T i ⟶ X)
    (hj : ∀ i, IsImmersion (B.inclusion.map (j i)))
    (hc : ∀ i, Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j i)).base))
    (hcover : (Set.univ : Set X.obj) = ⋃ i, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j i)).base)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B (T i)
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (j i)).sheafPullback D
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B (T i).obj (T i).property)).obj F)) :
    IsConstructibleFiniteSheaf B X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_constructible_immersion_cover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YR, for sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring.** On a quasi-compact
quasi-separated scheme, a sheaf of modules over a Noetherian ring is constructible as soon as there
are constructible locally closed subschemes covering the scheme on each of which its inverse image
is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_constructible_immersion_cover
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R))
    {I : Type*} (T : I → B.Scheme) (j : ∀ i, T i ⟶ X)
    (hj : ∀ i, IsImmersion (B.inclusion.map (j i)))
    (hc : ∀ i, Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j i)).base))
    (hcover : (Set.univ : Set X.obj) = ⋃ i, Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j i)).base)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B (T i) R
      (((smallEtaleBaseChange B (j i)).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{w} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B (T i).obj (T i).property)).obj F)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_setOf_surjective_etaleStalk_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS, part (1), surjectivity.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme.
For a map of constructible sheaves of sets on the small étale site of `X`, the set of points of
`X` at which the induced map of geometric stalks is surjective is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_setOf_surjective_etaleStalk_map
    (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F) (hG : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X G) :
    IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
      Function.Surjective
        ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom)}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_setOf_injective_etaleStalk_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS, part (1), injectivity.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme.
For a map of constructible sheaves of sets on the small étale site of `X`, the set of points of
`X` at which the induced map of geometric stalks is injective is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_setOf_injective_etaleStalk_map
    (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F) (hG : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X G) :
    IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
      Function.Injective
        ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom)}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_setOf_etaleStalk_map_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS, part (1), prescribed isomorphism class.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact
quasi-separated scheme and let `m₀` be a map of sets. For a map of constructible sheaves of sets
on the small étale site of `X`, the set of points of `X` at which the induced map of geometric
stalks is isomorphic to `m₀` is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_setOf_etaleStalk_map_iso {A₀ : Type v} {C₀ : Type w}
    (m₀ : A₀ → C₀) (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F) (hG : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X G) :
    IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
      ∃ (b : (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).obj F.obj ≃ A₀)
        (d : (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).obj G.obj ≃ C₀),
        ∀ z, d ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom z) =
          m₀ (b z)}
declarations.comment: part (1), isomorphic to a given map of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_supportSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS, part (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme. The support of
a constructible abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `X` is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_supportSheaf (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] [UnivLE.{u, w}]
    [∀ (Z : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B Z.obj Z.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (Z : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B Z.obj Z.property),
      ((SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective
        AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (Y Z : B.Scheme) (f : Z ⟶ Y),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w}
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F) :
    IsConstructible (supportSheaf B X.obj X.property F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_support_moduleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS, part (3).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let `Λ` be a
Noetherian ring. The support of a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on the small étale site of
`X` — the set of points carrying a nonzero geometric stalk — is constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_support_moduleSheaf (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (Λ : Type r) [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [UnivLE.{u, w}]
    [PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{max u w, max u w} (forget (ModuleCat.{max u w} Λ))]
    [∀ (Z : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B Z.obj Z.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{max u w} Λ)]
    [∀ (Z : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B Z.obj Z.property),
      ((SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective
        (ModuleCat.{max u w} Λ)]
    [∀ (Y Z : B.Scheme) (f : Z ⟶ Y),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{max u w} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max u w} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ F) :
    IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
      ¬ IsZero (etaleStalk B X.obj X.property t F.obj)}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_etaleStalk_map_loci_and_supports
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YS.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme.

1. For a map `φ : F ⟶ G` of constructible sheaves of sets on the small étale site of `X`, each of
   the three sets of points of `X` at which the induced map of geometric stalks is surjective, is
   injective, or is isomorphic to a prescribed map of sets `m₀`, is constructible.
2. The support of a constructible abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `X` is constructible.
3. For `Λ` a Noetherian ring, the support of a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on the small
   étale site of `X` is constructible.

Sheaves of sets have values in the universe `u + 1` of the site; abelian sheaves, resp. sheaves of
`Λ`-modules for `Λ : Type r`, have values in any universe containing that of the site, resp. that
of the site and of `Λ`. The statement has no hypothesis beyond the source's: every coefficient
condition the general parts `isConstructible_supportSheaf` and
`isConstructible_support_moduleSheaf` assume is proved at these universes inside the proof.

Part (1) is `isConstructible_setOf_surjective_etaleStalk_map`,
`isConstructible_setOf_injective_etaleStalk_map` and `isConstructible_setOf_etaleStalk_map_iso`,
part (2) is `isConstructible_supportSheaf` and part (3) is
`isConstructible_support_moduleSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_etaleStalk_map_loci_and_supports (B : BigEtaleSite.{u})
    (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] :
    (∀ (F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))) (φ : F ⟶ G),
        IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F → IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X G →
        IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
            Function.Surjective
              ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom)} ∧
          IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
            Function.Injective
              ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom)} ∧
          ∀ (A₀ : Type v) (C₀ : Type w₀) (m₀ : A₀ → C₀),
            IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
              ∃ (b : (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t
                  (Type (u + 1))).obj F.obj ≃ A₀)
                (d : (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t
                  (Type (u + 1))).obj G.obj ≃ C₀),
                ∀ z, d ((etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B X.obj X.property t
                  (Type (u + 1))).map φ.hom z) = m₀ (b z)}) ∧
      (∀ F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) w},
          IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F →
            IsConstructible (supportSheaf B X.obj X.property F)) ∧
      ∀ (Λ : Type r) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
        (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r w} Λ)),
        IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ F →
          IsConstructible {x : X.obj | ∃ t : GeometricPoint X.obj, t.LiesOver x ∧
            ¬ IsZero (etaleStalk B X.obj X.property t F.obj)}
declarations.comment: parts (1), (2) and (3), as the conjunction of the three constructibility claims

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_iff_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YT.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme. An abelian sheaf on the
small étale site of `X` is constructible exactly when it is of the form
`Coker(⨁_j j_{V_j!}(Z/m_jZ) → ⨁_i j_{U_i!}(Z/n_iZ))` with the `V_j` and `U_i` quasi-compact
quasi-separated objects of `X_étale` and the `m_j`, `n_i` positive integers.

Both inclusions are proved. A cokernel of that form is constructible because constructibility of
abelian sheaves is a weak Serre condition, Stacks 03RZ (2), and the summands are constructible by
Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups `Z/nZ`, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.abelianShriekZModIsConstructible`. Conversely a constructible abelian sheaf is
annihilated by a positive integer `N` and has a presentation by extensions by zero of the constant
sheaf `ℤ` from Stacks 095N at `Λ = ℤ`; quotienting that presentation by `N` turns it into one of
the displayed form.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_iff_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation
    (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj) (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F ↔
      HasFiniteZModShriekPresentation B X (IsQCQSEtaleObject B X) F
declarations.comment: a constructible abelian sheaf on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is exactly a cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of the sheaves j_{U!}(Z/nZ) at quasi-compact quasi-separated etale objects and positive integers n

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_iff_affineZModShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YT, the affine form.** "In fact, we can even assume `U_i` and `V_j` affine": the
étale objects of the presentation of a constructible abelian sheaf may be taken affine, and a
presentation by affine objects still has a constructible cokernel.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_iff_affineZModShriekPresentation
    (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj) (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F ↔
      HasFiniteZModShriekPresentation B X (SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.obj X.property) F
declarations.comment: the same characterization with the etale objects of the presentation affine, which is the tag's concluding sentence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YT**, the inclusion of the displayed cokernels into the constructible abelian
sheaves. Let `X` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Every abelian sheaf of the form
`Coker(⨁_j j_{V_j!}(Z/m_jZ) → ⨁_i j_{U_i!}(Z/n_iZ))`, with the `V_j` and `U_i` quasi-compact
quasi-separated objects of `X_étale` and the `m_j`, `n_i` positive, is a constructible abelian
sheaf, granted Stacks 03S8 (2) for the summands.

The reverse inclusion — every constructible abelian sheaf has such a presentation — is the other
half of the tag and is not proved here. The source deduces it from Stacks 095N at `Λ = Z/nZ`
together with the omitted fact that on a quasi-compact `X` every constructible abelian sheaf is
annihilated by some positive integer. Stacks 095N is now in the library, as
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_hasFiniteShriekPresentation`, but only for
sheaves of modules over a single ring in the model `Sheaf J (ModuleCat Λ)`, and three separate
things are missing for the reduction: the global annihilation statement, whose absence this
library already records in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleCohomology.ProperBaseChange.PrimaryDevissage` as waiting on
this very tag; a comparison between abelian sheaves annihilated by `n` and sheaves of
`Z/nZ`-modules, which `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.coefficientEquivalence` cannot supply because it
needs an equivalence of coefficient categories and `AddCommGrpCat` is not equivalent to
`ModuleCat (ZMod n)`; and an identification of `AlgebraicGeometry.moduleShriekConstant` at
`Z/nZ` with `AlgebraicGeometry.abelianShriekZMod`, which is not bookkeeping — the analogous
comparison between extension by zero of modules and of the underlying abelian sheaves is *not*
an isomorphism in general, by the counterexample
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriekForget_not_isomorphic`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation
    (h03S8 : AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible B) (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj)
    (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    {F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    (hF : HasFiniteZModShriekPresentation B X (IsQCQSEtaleObject B X) F) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the displayed cokernels at quasi-compact quasi-separated objects into the constructible abelian sheaves, granted Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups Z/nZ as the hypothesis h03S8; the reverse inclusion needs Stacks 095N at Lambda = Z/nZ and is not proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_affineZModShriekPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YT, the affine form of the same inclusion.** "In fact, we can even assume `U_i` and
`V_j` affine": for this inclusion that is a weakening of the hypothesis, since an affine scheme is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so the affine cokernels are constructible as well.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_affineZModShriekPresentation
    (h03S8 : AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible B) (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj)
    (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    {F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    (hF : HasFiniteZModShriekPresentation B X (SmallEtale.IsAffine B X.obj X.property) F) :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F
declarations.comment: the same inclusion for the affine form of the displayed cokernels (the tag's concluding sentence), granted Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups Z/nZ as the hypothesis h03S8

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YT**, the inclusion of the displayed cokernels into the constructible abelian
sheaves. Let `X` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Every abelian sheaf of the form

public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation_of_qcqs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_affineZModShriekPresentation_of_qcqs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFull_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_unconditional
declarations.doc: **Stacks 09YU, clause (2), the fullness assertion.**

theorem smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_unconditional (hc : IsLimit c)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (2).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of
schemes with affine transition morphisms, each `X_i` quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The
category of constructible abelian sheaves on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories of
constructible abelian sheaves on the `(X_i)_étale`: the comparison is faithful, full and
essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_unconditional (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))

    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (3), the essential surjectivity assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the
limit of a directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine
transition morphisms and let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring. Every constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on
`X_étale` is isomorphic to the inverse image of a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on some
`(X_i)_étale`.

A constructible sheaf is the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of sheaves `j_{U!}Λ`
with `U` affine (Stacks 095N); the affine `U` are base changed from a stage (Stacks 0EYL for
objects, which is Stacks 01ZM and 07RP), extension by zero commutes with base change, and the map
comes from a later stage by the fullness assertion; its cokernel there is constructible and
pulls back to the given sheaf, inverse image being right exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleModuleSheaf [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesEssSurj B (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (3).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of
schemes with affine transition morphisms, each `X_i` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let `Λ`
be a Noetherian ring. The category of constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is the
colimit of the categories of constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the `(X_i)_étale`: the
comparison, built from the inverse images and the canonical comparisons of iterated inverse
images, is faithful, full and essentially surjective. For a directed index these three conditions
are exactly the assertion that the canonical functor from the filtered colimit of the categories
is an equivalence.

Nothing is assumed beyond the source's hypotheses: a nonempty directed index, a limit cone,
affine transition morphisms, and quasi-compact quasi-separated stages.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFull_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (3), the fullness assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a
directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition
morphisms and let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring. Every map between the inverse images to `X_étale` of
two constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `(X_i)_étale` is the inverse image of a map at some
later stage, read through the canonical comparison of inverse images.

A constructible sheaf is a quotient of a finite direct sum of sheaves `j_{U!}Λ` with `U` affine by
Stacks 095N; the map on the sum comes from a stage by the degree zero case of Stacks 09YQ, its
restriction to the kernel vanishes on `X` and hence, by the faithfulness assertion, at a later
stage, where the map descends to the quotient.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleStagesFull_isConstructibleModuleSheaf [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesFull B (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (2), the faithfulness assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a
directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition
morphisms. Two maps of constructible sheaves of abelian groups on `(X_i)_étale` whose inverse
images to `X_étale` agree agree after inverse image to some later stage.

The image of the difference of the two maps is constructible by Tag 03RZ, so the locus where it
has a nonzero geometric stalk is constructible by Tag 09YS (2); inverse image to `X` is exact and
kills the difference, hence the image, so by Tag 03Q1 that locus misses the image of `X` and by
Tag 05F4 the image of a later stage, where Tag 03PU makes the inverse image of the image sheaf
zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesFaithful B AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleSetSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (1), the essential surjectivity assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the
limit of a directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine
transition morphisms inside a big étale site. Every constructible sheaf of sets on `X_étale` is
isomorphic to the inverse image of a constructible sheaf of sets on `(X_i)_étale` for some `i`.

Tag 09Y9 presents the sheaf as a coequalizer of two maps between finite coproducts of sheaves
represented by quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects; those coproducts are represented by the
disjoint unions of the objects, so the two maps are a parallel pair of morphisms of the site,
which descends to a stage by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_smallEtaleModel_parallelPair_of_qcqs`. The coequalizer of the
descended pair of representable sheaves is constructible at that stage by Tag 03RZ and Tag 03S8
part (1), and inverse image, a left adjoint commuting with the sheafified Yoneda embedding,
carries it to the given sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleSetSheaf (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesEssSurj B (Type (u + 1)) Dg c hX
      (fun X => IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleSetSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (1), the faithfulness assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a
directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition
morphisms. Two maps of constructible sheaves of sets on `(X_i)_étale` whose inverse images to
`X_étale` agree agree after inverse image to some later stage.

The locus in `X_i` where the two maps have the same geometric stalk is the locus where the
geometric stalk of the inclusion of their equalizer is surjective; the equalizer is constructible
by Tag 03RZ, so that locus is constructible by Tag 09YS and contains the image of `X`, hence by
Tag 05F4 the image of a later stage, where Tag 03PU turns the inverse image of the inclusion into
an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleSetSheaf (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesFaithful B (Type (u + 1)) Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleSetSheaf B Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (3), the faithfulness assertion.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a
directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition
morphisms and let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring. Two maps of constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules on
`(X_i)_étale` whose inverse images to `X_étale` agree agree after inverse image to some later
stage.

The image of the difference of the two maps is constructible by Tag 03RZ (3), so its support is
constructible by Tag 09YS (3); inverse image to `X` is exact and kills the difference, hence the
image, so by Tag 03Q1 that support misses the image of `X` and by Tag 05F4 the image of a later
stage, where Tag 03PU makes the inverse image of the image sheaf zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleModuleSheaf (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesFaithful B (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B Y Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (1).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms inside a big étale
site. The category of constructible sheaves of sets on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories
of constructible sheaves of sets on the `(X_i)_étale`, along étale inverse image: the comparison
is faithful (`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleSetSheaf`), full
(`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFull_isConstructibleSetSheaf`) and essentially surjective
(`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleSetSheaf`), which over a directed index
is the assertion that the category on the limit is the filtered colimit of the categories at the
stages.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B (Type (u + 1)) Dg c hX (fun X => IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (2).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms inside a big étale
site. The category of constructible abelian sheaves on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories
of constructible abelian sheaves on the `(X_i)_étale`, along étale inverse image: the comparison is
faithful (`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFaithful_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf`), full
(`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesFull_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf`) and essentially surjective
(`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesEssSurj_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf`), which over a directed
index is the assertion that the category on the limit is the filtered colimit of the categories at
the stages.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf [Nonempty I]
    [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Dg c hX
      (fun Y => IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_isConstructibleSetSheaf_iso_sheafifiedYoneda
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YU, clause (1), the essential surjectivity assertion for a representable sheaf.**
Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated
schemes with affine transition morphisms inside a big étale site. For every quasi-compact and
quasi-separated object `U` of `X_étale` there is a stage `i` and a *constructible* sheaf of sets
on `(X_i)_étale` whose inverse image to `X_étale` is the sheaf `h_U` represented by `U`.

This is the case of the essential surjectivity assertion of clause (1) to which the source
reduces it through Tag 09Y9. The object `U` is descended to the stage by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_smallEtaleModel_of_qcqs`; inverse image carries the representable
sheaf of the descended object to the representable sheaf of its base change, because inverse
image along a continuous functor commutes with the sheafified Yoneda embedding; and the
representable sheaf of a quasi-compact and quasi-separated object is constructible by Tag 03S8
part (1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_stage_isConstructibleSetSheaf_iso_sheafifiedYoneda (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (U : SmallEtale B c.pt hX)
    (hUc : CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj) (hUq : QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Fi : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B (Dg.obj (op i)).obj
        (Dg.obj (op i)).property) (Type (u + 1))),
      IsConstructibleSetSheaf B (Dg.obj (op i)) Fi ∧
        Nonempty ((smallEtaleStageProjection B (Type (u + 1)) Dg c hX i).obj Fi ≅
          (Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (SmallEtale.topology B c.pt hX)).obj U)
declarations.comment: clause (1), the essential surjectivity assertion for the sheaves represented by a quasi-compact and quasi-separated object of the small etale site, which is the case the source's proof reduces that assertion to

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09YV** for sheaves of sets. On a Noetherian scheme every ascending
chain of subsheaves of a constructible sheaf of sets stabilizes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    (hsub : ∀ {G H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))}
      (i : G ⟶ H), Mono i → IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X H → IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X G)
    (hess : ∀ (M : ℕ ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
      (c : Cocone M), IsColimit c →
      (∀ n, IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X (M.obj n)) → IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X c.pt →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : c.pt ⟶ M.obj n),
        EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith M c n r)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets, carrying Stacks 09BH (a subsheaf of a constructible sheaf of sets is constructible) as the explicit hypothesis hsub and Stacks 095P (a filtered system of constructible sheaves of sets whose colimit is constructible is essentially constant) as the explicit hypothesis hess

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09YV** for sheaves of abelian groups. On a Noetherian scheme every
ascending chain of subsheaves of a constructible sheaf of abelian groups stabilizes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (hsub : ∀ {G H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
      (i : G ⟶ H), Mono i →
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X H → IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X G)
    (hess : ∀ (M : ℕ ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (c : Cocone M), IsColimit c →
      (∀ n, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (M.obj n)) →
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X c.pt →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : c.pt ⟶ M.obj n),
        EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith M c n r)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups, carrying Stacks 09BH (a subsheaf of a constructible sheaf of abelian groups is constructible) as the explicit hypothesis hsub and Stacks 095P (a filtered system of constructible sheaves of abelian groups whose colimit is constructible is essentially constant) as the explicit hypothesis hess

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09YV** for sheaves of modules. On a Noetherian scheme, and over a
Noetherian coefficient ring, every ascending chain of subsheaves of a constructible sheaf of
modules stabilizes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    (R : Type r) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{w} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{w} R)]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R)]
    (hsub : ∀ {G H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R)}
      (i : G ⟶ H), Mono i →
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R H → IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R G)
    (hess : ∀ (M : ℕ ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R))
      (c : Cocone M), IsColimit c →
      (∀ n, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (M.obj n)) →
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R c.pt →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : c.pt ⟶ M.obj n),
        EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith M c n r)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} R))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring, carrying Stacks 09BH (a subsheaf of a constructible sheaf of modules is constructible) as the explicit hypothesis hsub and Stacks 095P (a filtered system of constructible sheaves of modules whose colimit is constructible is essentially constant) as the explicit hypothesis hess

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YV for sheaves of sets.** On a Noetherian scheme every ascending chain of
subsheaves of a constructible sheaf of sets on the small étale site stabilizes: the sheaf is a
Noetherian object of the category of sheaves of sets.

Stacks 09BH (1) and Stacks 095P (1) are supplied to
`AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_of_mono` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf_colimit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleSetSheaf'
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets: on a Noetherian scheme a constructible sheaf of sets on the small etale site is a Noetherian object, so every ascending chain of subsheaves stabilizes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YV for sheaves of abelian groups.** On a Noetherian scheme every ascending chain
of subsheaves of a constructible sheaf of abelian groups on the small étale site stabilizes: the
sheaf is a Noetherian object of the category of abelian sheaves.

Stacks 09BH (2) and Stacks 095P (2) are supplied to
`AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_mono` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_colimit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf'
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups: on a Noetherian scheme a constructible abelian sheaf on the small etale site is a Noetherian object, so every ascending chain of subsheaves stabilizes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YV for sheaves of modules, with nothing granted and the coefficient ring in any
universe.** On a Noetherian scheme, over a Noetherian ring, every ascending chain of subsheaves
of a constructible sheaf of `R`-modules stabilizes.

`AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf` carries Stacks 09BH and
Stacks 095P as the explicit hypotheses `hsub` and `hess`. Both are available above at a
coefficient ring in any universe, so they are supplied here and nothing is granted. The
quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness that Stacks 095P asks of `X` follow from its being
Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianObject_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf' [IsNoetherian X.obj]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F) :
    IsNoetherianObject F
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules over a Noetherian ring in any universe, with Stacks 09BH and Stacks 095P discharged

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.FiniteLevelSheaf.isNoetherianObject
declarations.doc:
A constructible finite-level sheaf is a Noetherian object: every ascending chain of subsheaves
of it stabilises.
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules, at the coefficients Z/l^{n+1}Z of a finite level of an l-adic sheaf

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isRightAdjoint_of_isCorepresentable_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09YX.** Let `C`, `D` be sites and let `finv : Sh(C) ⥤ Sh(D)` be a functor between
their topoi of sheaves of sets — for instance the inverse image `f⁻¹` of a morphism of topoi
`f : Sh(D) → Sh(C)`. Let `E` be a subset of the objects of `D` such that

1. for every `V ∈ E` there is a sheaf `G` on `C` with `finv F (V) = Mor_{Sh(C)}(G, F)`
   functorially in `F`, i.e. the functor `F ↦ finv F (V)` is corepresentable, and
2. every object of `D` has a covering by objects of `E`, i.e. the inclusion of the full
   subcategory on `E` is cover dense.

Then `finv` has a left adjoint `f_!`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRightAdjoint_of_isCorepresentable_sections {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {D : Type u} [Category.{v} D] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (finv : Sheaf J (Type max u v) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type max u v)) (E : ObjectProperty D)
    [E.ι.IsCoverDense K]
    (hE : ∀ V : D, E V → (finv ⋙ (sheafSections K (Type max u v)).obj (op V)).IsCorepresentable) :
    finv.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment:
Existence of lower shriek: the inverse image of a morphism of topoi has a left
  adjoint as soon as it is corepresentable on sections over a family of objects covering
  everything.

declarations.name: Stacks.FiniteAlgebraLimitPresentation.finiteLimitPresentationOfIsFinite
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 09YY].** A finite morphism over a quasi-compact and quasi-separated base is
the inverse limit of a directed system of morphisms to that base which are finite and of finite
presentation, with closed immersions as transition maps.

[Stacks, Tag 09ZQ] supplies such a system of morphisms of finite presentation, finiteness of
the stages failing only below some index; [Stacks, Tag 09ZN] produces that index, and the
cofinal tail above it is an initial subcategory, so the restricted system has the same
limit.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def finiteLimitPresentationOfIsFinite {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsFinite f]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] : FiniteLimitPresentation f

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag0817PartTwo.nonempty_integralLimitPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 09YZ.**  An integral morphism to a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme exhibits its source as the limit of a directed inverse system of schemes finite and of
finite presentation over that target.

This is the tag's own proof.  The quasi-coherent algebra `f_* 𝒪_X` ([Stacks, Tag 01LC], here
`Stacks.AffineAlgebraEquivalence.isQuasicoherent_pushforwardAlgebra`) is integral, part (2) of
[Stacks, Tag 0817] — `exists_small_index_finite_finitePresentation` above, packaged as
`integralAlgebraHasFiniteFinitePresentationColimit` — writes it as a filtered colimit of finite,
finitely presented quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-algebras, and the relative spectrum turns that colimit
into the required limit of schemes, with the finiteness and the finite presentation of each stage
read off its algebra.  That last passage is
`Stacks.IntegralLimit.nonempty_integralLimitPresentation_of_algebraColimit`, whose only hypothesis
was part (2).

The base is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, as the tag asks; the affine-base case
`AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_integralLimitPresentation_of_isAffine` is strictly weaker and is
subsumed by this.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_integralLimitPresentation {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsIntegralHom f]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] :
    Nonempty (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IntegralLimitPresentation f)
declarations.comment:
an integral morphism over a quasi-compact and quasi-separated base is the limit of
a directed inverse system of schemes finite and of finite presentation over that base

declarations.name: Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isIntegralHom_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Tag 09Z0: a surjective étale covering is refined by a surjective integral morphism
which factors through it Zariski-locally.** Let `p : U ⟶ X` be a surjective étale morphism of
schemes with `X` quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then there exist a scheme `Y` and a
surjective integral morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` such that every point of `Y` has an open neighbourhood
`V` for which `V ⟶ X` factors through `p`.

This is the general case of the tag's existence statement: neither separatedness of `p` nor any
hypothesis on its fibre degrees is assumed. The source's first reduction, to an affine — hence
separated — source, is `Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_of_isAffine_source`; a natural-number bound
for the degrees of the fibres over that affine source comes from
[Stacks, Tag 03JA](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03JA); and the induction on that bound is
`Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isIntegralHom_factorsNear_of_boundsFiberDegrees`.

The tag's closing refinement, that `f` may moreover be taken finite and of finite presentation,
is `Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isFinite_finitePresentation_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors`,
proved by presenting the integral refinement produced here as a limit of morphisms finite and of
finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isIntegralHom_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors (p : U ⟶ X) [Etale p]
    [Surjective p] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom f ∧ Surjective f ∧
      ZariskiLocallyFactors f p
declarations.comment:
the existence assertion: a surjective étale covering of a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme is refined by a surjective integral morphism factoring through it
Zariski-locally. The closing sentence, that the refinement may be taken finite and of finite
presentation, is
`Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isFinite_finitePresentation_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors`

declarations.name: Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isFinite_finitePresentation_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Tag 09Z0: the refinement may be taken finite and of finite presentation.** Let
`p : U ⟶ X` be a surjective étale morphism of schemes with `X` quasi-compact and quasi-separated.
Then there exist a scheme `Y` and a surjective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` which is finite and of finite
presentation — hence in particular integral — such that every point of `Y` has an open
neighbourhood `V` for which `V ⟶ X` factors through `p`.

This is the whole of the tag: the first assertion asks only that `f` be integral, which finiteness
gives, and the closing sentence asks for exactly the finiteness and the finite presentation. No
hypothesis beyond the source's is used; in particular `p` is not assumed separated and nothing is
assumed about the degrees of its fibres.

The integral refinement is
`Stacks.MoreMorphisms.exists_isIntegralHom_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors`; it is presented as
a limit of morphisms finite and of finite presentation by
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag0817PartTwo.nonempty_integralLimitPresentation`, which is
[Stacks, Tag 09YZ](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YZ) over a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated base; and one stage of that limit already carries the covering and the
factorisations, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_surjective_refinement_of_isLimit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFinite_finitePresentation_surjective_zariskiLocallyFactors (p : U ⟶ X)
    [Etale p] [Surjective p] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom f ∧ Surjective f ∧ IsFinite f ∧
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ∧ QuasiCompact f ∧ QuasiSeparated f ∧
      ZariskiLocallyFactors f p
declarations.comment:
the whole statement: the surjective refinement factoring through the covering
Zariski-locally, and the closing sentence that it may be taken finite and of finite presentation

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.FixedBaseHigherDirectImage.transitionMap
declarations.doc:
The transition map `ψ_{i'i} : R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i ⟶ R^p g_{i', *} ℱ_{i'}`: the base change map
`higherBaseChangeMapAb` for the square `g_{i'} ≫ 𝟙_S = f_{i'i} ≫ g_i`, read through the
identification of the inverse image along `𝟙_S` with the identity functor, followed by
`R^p g_{i', *}` of the transition map `φ_{i'i} : f_{i'i}^{-1}ℱ_i ⟶ ℱ_{i'}` of the system of
sheaves.
declarations.comment: the transition maps `ψ_{i'i} : R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i ⟶ R^p g_{i', *} ℱ_{i'}` of the diagram whose colimit the lemma computes, constructed from the base change map on higher direct images of Stacks 0F02 for the square over the fixed base and the transition map of the system of sheaves. The cocycle condition `ψ_{i''i} = ψ_{i''i'} ∘ ψ_{i'i}` is NOT proved here: the pasting law it reduces to, `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.higherBaseChangeMapAb_paste_app`, is unconditional, and the cocycle condition for the transition maps of a system of bases is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LimitHigherDirectImage.transitionMap_comp`, but neither is transported to the fixed base, where the comparisons of the inverse image along `𝟙_S` have to be moved past them. The colimit assertion `R^p g_* ℱ = colim_i R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i` is NOT proved either; it additionally needs Theorem 09YQ at quasi-compact quasi-separated levels and the comparison of Stacks 04HR at the level of cohomology, the carriers of 09YQ in this repository being stated for the right-derived `CategoryTheory.sheafSections` of the small AFFINE étale sites.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.FixedBaseHigherDirectImage.projectionMap
declarations.doc:
The map `ψ_i : R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i ⟶ R^p g_* ℱ`: the base change map `higherBaseChangeMapAb`
for the square `g ≫ 𝟙_S = f_i ≫ g_i`, read through the identification of the inverse image along
`𝟙_S` with the identity functor, followed by `R^p g_*` of the map `ι_i : f_i^{-1}ℱ_i ⟶ ℱ`
presenting `ℱ` as `colim f_i^{-1}ℱ_i`.
declarations.statement:
def projectionMap (F : EtaleSheafSystem D Ab.{u + 1})
    (ι : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, (smallEtalePullbackAb (c.π.app i)).obj (F.obj i) ⟶ 𝓕) (i : Iᵒᵖ)
    (w : gX = c.π.app i ≫ g i) :
    stage g p F i ⟶ ((smallEtalePushforwardAb gX).rightDerived p).obj 𝓕
declarations.comment: the cocone maps `ψ_i : R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i ⟶ R^p g_* ℱ` whose universality the lemma asserts, constructed from the base change map on higher direct images of Stacks 0F02 for the square over the fixed base and the map `ι_i : f_i^{-1}ℱ_i ⟶ ℱ` presenting the colimit. The compatibility `ψ_{i'} ∘ ψ_{i'i} = ψ_i`, which would exhibit these maps as a cocone, is NOT proved, for the reason recorded on `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.FixedBaseHigherDirectImage.transitionMap`. The colimit assertion `R^p g_* ℱ = colim_i R^p g_{i, *} ℱ_i` is NOT proved.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.FixedBaseHigherDirectImage.isSystemColimit
declarations.doc:
Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system of schemes over `S` with affine
transition morphisms and quasi-compact and quasi-separated structure morphisms `g_i : X_i ⟶ S`,
let `g : X ⟶ S` be the structure morphism of the limit, and let `ι_i : f_i⁻¹ℱ_i ⟶ ℱ` present
`ℱ = colim f_i⁻¹ℱ_i` for a system `(ℱ_i, φ_{i'i})` of abelian sheaves. Then for every `p` the
maps `ψ_i : R^p g_{i, *}ℱ_i ⟶ R^p g_*ℱ` present `R^p g_*ℱ = colim_i R^p g_{i, *}ℱ_i`, the
transition maps being the `ψ_{i'i}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSystemColimit (p : ℕ) (F : EtaleSheafSystem D Ab.{u + 1})
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology c.pt) Ab.{u + 1})
    (ι : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, (smallEtalePullbackAb (c.π.app i)).obj (F.obj i) ⟶ 𝓕)
    (hι : ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j),
      (conePullbackComp c a).inv.app (F.obj j) ≫
        (smallEtalePullbackAb (c.π.app i)).map (F.map a) ≫ ι i = ι j)
    (hpres : LimitHigherDirectImage.IsPullbackColimitPresentation c 𝓕 F ι) :
    IsSystemColimit (stage g p F) (fun {_i _j} a => transitionMap g p F a (hg a))
      (((smallEtalePushforwardAb gX).rightDerived p).obj 𝓕)
      (fun i => projectionMap g p c gX 𝓕 F ι i (w i))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_cechSheafSpectralSequence_functorial
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 09Z2].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective finite morphism of schemes, let
`f_n : X_n ⟶ Y` be the structure map of the `(n + 1)`-fold fibre product of `X` over `Y`, and for
an abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `Y` put `F_n = f_{n,*}f_n^{-1}F`. Then:

* there is an exact sequence `0 → F → F_0 → F_1 → F_2 → ⋯` on `Y_étale`, with augmentation the
  canonical map `F ⟶ f_*f^{-1}F`;
* there is a cohomological spectral sequence with
  `E_1^{p,q} = H^q_étale(X_p, f_p^{-1}F)` converging to `H^{p+q}(Y_étale, F)`, convergence
  meaning that each `H^n(Y_étale, F)` carries a finite decreasing filtration `Fil` whose graded
  pieces are the stable terms of the spectral sequence;
* **this spectral sequence is functorial in `F`**: it is produced by a *functor* `E` of `F`, the
  first-page identification is an isomorphism of functors of `F`, and the filtration of the
  abutment is carried into itself by the map a morphism `F ⟶ G` induces on cohomology.

The exact sequence is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_exact_cechSheafSequence`; the functor is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.cechSpectralSequenceFunctor`, the augmented cobar complex of the monad
`f_*f^{-1}` followed by the hyper-`Ext` spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 0AVI].
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_cechSheafSpectralSequence_functorial [IsFinite f] [Surjective f] :
    (∀ F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1},
        ∃ (d : ∀ n : ℕ, cechSheaf f F n ⟶ cechSheaf f F (n + 1))
          (haug : cechAug f F ≫ d 0 = 0) (hdd : ∀ n : ℕ, d n ≫ d (n + 1) = 0),
          Mono (cechAug f F) ∧ (ShortComplex.mk _ _ haug).Exact ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (hdd n)).Exact) ∧
      ∃ E : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1} ⥤
          CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 1,
        (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty (E ⋙
            CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} _ 1 1 (le_refl 1) ⋙
              HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} _ ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≅
            smallEtalePullbackAb (cechProjection f p) ⋙
              sheafHFunctor (cechScheme f p) q)) ∧
          ∃ (Fil : ∀ (_p : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}),
                Subobject ((sheafHFunctor Y n).obj F))
            (hFil : ∀ (p p' : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}),
                p ≤ p' → Fil p' n F ≤ Fil p n F),
            (∀ (p : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (F G : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (φ : F ⟶ G),
                (Subobject.«exists» ((sheafHFunctor Y n).map φ)).obj (Fil p n F) ≤
                  Fil p n G) ∧
              (∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}),
                  ∃ s t : ℤ, s ≤ t ∧ Fil s n F = ⊤ ∧ Fil t n F = ⊥) ∧
                ∀ (p q : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}),
                  p + q = (n : ℤ) → ∃ r₀ : ℤ, 1 ≤ r₀ ∧
                    ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), r₀ ≤ r →
                      ((E.obj F).page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q + 1 - r) = 0 ∧
                        ((E.obj F).page r hr).d (p - r, q + r - 1) (p, q) = 0 ∧
                          Nonempty (((E.obj F).page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
                            cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (Fil (p + 1) n F) (Fil p n F)
                              (hFil p (p + 1) n F (by omega))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mono_smallEtaleUnitAb_of_isFinite_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 09Z2, exactness at `ℱ`.** For a finite surjective morphism of schemes the unit
`ℱ ⟶ f_* f^{-1}ℱ` of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction on abelian sheaves on the small
étale sites is a monomorphism. The zeroth level of the Čech nerve of `f` being `X` itself, this
is injectivity of the augmentation `ℱ ⟶ ℱ₀`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_smallEtaleUnitAb_of_isFinite_of_surjective
    [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] [Surjective (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.1 Y.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    Mono (((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B Y.1 Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property)).unit.app G)
declarations.comment:
exactness at `ℱ` of `0 → ℱ → ℱ₀ → ℱ₁ → ⋯`, i.e. injectivity of the augmentation
`ℱ ⟶ ℱ₀ = f_*f^{-1}ℱ`; exactness in the higher degrees and the spectral sequence are not proved
here

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalSectionsPullback_isEqualizer_of_isFinite_surjective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 09Z3].**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite surjective morphism of schemes and let
`𝒢` be a sheaf of sets on the small étale site of `Y`.  The first two levels of the Čech nerve of
`f` are `X₀ = X` with `f₀ = f`, and `X₁ = X ×_Y X` with `f₁ = pr₀ ≫ f = pr₁ ≫ f`.  Then

`Γ(Y, 𝒢) = Equalizer (Γ(X₀, f₀⁻¹𝒢) ⇉ Γ(X₁, f₁⁻¹𝒢))`:

the canonical comparison `Γ(Y, 𝒢) ⟶ Γ(X₀, f₀⁻¹𝒢)` on global sections is injective, and a
section of `f₀⁻¹𝒢` over `X₀` is in its image exactly when its two pullbacks to `X₁` agree.

The comparison is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleGlobalPullback`, which is by definition the
component at `𝒢` of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalSectionsSmallEtaleInverseImageComparison`;  the two parallel
arrows are the two instances of `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.relativeGlobalSectionsMap` attached to
the two factorizations `f₁ = pr₀ ≫ f` and `f₁ = pr₁ ≫ f` of the structure morphism of `X₁`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem globalSectionsPullback_isEqualizer_of_isFinite_surjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Surjective f]
    (G : Sheaf (Scheme.smallEtaleTopology Y) (Type (max (u + 1) v))) :
    Function.Injective (etaleGlobalPullback f G) ∧
      ∀ t : (etaleGlobalSections X).obj ((smallEtaleInverseImage.{u, v} f).obj G),
        relativeGlobalSectionsMap f (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.fst f f ≫ f) rfl G t =
            relativeGlobalSectionsMap f (pullback.snd f f) (pullback.fst f f ≫ f)
              pullback.condition G t ↔
          ∃ s : (etaleGlobalSections Y).obj G, etaleGlobalPullback f G s = t
declarations.comment:
the displayed equality `Γ(Y, 𝒢) = Equalizer (Γ(X₀, f₀⁻¹𝒢) ⇉ Γ(X₁, f₁⁻¹𝒢))`, for a
finite surjective `f : X ⟶ Y` and a sheaf of sets `𝒢` on the small étale site of `Y`, with
`X₀ = X`, `f₀ = f`, `X₁ = X ×_Y X` and `f₁` the structure morphism of `X₁`:  the canonical
comparison on global sections is injective with image exactly the equalizer

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable
declarations.doc:
**The sheaves-of-abelian-groups case of Stacks 09Z4.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme and let `F` be a constructible abelian sheaf on `X_étale`. Then morphisms
out of `F` commute with filtered colimits of abelian sheaves:
`Mor(F, colim G_i) = colim Mor(F, G_i)`.

A constructible abelian sheaf is a constructible sheaf of `ℤ`-modules and `ℤ` is Noetherian, so
this is the module case at `Λ = ℤ`. Stacks 095N at `ℤ`, the presentation of a constructible sheaf
of `ℤ`-modules as the cokernel of a map between finite direct sums of extensions by zero of the
constant sheaf `ℤ` at quasi-compact and quasi-separated étale objects, is supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasFiniteShriekPresentation_of_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_int`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X F) :
    IsFinitelyPresentable.{u + 1} F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsConstructibleModuleSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**The sheaves-of-`Λ`-modules case of Stacks 09Z4, with nothing assumed.** Let `X` be a
quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `F` be a
constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale`. Then morphisms out of `F` commute with filtered
colimits of sheaves of `Λ`-modules: `Mor(F, colim G_i) = colim Mor(F, G_i)`.

The inverse image along small étale base change and the sheafification of presheaves of
`Λ`-modules on the slices of the small étale sites, through which constructibility of a sheaf of
`Λ`-modules is stated, are found here by instance search rather than taken as arguments.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsConstructibleModuleSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable_unconditional
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F) :
    IsFinitelyPresentable.{u + 1} F
declarations.comment: sheaves of Λ-modules over an arbitrary Noetherian ring, with the inverse image along small étale base change and the sheafification on the slices proved rather than assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsConstructibleModuleSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable
declarations.doc:
**The sheaves-of-`Λ`-modules case of Stacks 09Z4.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme, let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and let `F` be a constructible sheaf of
`Λ`-modules on `X_étale`. Then morphisms out of `F` commute with filtered colimits of sheaves of
`Λ`-modules: `Mor(F, colim G_i) = colim Mor(F, G_i)`.

Stacks 095N, the presentation of a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules as the cokernel of a map
between finite direct sums of extensions by zero of constant free rank-one module sheaves at
quasi-compact and quasi-separated étale objects, is supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_iff_qcqsShriekPresentation`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsConstructibleModuleSheaf.isFinitelyPresentable
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [CompactSpace X.1] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.1]
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.1 S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R F) :
